scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
What a nice day, isn't it!
Welcome to Cat Merchant Group. We do anything to please our customers. We would even lie on our back if you want!
scripts.translation:
[傳送貓]
今天天氣真好，不是嗎！
歡迎來到貓咪商會。我們願意做任何事來取悅顧客。如果您願意，我們甚至可以躺在地上！

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
We provide teleport service between various regions based on our accumulated knowledge. We accept Malangdo Canned Specialties or Zeny, so you can pay however you like it~
scripts.translation:
[傳送貓]
我們根據積累的知識，提供各地區之間的傳送服務。我們接受馬拉甘多罐頭特產或Zeny，您可以選擇自己喜歡的支付方式~

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
I'll see you later then.
scripts.translation:
[傳送貓]
那我先走了，回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
I'm afraid it's not enough. Sorry, but it can't be done for free~
scripts.translation:
[傳送貓]
恐怕不夠呢。抱歉，不能免費使用哦~

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
I'm afraid it's not enough. Sorry, but it can't be done for free~
scripts.translation:
[傳送貓]
恐怕不夠呢。抱歉，不能免費使用哦~

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please wait a minute.
All first-time visitors to Eclage must fill out the necessary forms before entering.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
請稍等。
所有首次前往埃克拉珠的訪客，都必須填寫必要的表格後才能進入。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
All first-time visitors to Eclage must fill out the necessary forms here before entering.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
所有首次前往埃克拉珠的訪客，都必須在這裡填寫必要的表格後才能進入。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Great, you completed the forms.
Welcome to Eclage, the capital of the Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
很好，您已填好表格。
歡迎來到拉菲尼絲的首都——埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Welcome to Eclage, the capital of the Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
歡迎來到拉菲尼絲的首都——埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please submit your forms to the administrator over there after writing in your name, occupation, and level.
There may be some waiting time, so take your time.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
請填寫您的姓名、職業和等級，然後將表格交給那邊的管理員。
可能需要等待一段時間，請慢慢來。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please understand because of a recent increase in the influx of people from Midgard through Bifrost, we had to create this process.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
由於最近通過雙層牛肉堡從米德加爾特湧入的人流增加，我們不得不設立這一流程，請諒解。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Of course, the documents will be secured away after their use in access regulations, so you don't have to worry.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
當然，檔案在用於准入管理後會被妥善保管，您不必擔心。

scripts.text: Fill out the forms.
scripts.translation: 填寫表格

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please note that you would not be able to enter the city without filling out the forms.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
請注意，如果不填寫表格，您將無法進入城市。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please fill out your name, occupation, and level here.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
請在這裡填寫您的姓名、職業和等級。

scripts.text: Write your name.
scripts.translation: 填寫您的姓名。

scripts.text: Write your occupation.
scripts.translation: 填寫您的職業。

scripts.text: Write your level.
scripts.translation: 填寫您的等級。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
If you completed your forms, please submit them to the administrator over there.
There may be some waiting time, so take your time.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
如果您已填好表格，請將其交給那邊的管理員。
可能需要等待一段時間，請慢慢來。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Since Eclage is under the influence of Bifrost, there is fluent communication among the races.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
由於埃克拉珠受到雙層牛肉堡的影響，各種族之間的交流非常順暢。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
There would be no need for any separate translation, and there are enough bridges for on-foot races, so I hope you have a comfortable visit.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
不需要單獨的翻譯，而且也有足夠的橋梁供步行種族使用，希望您能度過愉快的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Since Eclage is under the influence of Bifrost, there is fluent communication among the races.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
由於埃克拉珠受到雙層牛肉堡的影響，各種族之間的交流非常順暢。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
There would be no need for any separate translation, and there are enough bridges for on-foot races, so I hope you have a comfortable visit.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
不需要單獨的翻譯，而且也有足夠的橋梁供步行種族使用，希望您能度過愉快的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
There's still a lot of people before you. Could you please wait until your turn?
It won't be too long.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
您前面還有很多人，請等到輪到您時再來。
不會太久的。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Whew! I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
There are just too many visitors.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
呼！抱歉讓您久等了。
遊客實在太多了。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Alright, next person in line please!
Next!
Next person!
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
好的，下一位請上前！
下一位！
下一位！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
What do you need?
As you can see, I'm really busy here, so unless you need something, please don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
您有什麼事？
如您所見，我這裡非常忙，如果沒有急事，請不要打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Oh wow, this is just so crazy.
{0} Here, your documents are processed.
You may enter the city when you go talk to the security guard.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
哇，這也太瘋狂了。
{0}，您的檔案已處理完畢。
請去和保安交談後即可進入城市。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
So if you will place your forms here...
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
那麼，如果您把表格放在這裡...

scripts.text:
[???]
Here!! These are my completed forms!!
This time it's all good, right?
Let me through quick!
scripts.translation:
[???]
在這裡！！這是我填好的表格！！
這次應該沒問題了吧？
快點讓我過去！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
I'm taking care of visitors in the order they arrived, so please wait for your turn.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
我是按照到達順序處理遊客的，所以請等待輪到您。

scripts.text:
[???]
What are you talking about!
I was waaaay before all of these guys!
scripts.translation:
[???]
你在說什麼！
我明明比這些人都早到！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Well, your turn was delayed because you had to fill out your forms, so you have to wait until later.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
嗯，因為您之前需要填寫表格，所以您的輪次被推遲了，您必須等到後面。

scripts.text:
[???]
What?! You just said you take care of visitors in the order they arrived!!!
scripts.translation:
[???]
什麼？！你剛才不是說按照到達順序處理遊客的嗎！！！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Yes, I did say that but...
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
是的，我確實那樣說了，但是...

scripts.text: - SMACK!!! -

[???]
OW!! Why did you hit me?
scripts.translation:
[???]
痛！！你為什麼要打我？

scripts.text:
[???]
I'm so sorry.
My stupid friend here is causing trouble.
scripts.translation:
[???]
非常抱歉。
是我這個笨蛋朋友在惹麻煩。

scripts.text:
[???]
Who are you calling stupid?!
scripts.translation:
[???]
你誰啊，說誰笨蛋呢？！

scripts.text:
[???]
If you hadn't filled out my name incorrectly in the first place, we wouldn't be waiting like this!
scripts.translation:
[???]
如果你一開始沒有把我的名字填錯，我們就不會在這裡等這麼久了！

scripts.text:
[???]
Mark Esha or Madrid, they're all the same!
scripts.translation:
[???]
馬克·艾沙還是馬德里，反正都一樣！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
They're not at all the same!
And what's more, how can you not know the name of your friend of 15 years?
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
完全不一樣！
而且，你怎麼會連認識15年的朋友的名字都不知道？

scripts.text:
[???]
It's not that I didn't know- I did it on purpose!!
Madrid is just fine! Madrid!
scripts.translation:
[???]
不是我不知道-我是故意的！！
馬德里就很好！馬德里！

scripts.text: - SMACK -

[Mark Esha]
Hu... I am so sorry that my friend is this stupid.
Please don't mind us and do what you need to do.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
嗚...真抱歉，我的朋友這麼笨。
請別介意我們，繼續做您需要做的事吧。

scripts.text:
[???]
AHHHH!!!
LET ME IN!!!!
How long do I have to wait out here!!!
scripts.translation:
[???]
啊啊啊！！！
讓我進去！！！！
我還要在外面等多久啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Would you stay put just for a second?!!!
Sorry. So sorry.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
你就不能老實待一會兒嗎？！！
抱歉。真的非常抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Oh wow, this is just so crazy.
{0} Here, your documents are processed.
You may enter the city when you go talk to the security guard.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
哇，這也太瘋狂了。
{0}，您的檔案已處理完畢。
請去和保安交談後即可進入城市。

scripts.text:
[???]
Shuffle, shuffle
scripts.translation:
[???]
挪動，挪動

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
And Mr. Deu Lean, please take your group and enter. It's just way too noisy.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
還有杜連先生，請帶著您的隊伍進去吧。這裡實在太吵了。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Mwahah!!
SEE THAT?!
Thanks to me, we got through faster!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
哇哈哈！！
看到了嗎？！
多虧了我，我們才過得更快！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
You mean slower...
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
你是說更慢...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
A real man does not get bogged down by the past!!
I may have been slow with the documentation but I will be the one to enter Eclage first!
Mwahah!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
真正的男子漢不會被過去束縛！！
雖然我在辦理檔案時慢了點，但我一定會第一個進入埃克拉珠！
哇哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
......Whew
I'm so sorry for everything.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
......呼
對不起，發生了這麼多事。

scripts.text:
[???]
Well......
Mr. Mark, Mr. Du is already gone.
scripts.translation:
[???]
嗯......
馬克先生，杜先生已經走了。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
My goodness......
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
天哪......

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Ack...
I don't think it's all for the best to have so many visitors.
scripts.translation:
[入境官員]
唉...
我覺得這麼多遊客湧入，未必全是好事。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I can't believe I have to wait this long......
When is it going to be my turn?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
真不敢相信我要等這麼久......
什麼時候才輪到我？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm actually done with my documentation, but I'm just sticking around to appreciate all of these flowers.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
其實我的檔案已經辦好了，但我只是想留下來欣賞這些花。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm just getting through the night with my sleeping bag!
It's alright as long as you can withstand the security guard's annoyance with you.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我就帶著睡袋在這裡過夜了！
只要你能忍受保安對你的嘮叨，這就沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I wonder how beautiful of a city Eclage would be.
It just makes my heart beat thinking about it.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
不知道埃克拉珠這座城市有多美。
光是想想就讓我心跳加速。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
No, I'm not a visitor. I'm an Eclage citizen!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
不，我不是遊客。我是埃克拉珠的市民！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I can't believe I can't even enter because of all these tourists!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
真不敢相信，因為這麼多遊客，我連家都進不去！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I hear their acorns are delicious without a hint of bitterness.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
聽說那裡的橡果很好吃，而且完全沒有苦味。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
You could probably make the world's best acorn jello.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
說不定能做出世界上最好吃的橡果果凍。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
It's important to keep your belongings light when traveling.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
旅行時保持行李輕便很重要。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
It's going to increase as you go along anyways.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
反正隨著旅程的深入，負擔也會增加的。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Perhaps you could consider it as the weight of life?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
或許你可以把它看作生活的重量？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Cool cool.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
酷，真酷。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Snorrrreee....Erhem....
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
呼嚕嚕嚕...咳咳...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Err.... No.....
Curry.... Curry rice.... Snorrreeeee
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
呃...不...
咖哩...咖哩飯...呼嚕嚕嚕

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Oh! Are you also from Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
哦！你也是來自米德加爾特嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
It's encouraging to see so many Midgard people nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
現在能看到這麼多米德加爾特人，真讓人振奮。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ow.... My legs...
You're saying I have to wait after all this traveling through Bifrost?!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
哎喲...我的腿...
經過雙層牛肉堡這麼長途跋涉，居然還要等待？！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ahh...
Why are there so many people...?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
啊...
為什麼有這麼多的人...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I want to be alone......Sniff!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我想一個人靜靜......吸溜！

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hey!!!!!!!
Be careful over there!!
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
嘿！！！！！！
那邊小心點！！

scripts.text: - The bridge is broken. There should be some kind of a solution. -
scripts.translation: - 橋斷了。應該有什麼解決辦法。 -

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Wait!!!!!
That's an unregistered visitor!!!!!!!
Security!!! Security!!!
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
等等！！！！！！
那是未登記的訪客！！！！！！
保安！保安！

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Did you talk to the security guard before coming into the city?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
進城之前你有和保安交談過嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
The bridge is kind of broken so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
橋有點損壞，請小心。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
This area is kind of broken, so be careful.
Otherwise, you'll fall aaaaaall the way down.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
這片區域有點損壞，請小心。
否則，你會一直掉下去的。

scripts.text: The work being done right now
scripts.translation: 目前正在進行的工程

scripts.text: The reason for the bridge being broken
scripts.translation: 橋梁損壞的原因

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
As you can see, I'm doing some carpentry work.
There are more visitors to Eclage nowadays, so I'm primarily working on building bridges.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
如您所見，我正在做木工活。
最近來埃克拉珠的訪客變多了，所以我主要在建橋。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Oh, just a minute ago, there was a human being who took a misstep and broke a tree branch while falling.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
哦，就在剛才，有個人類失足摔下來，把樹枝弄斷了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
You can't get past here until it's repaired, so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
在修好之前，您無法通過這裡，請小心。

scripts.text: [Fairy Carpenter]
scripts.translation: [妖精木匠]

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
In fact, Laphines can fly around so bridges are technically not necessary, but we are building them since there are many visitors who have been getting hurt by falling while climbing trees.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
其實，拉菲涅斯會飛，所以嚴格來說不需要橋。
但因為有很多訪客在爬樹時摔傷，所以我們還是建了橋。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Being close to the entrance and all, this really needs to be fixed soon.
I'm trying to decide whether I should put up a warning sign, gather the necessary materials for repair, or call a friend to help.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
這裡離入口很近，真的需要儘快修好。
我正在考慮是立個警告牌，還是收集維修材料，或者叫朋友來幫忙。

scripts.text: Give help.
scripts.translation: 幫忙

scripts.text: Don't give help.
scripts.translation: 不幫忙

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
You can't get past here until it's repaired, so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
在修好之前，您無法通過這裡，請小心。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Wow!!!
You are going to help me?!
So... so kind...
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
哇！！！
你要幫我嗎？！
太...太善良了...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
I can't believe there's still this kind of kindness left in the world... Hmm, sweaty eyes...
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
真不敢相信世界上還有這麼善良的人... 嗯，眼睛有點溼潤...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Would you then bring me a new bridge to use for repair?
Since other people can get hurt, I'll use my magic to maintain this bridge in the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
那麼，你能給我帶一座新橋來用於維修嗎？
因為其他人可能會受傷，我會先用魔法維持這座橋的狀態。

scripts.text: What if you use magic to repair it?
scripts.translation: 用魔法修好它呢？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm, it's not impossible, but magic that deals with creation of life requires much magic power and shouldn't be used so freely.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
嗯，不是不可能，但涉及創造生命的魔法需要大量魔力，不應該隨意使用。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
If I were to describe how stupid that would be... Well, it's like turning a deliciously baked chocolate cake back into flour.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
如果要說這有多愚蠢... 嗯，就像把烤好的美味巧克力蛋糕變回麵粉一樣。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Since the broken part is about 19 meters from here...
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
因為損壞的部分離這裡大約19米...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Ahh! Now that I remember, before we used to be able to order the exact necessary length, but because they are mass-producing them nowadays, they only provide preset lengths.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
啊！我想起來了，以前我們可以訂購精確所需的長度，但現在因為是批次生產，只提供預設的長度。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
To maximize the stability, it's better to avoid connecting multiple bridge pieces together,
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
為了最大化穩定性，最好避免將多塊橋板連線在一起，

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
and this broken bridge... from here to there it's about 19 meters and the prepieces come in 3 meters = 5 meters, and 10 meters......
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
而且這座斷橋... 從這裡到那裡大約19米，而預製件有3米、5米和10米...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm.......

[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm......
......

[Fairy Carpenter]
......Hmm.........
- It's probably just my imagination that smoke is coming out of his head, right? -
scripts.translation: - 大概只是我的錯覺，他頭上冒煙了，對吧？ -

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Oh ho!
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
哦！
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
To make a bridge of 19 meters in length with the fewest number of pieces possible, how many of each 3, 5, or 10 meter length pieces would I need?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
要用最少的橋板拼出19米長的橋，需要多少塊3米、5米或10米的橋板呢？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Please write the number of pieces necessary for each length. If no pieces for that length are necessary, please write 0.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
請寫出每種長度所需的數量。如果不需要某種長度，請寫0。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm that's kind of....
Would there be a better way?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
嗯，這樣有點......
有沒有更好的辦法？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Yeah, that sounds good, right?
Especially since there wouldn't be a need to make them so straight.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
是啊，聽起來不錯，對吧？
而且這樣就不需要把它們做得那麼直了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Okay, if you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
好的，去跟[戈利]談談，他在中央塔附近的城外工作，他會給你新的橋板。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
If you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
好的，去跟[戈利]談談，他在中央塔附近的城外工作，他會給你新的橋板。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
If you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
好的，去跟[戈利]談談，他在中央塔附近的城外工作，他會給你新的橋板。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Oh man, he's still worried about that kind of thing.
He's too serious for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
天哪，他還在擔心這種事。
他太認真了，毫無理由。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Whoa! This isn't the time to be doing this. I should repair the bridge quickly and help out all the people who fell through.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
哇！現在不是做這種事的時候。我應該儘快修好橋，幫助那些掉下去的人。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Ah!
Thank goodness!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
啊！
太好了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
I would have been toast if it weren't for that tree branch.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
要不是那根樹枝，我早就完蛋了。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I told you to be careful!
Exactly how much trouble do you want to cause?
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
我告訴過你要小心！
你到底想惹出多少麻煩？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
...

[Du Lian]
No way!
They're those guys from earlier!
Oy!
I thought I got rid of them, but it looks like they aren't going to be that easy.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
不會吧！
是剛才那幾個人！
喂！
我以為我擺脫他們了，但看來他們沒那麼容易打發。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I'm sorry.
We just have not been our best ever since we met.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
對不起。
自從我們相遇以來，我們就一直狀態不佳。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Well, I'm going to let it pass this time around, but if you break the bridge again, I'm going to put you in jail!
You should know that I am pretty busy myself.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
好吧，這次我就放過你們，但如果你們再弄斷橋，我就把你們關進監獄！
你們應該知道我自己也很忙。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I'm sorry.
I'll take special caution, so please don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
對不起。
我會特別小心的，請放心。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
But for a bridge to break so easily after running a bit, isn't it just too weak?
Giants couldn't even visit Eclage in this wa...
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
但是，橋才跑了一會兒就斷了，這難道不是太脆弱了嗎？
巨人甚至都沒法這樣去埃克拉珠...

scripts.text: - SNAP -
scripts.translation: - 咔嚓 -

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
......

[Mark Esha]
Oh dear....
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
哎呀....

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Uh oh...
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wait! No, it's really a mistake this time!
Look!
Even this warning sign tells you that you have to grab onto the hand rails since the bridge is so dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
等等！不，這次真的是個意外！
你看！
連這個警告牌都寫著，因為橋太危險了，必須抓住扶手。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
All I did was just place my hand on it!
I really didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
我只是把手放上去而已！
我真的什麼都沒做！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
......

[Carpenter Fon]
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
唉...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Get out of here you troublemaker!!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
快滾，你這個麻煩製造者!!!!

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I am so sorry.
I will come by to help out later even if it's by tying this guy up to a pole.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
非常抱歉。
稍後我會過來幫忙，哪怕是把這傢伙綁在柱子上也好。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Don't come back!
Don't EVER come back!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
別回來了！
永遠都別回來!!!

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Oy........
I thought today I might be able to see my friends after finishing up my work.....
Looks like a long night again.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
喂........
我還以為今天做完工作就能見見朋友了.....
看來又得熬個長夜了。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Since it's not a big fix, I'm sure I can take care of this somehow.
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
既然不是大修，我想我肯定能想辦法搞定。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
{0} Well, you should get going to Eclage.
You just need to follow this path to the northern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
{0} 好了，你應該去埃克拉珠了。
你只需要沿著這條路走到城市的北部。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
You'll find the main plaza as soon as you enter Eclage, and I'm sure you'll have easy time getting information from all the people there.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
一進埃克拉珠你就會看到主廣場，我相信你在那裡很容易就能從人們那裡得到資訊。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
And on your way, do you mind letting my friend Glasses that I won't make it today?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
另外，在去的路上，你介意幫我告訴我的朋友眼鏡，我今天去不了了？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
But where are the materials.
I need to start repairing soon...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
但是材料在哪裡呢。
我得趕緊開始修理了...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
I really ask you this favor because I'm supposed to meet with my friends to discuss a birthday coming up, but I can't just keep them waiting.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
我真的很想請你幫這個忙，因為我本來要和朋友們見面討論即將到來的生日，但我不能一直讓他們等著。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
I wanna see my friends real soon.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 豐]
我真想快點見到我的朋友們。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
They say that life is nature's greatest invention and death is just a scheme to obtain more life.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
人們常說，生命是大自然最偉大的發明，而死亡只是為了獲取更多生命的手段。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Alright, you may now deliver this to Fon. Also, while I know that it is difficult in these busy times, would you also tell him that I said, 'please take more precious care of them?'
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
好了，現在你可以把這個交給豐了。另外，雖然我知道現在大家都很忙，但能否請你轉告他，我說：“請更加珍重它們？”

scripts.text:
[Golie]
To grow Elder Willow trees,
since Spring, Peco Peco
must have cried as such.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
為了培育長老樹精，
自春天起，大嘴鳥
想必就是這樣啼哭過的。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
You lost the materials?
I will give you another since you are busy, but please take care.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
你把材料弄丟了？
既然你很忙，我就再給你一份，但請務必小心保管。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
However, how about these sprouts that were born by magic- do they have life or not?
Would a bridge born by magic be considered dead or not?
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
不過，那些由魔法誕生的幼苗——它們算是有生命還是沒有生命呢？
由魔法誕生的橋梁，算是死的還是活的呢？

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Because I spend so much time nurturing a bridge from a seed, it hurts me to see so many getting broken and replaced.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
因為我花費了大量時間從種子開始培育橋梁，看到它們頻繁損壞並被替換，讓我很心痛。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Would this be how the times are changing...? That must be why I am creating these objects of tragic destinies.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
難道這就是時代變遷的方式嗎...？這大概就是我創造出這些命運悲慘之物的原因吧。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
This seed is named [Goliath] after my name, and it's a plant used as a bridge for its strange ability to grow into two stems and one leaf.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
這顆種子以我的名字命名為[戈利亞斯]，它是一種用作橋梁的植物，擁有能長出兩根莖和一片葉子的奇特能力。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Thanks to Goliath, the dire need for bridges has been resolved, but I cannot shake the concern that one day, there are going to be fearsome consequences for utilizing magic to ignore the rules of nature.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
多虧了戈利亞斯，對橋梁的迫切需求得到了解決，但我無法擺脫一種擔憂：總有一天，利用魔法無視自然法則會帶來可怕的後果。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
I am recently finding encouragement bit by bit as I work with the great Fili who stands next to me here, but one day, I assure you that all of this will be fixed.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
最近，隨著我與站在我身旁偉大的菲利一起工作，我逐漸找到了一些鼓勵，但我向你保證，總有一天這一切都會得到修正。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Whenever you are disheartened and discouraged, try approaching Fili with your concerns. You will probably find new insights. 
And... Mm... the bridge was done while we were just jibber-jabbering.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
當你感到沮喪和灰心時，試著帶著你的煩惱去找菲利。你或許會發現新的見解。
而且...嗯...我們閒聊的這段時間，橋已經修好了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Alright, you may now deliver this to Fon. Also, while I know that it is difficult in these busy times, would you also tell him that I said, 'please take more precious care of them?'
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
好了，現在你可以把這個交給豐了。另外，雖然我知道現在大家都很忙，但能否請你轉告他，我說：“請更加珍重它們？”

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Surely, I am busy nowadays helping with Fili's work but it also seems that the bridges are breaking too often.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
當然，我現在正忙著協助菲利的工作，但看起來橋梁損壞的頻率也太高了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Surely, I am busy nowadays helping with Fili's work but it also seems that the bridges are breaking too often.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
當然，我現在正忙著協助菲利的工作，但看起來橋梁損壞的頻率也太高了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
To grow Elder Willow trees
the alarm in the clock tower
again must have cried as such.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
為了培育長老樹精，
鐘樓的鐘怪
想必又是這樣啼哭過的。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
It's a song given to me by a bard from Midgard. The lyrical and nature-oriented words really resonated with me.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
這是一首米德加爾特的一位詩人送給我的歌。那些富有韻律且貼近自然的歌詞，真的讓我產生了共鳴。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
I would love to hear any songs that you might know also.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
如果你知道什麼歌曲，我也很樂意聽聽。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hm......
The guys are late.
I can only imagine that they would be busy just looking at the number of people visiting Eclage nowadays but...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯......
那幾個人遲到了。
我只能想像，光是看看如今埃克拉珠的訪客數量，他們就會忙得不可開交，但是...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm...
The guys are late.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...
那幾個人遲到了。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I can't leave this place since others might arrive, so if you see a fairy with a yellow, tangerine-stem-like head, please tell him Glaces is looking for him.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
好吧，我不能離開這裡，因為可能還會有其他人到來。如果你看到一個頭部像黃色橘子梗一樣的妖精，請告訴他格拉西斯在找他。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Oh...
Moreng's age?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哦...
莫倫的年齡？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
How dare you ask a lady's age!!!
We aren't exactly the same age, but since Murah is also 30 years apart from Moreng, ask Murah.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
你怎麼敢問女士的年齡！！！
我們年齡雖然不完全一樣，但穆拉和莫倫也相差30歲，你去問穆拉吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Mm.. Something's missing... Mm, I couldn't tell you exactly...
You should go see Yube.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...好像少了點什麼...嗯，我說不太清楚...
你應該去找尤貝。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Whoa!
We would need an enormous cake to fit all these candles...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哇！
要插這麼多蠟燭，我們需要一個巨大的蛋糕...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Who are those guys? They even took Yube with them?!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
那些人是誰？他們竟然把尤貝也帶走了？！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
I wonder what's better, cream or chocolate...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
我在想，奶油和巧克力哪個更好吃...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
I wonder what's better, cream or chocolate?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
我在想，奶油和巧克力哪個更好吃？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
If he really seems like he might leave soon, we should grab him before he leaves and at least throw him a farewell party.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
如果他看起來真的快要離開了，我們應該在他走之前抓住他，至少給他辦個歡送會。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
It's going to feel really empty if Moreng leaves for Midgard.
It felt like this when Yube was dispatched to the Splendide unit before...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
如果莫倫要去米德加爾特，這裡會感覺很空蕩的。
之前尤貝被派往輝煌領域時，也是這種感覺...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Shul lives in the eastern part of the city.
I'm guessing he's near his place?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
舒爾住在城市的東部。
我猜他應該就在那附近？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Tato is in the western part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
塔托在城市的西部。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
A king lives in Eclage.
He is super good looking.
Hehe
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
國王住在埃克拉珠。
他超級帥。
嘿嘿

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
To think of it, I should probably visit Fon and Golie as well...
I guess I'll visit later.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
想想看，我也應該去拜訪一下豐和戈利...
我想我稍後再去。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Why... why do I have so much time at hand...?
Am I the only one with so much free time?
Am I really the only one?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
為什麼...為什麼我手頭有這麼多空閒時間...？
只有我一個人這麼閒嗎？
真的只有我一個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
照顧什麼？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Yes?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
是的？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Ah...
Oh...Well...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
啊...
哦...好吧...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Um... This is sort of awkward for me...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...這讓我有點尷尬...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, that's not what I mean...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我不是那個意思...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm...
You see, I have a boyfriend already.
Man.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...
你看，我已經有男朋友了。
真是的。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
This is why I don't like to be kept waiting for long. My popularity just doesn't let me go anywhere without being noticed.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
這就是為什麼我不喜歡讓人等太久。我的受歡迎程度讓我走到哪裡都會被注意到。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I mean... Mr. Fon told me to let you know that he won't be able to make it because of his work...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我的意思是... 方先生讓我轉告你，他因為工作原因無法到場...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Oh, I see.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哦，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Yeah, I feel like I should hide somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
是啊，我覺得我應該找個地方躲起來。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Anyways, Fon can't make it?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
總之，方來不了了？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Moreng's birthday is not long from now, and without being able to meet all this time, it might turn out to be a terrible party.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
莫倫的生日快到了，如果我們這段時間一直見不到面，派對可能會變得很糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Yube even flew here from Splendide for Moreng's birthday...
Speaking of which, where did that guy go?!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
尤貝甚至從輝煌領域飛過來參加莫倫的生日派對...
話說回來，那個傢伙去哪了？！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
He was the one who suggested that we should meet at his own place.
The least he could do is opening the door before disappearing!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
是他提議我們在他的地方見面的。
他至少應該在消失之前把門開啟吧！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I can't leave this place since others might arrive, so if you see a fairy with a yellow, tangerine-stem-like head, please tell him Glaces is looking for him.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
好吧，我不能離開這裡，因為可能還會有其他人到來。如果你看到一個頭部像黃色橘子梗一樣的妖精，請告訴他格拉西斯在找他。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
And also please tell him that if he doesn't get back right away, I will pluck off that stem.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
還有，請告訴他，如果他再不回來，我就拔掉那根莖。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Great!!!
That
favor!
I will take care of it!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
太好了！！！
這個
忙！
包在我身上！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Hey! I told you not to interfere in other people's conversations!
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
嘿！我說過不要插嘴別人的對話！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What are you talking about?
It's the job of a warrior to go wherever help is needed!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
你在說什麼？
戰士的職責就是去任何需要幫助的地方！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
And you!
There must be some kind of destiny here running into you over and over again!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
還有你！
我們總是反覆相遇，這裡一定有什麼命運在牽引！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Okay!
I made up my mind!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
好了！
我決定了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
I don't usually recognize others like this, but I'll let you be my rival!
And as for the competition-!!
It is to help this girl fairy Graces!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
我通常不會這樣認可別人，但我允許你成為我的對手！
至於比賽的內容——！！
就是幫助這位女孩妖精格拉西斯！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Who are you calling a girl? You got my name wrong too!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
誰是你叫的女孩？你連我的名字都叫錯了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Heh heh, don't you worry, baby girl.
I'll take care of you!!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
嘿嘿，別擔心，小妹妹。
我會照顧你的！！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Well!
I'm off to find that tangerine stem!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
好了！
我去找那根橘子莖！！！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
And also please tell him that if he doesn't get back right away, I will pluck off that stem.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
還有，請告訴他，如果他再不回來，我就拔掉那根莖。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm... I think we are apart by about 30 years...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯... 我覺得我們之間大概差了30歲...

scripts.text: Then what's Glaces' age?
scripts.translation: 那麼格拉西斯幾歲了？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
How dare you ask a lady's age!!!
We aren't exactly the same age, but since Murah is also 30 years apart from Moreng, ask Murah.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
你怎麼敢問女士的年齡！！！
我們年齡雖然不完全一樣，但穆拉和莫倫也相差30歲，你去問穆拉吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Murah is probably at the Eclage plaza.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
穆拉大概在埃克拉珠廣場。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Murah is probably at the Eclage plaza.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
穆拉大概在埃克拉珠廣場。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm... Since everyone seems so busy, I'm going to give up meeting them today and just go to bake a cake big enough to fit the candles.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯... 既然大家都這麼忙，我今天就不去見他們了，還是去烤一個能插下蠟燭的大蛋糕吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Moreng's house is down this road, so please ask him if he wants anything for his birthday.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
莫倫的家就在這條路上，請順便問問他生日想要什麼。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Baby girl!
I brought the guy named Yube!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
小丫頭！
我把那個叫尤貝的傢伙帶來了！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
What, who is this fool?
Let me go!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
喂，這笨蛋是誰？
放開我！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Do you mind not treating my friend like a piece of luggage?
And it's too late anyways!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
你能不能別把我朋友當行李一樣對待？
而且現在也來不及了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What?!
But there are two of them!
I have the disadvantage!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
什麼？！
可是他們有兩個！
我處於劣勢啊！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
There are four of us.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
我們有四個。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What do you mean?
We had that kid following us ever since we entered the city.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
你什麼意思？
我們從進城開始就有那個小孩跟著我們了。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Sure, he's kind of cute too, but we have our cutest Maggi to beat them all!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
沒錯，他確實挺可愛的，但我們有著最可愛的瑪姬，足以勝過他們所有人！！！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
...
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
...

scripts.text:
[???]
Can you see me?
scripts.translation:
[???]
你能看見我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What are you saying?
Your clothes stick out like a sore thumb.
Where are you from really?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
你在說什麼？
你的衣服太顯眼了，簡直像個大拇指一樣突出。
你到底是哪裡人？

scripts.text:
[???]
Ey~~
I thought you weren't able to see me but I guess not?
scripts.translation:
[???]
哎呀~~
我還以為你們看不見我，看來不是這樣？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
How could I not see you?
Unless you were cloaking yourself like our Alp here!
Maybe it's because he is a Guillotine Cross, but he just seems so transparent even without using any skills.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
我怎麼可能看不見你？
除非你像我們的阿爾普·奧卡特那樣使用了偽裝！
也許是因為他是十字斬首者，但他即使不用技能，看起來也透明得像個幽靈。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Maybe it's because he doesn't have much presence to begin with.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
也許是因為他本來存在感就低吧。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Now that I think about it, I think I saw you somewhere...
Where was it?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
這麼一想，我覺得我在哪裡見過你...
是在哪裡呢？

scripts.text:
[???]
Eh...
It's been awhile since I had such a vivid dream...
scripts.translation:
[???]
呃...
好久沒有做過這麼清晰的夢了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wahahahahah!
A dream!
Hey Mark, this guy thinks it's a dream!
How adorable!
Can we take him around?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
是夢啊！
嘿，馬克，這傢伙以為自己在做夢呢！
好可愛啊！
我們可以帶他到處逛逛嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
What are you saying?!
Don't touch whoever you want like that!
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
你在說什麼啊？！
別想隨便對誰動手動腳！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Eeek~ I don't like this.
Besides, I'm not a kid or a child!
I have a great name called Oliver!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
哎呀~我不喜歡這樣。
而且，我不是小孩也不是孩子！
我有一個很棒的名字，叫奧利弗！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
I have been rejected straight up.
To put him next to our Maggi would be just downright adorable.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
居然被直接拒絕了。
把他放在我們的瑪姬旁邊，那畫面簡直太可愛了。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm.
Wait, but don't you have something to give me?
You did earlier.
Where did it go?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯。
等等，你們不是有什麼東西要給我嗎？
剛才還給我的。
去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Now that I am rejected!
Off to find Moreng!
I won't lose this time for sure!
Let us begin!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
既然被拒絕了！
那就去找莫倫吧！
這次我絕對不會輸的！
讓我們開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Who are those guys?They even took Yube with them!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
那些人是誰？他們竟然連尤貝也帶走了！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I'm sure Yube will take care of himself.
Anyways...
Moreng's house is down this road, so please ask him if he wants anything for his birthday.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...我相信尤貝能照顧好自己。
總之...
莫倫的家就在這條路上，請幫他問問生日想要什麼禮物。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well... I'm sure Yube will take care of himself.
Anyways...
Moreng's house is down this road, so please ask him if he wants anything for his birthday.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...我相信尤貝能照顧好自己。
總之...
莫倫的家就在這條路上，請幫他問問生日想要什麼禮物。

scripts.text: - She seems really busy making the cake. Let's not bother her. -
scripts.translation: - 她似乎正忙著做蛋糕。別去打擾她。 -

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Oh you're back.
Did you ask Moreng what he wants?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哦，你回來了。
你問莫倫想要什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Huh!!!
The legend of the great bird?!
It's been close to a hundred years since I've known Moreng, and he's never talked about it before!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
什麼？！
大鳥的傳說？！
我和莫倫認識快一百年了，他以前從來沒提過這個！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
If he really seems like he might leave soon, we should grab him before he leaves and at least throw him a farewell party.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
如果他看起來真的快要離開了，我們應該在他走之前抓住他，至少給他辦個歡送會。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
So sudden...
I'm going to try to talk with Moreng, so would you ask Yube for me?
He went inside to look for something, so I'm sure he's still inside.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
太突然了...
我要去和莫倫談談，你能幫我問問尤貝嗎？
他進去找東西了，應該還在裡面。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
So sudden...
I'm going to try to talk with Moreng, so would you ask Yube for me?
He went inside to look for something, so I'm sure he's still inside.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
太突然了...
我要去和莫倫談談，你能幫我問問尤貝嗎？
他進去找東西了，應該還在裡面。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I should first decide on what present to get him!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯，我得先決定送他什麼禮物！

scripts.text:
- Shuffle shuffle -
He's working on something.
Let's not bother him.
scripts.translation:
- 沙沙沙沙 -
他正在忙什麼。
別去打擾他。

scripts.text: - Shuffle shuffle -
scripts.translation: - 沙沙沙沙 -

scripts.text: - It looks like the fairy that Glaces was talking about. -
scripts.translation: - 看起來像是格拉西斯說的那個妖精。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Whoa!
Who are you?!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
哇！
你是誰？！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Whoa! Who's this? It's
{0}?
You seem more like a Warlock now!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
哇！這是誰？是
{0}？
你現在看起來更像個大魔導士了！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I'm glad to see you at a place like this.
What's going on anyways?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
很高興能在這裡見到你。
說起來，現在是什麼情況？

scripts.text: Share Glaces' story.
scripts.translation: 分享格拉西斯的故事

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I told her I'll be looking for materials to make candles with, but as expected, she wasn't listening.
She always loses her mind looking at herself through a mirror.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
我跟她說我要去找做蠟燭的材料，但不出所料，她根本沒在聽。
她總是對著鏡子看自己，然後就神志不清了。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
In any case, how old is Moreng now?
I think he was younger than me, but I'm not remembering it very well...
Would you mind asking Glaces about his age for me?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
話說回來，莫倫現在多大了？
我記得他比我小，但具體記不太清了...
你介意幫我問問格拉西斯他的年齡嗎？

scripts.text:
- Stop here !! -
- You have too many items -
- in your inventory right now. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 請在這裡停下 !! -
- 你現在的物品欄 -
- 已經裝不下更多物品了。 -
- 請減輕負重 -
- 然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Oh!
You gathered enough already?
I also made enough wicks just in time!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
哦！
你已經收集夠了嗎？
我也剛好做好了足夠的燭芯！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I mold the dust clumb like this and place the wick like this!
Voilà!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
我把灰塵團捏成這樣的形狀，然後像這樣插上燭芯！
瞧！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
They're all made!
Please take them to Glaces.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
全都做好了！
請把它們帶給格拉西斯。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
And also...
To return the favor, I'll let you use my house!
You can stay over whenever you want as long as you are in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
還有...
為了報答你，我把我的房子借給你用！
只要你在埃克拉珠，隨時都可以來住。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I work at Splendide for the most part anyways, so I don't come to Eclage very often.
Alright, thanks a lot~
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
反正我大部分時間都在輝煌領域工作，很少來埃克拉珠。
好了，非常感謝~

scripts.text:
[Yube]
If you aren't too busy, could you bring me a clump of dust to make some candles with?
I have to make as many candles as Moreng's age, so if you could bring me that much clump of dust, that would be good.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
如果你不忙的話，能幫我帶一團灰塵來做蠟燭嗎？
我必須做出和莫倫年齡數量相同的蠟燭，所以如果你能帶夠那麼多灰塵團來，那就太好了。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Huh?!
So no one knows how old Moreng is?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
誒？！
所以沒人知道莫倫多大嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I mold the dust clumb like this and place the wick like this!
Voilà!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
我把灰塵團捏成這樣的形狀，然後像這樣插上燭芯！
瞧！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Wha.. You lost the candles?
I still have some wicks left, so if you bring me the clump of dust again, I'll remake them for ya.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
什...你把蠟燭弄丟了？
我還剩一些燭芯，如果你再帶灰塵團來，我就重新給你做。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
In any case, how old is Moreng now?
I think he was younger than me, but I'm not remembering it very well...
Would you mind asking Glaces about his age for me?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
話說回來，莫倫現在多大了？
我記得他比我小，但具體記不太清了...
你介意幫我問問格拉西斯他的年齡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Murah? Murah is at the Eclage plaza.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
穆拉？穆拉在埃克拉珠廣場。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Shul? Shul is probably at the eastern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
舒爾？舒爾大概在城市東邊。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Tato? Tato is in the western part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
塔托？塔托在城市西邊。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Have you ever been to Jotunheim?
There are amazing giants that live there!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
你去過約頓海姆嗎？
那裡住著很棒的巨人！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm, at least to summarize what everyone has said...
He's younger than me; 30 years age gap wtih both Glaces and Murah but Glaces and Murah are not the same age,
Shul's age is to add Moreng's age to my age of 100 years before; Shul is 2 years older than Glaces; the average age of me and Shul is Tato and Tato's age is 146, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
嗯，至少總結一下大家說的話...
他比我小；他和格拉西斯、穆拉都有30歲的年齡差，但格拉西斯和穆拉年齡不同，
舒爾的年齡是我100歲之前的年齡加上莫倫的年齡；舒爾比格拉西斯大2歲；我和舒爾的平均年齡是塔托，而塔托是146歲，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
...
Then how old is he?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
...
那他到底多大了？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Yes!
That's right!
Now I remember!!!
I think that's what it was!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
對！
沒錯！
我想起來了！！！
我想應該是這樣！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm~ I don't think so.
Think harder.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
嗯~我覺得不是。
再好好想想。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm that means I still have to make more than a hundred candles...
Oy......
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
嗯，看來我還得做一百多支蠟燭...
哎呀......

scripts.text:
[Yube]
If you aren't too busy, could you bring me a clump of dust to make some candles with?
I have to make as many candles as Moreng's age, so if you could bring me that much clump of dust, that would be good.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
如果你不忙的話，能幫我帶一團灰塵來做蠟燭嗎？
我必須做出和莫倫年齡數量相同的蠟燭，所以如果你能帶夠那麼多灰塵團來，那就太好了。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
They're all made!
Please take them to Glaces.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
全都做好了！
請把它們帶給格拉西斯。

scripts.text: Make the candles.
scripts.translation: 製作蠟燭

scripts.text: Don't make the candles.
scripts.translation: 不製作蠟燭

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Really?
If you need more, just let me know~
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
真的嗎？
如果你還需要更多，儘管告訴我~

scripts.text:
- The weight is just too much that -
- you cannot receive the item. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 負重太重了 -
- 無法接收物品。 -
- 請減輕負重 -
- 然後重試。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I can make as many as 128. How many do you need?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
我最多可以做128支。你需要多少？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I mold the dust clumb like this and place the wick like this!
Voilà!
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
我把灰塵團捏成這樣的形狀，然後像這樣插上燭芯！
瞧！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
You aren't going to make them?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
你不打算做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Mmm...
To make that much, I would probably need more clumps of dust...
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
嗯...
要做這麼多，我可能需要更多的灰塵團...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
They're all made!
Please take them to Glaces.
Don't lose them again~~~
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
都做好了！
請把它們交給格拉西斯。
別再弄丟了~~~

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Moreng's age?
I don't know it exactly...
Maybe Shul might know?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
莫倫的年齡？
我不太清楚...
也許舒爾知道？

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Shul's house is at the east end of the city, so he should be around there.
In any case, isn't it crazy how they were friends even before I was born?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
舒爾住在城東邊，所以他應該在那附近。
話說回來，他們在我出生前就是朋友了，這也太不可思議了吧？

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Hmm... What amazing present should I give?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
嗯...我該送什麼特別的禮物呢？

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Moreng, Yube, and Shul got to know each other a hundred years ago, and I remember that at that time, their age difference was pretty large that adding Moreng's and Yube's age equaled to that of Shul.
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
嗯...莫倫、尤貝和舒爾是一百年前認識的，我記得那時候，他們的年齡差很大，莫倫和尤貝的年齡加起來等於舒爾的年齡。

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Shul's house is at the east end of the city, so he should be around there.
In any case, isn't it crazy how they were friends even before I was born?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
舒爾住在城東邊，所以他應該在那附近。
話說回來，他們在我出生前就是朋友了，這也太不可思議了吧？

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Moreng's age?
Hmm...
It's been awhile since I kept track of everyone's age.
I just remember that Glaces was two years younger than me.
scripts.translation:
[舒爾]
莫倫的年齡？
嗯...
我已經很久沒記大家的年齡了。
我只記得格拉西斯比我小兩歲。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Tato lives in the western part of the town, so try asking him there.
scripts.translation:
[舒爾]
塔托住在城鎮西邊，去那裡問問他吧。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Laphine's put their lives on the line to make Yai beautiful.
I'm a Laphine myself but that kind of priority is difficult to understand.
scripts.translation:
[舒爾]
拉芬族為了美化雅伊，不惜付出生命的代價。
我自己也是拉芬族，但很難理解這種優先順序。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Come to think of it, not too long ago, Tato said that his age was the same as the average between my age and Yube's age.
Maybe Tato would remember it?
scripts.translation:
[舒爾]
說起來，不久前塔托說他的年齡等於我和尤貝年齡的平均值。
也許塔托會記得？

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Tato lives in the western part of the town, so try asking him there.
scripts.translation:
[舒爾]
塔托住在城鎮西邊，去那裡問問他吧。

scripts.text:
[Tato]
Moreng's age?
It hasn't been very long since I got to know him, so I don't know his age very well.
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
莫倫的年齡？
我認識他沒多久，所以不太清楚他的年齡。

scripts.text:
[Tato]
But why is it that they don't know their own age either?!
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
但為什麼他們連自己的年齡都不知道呢？！

scripts.text: What's Tato's age?
scripts.translation: 塔托的年齡是多少？

scripts.text:
[Tato]
I am 146 years old.
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
我今年146歲。

scripts.text: - Although the exact information regarding Moreng's age is still unknown, let's return to Yube first.
scripts.translation: - 雖然莫倫的確切年齡仍然未知，但讓我們先回到尤貝那裡吧。

scripts.text: - Although the exact information regarding Moreng's age is still unknown, let's return to Yube first.
scripts.translation: - 雖然莫倫的確切年齡仍然未知，但讓我們先回到尤貝那裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Tato]
A friend of mine recently applied to the Splendide unit.
I heard Jotunheim is really cold. I hope he's doing well.
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
我的一個朋友最近申請加入了輝煌領域部隊。
聽說約頓海姆非常寒冷，希望他一切都好。

scripts.text:
Eclage is a really nice place to live
The flowers are always in full bloom and the weather is always comfortable.
scripts.translation:
埃克拉珠真是個適合居住的地方。
花兒總是盛開，天氣也總是舒適宜人。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
If there were a beautiful Yai of my own, it would truly be a paradise!
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
如果我也有一個美麗的雅伊，那這裡簡直就是天堂！

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Yai actually signifies an egg.
And to Laphines, Yai could even signify what is beyond a home...
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
雅伊實際上象徵著蛋。
對於拉芬族來說，雅伊甚至象徵著超越家園的存在...

scripts.text:
Eclage is a really nice place to live
The flowers are always in full bloom and the weather is always comfortable.
scripts.translation:
埃克拉珠真是個適合居住的地方。
花兒總是盛開，天氣也總是舒適宜人。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
If there were a beautiful Yai of my own, it would truly be a paradise!
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
如果我也有一個美麗的雅伊，那這裡簡直就是天堂！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Oh, so you call those round houses a Yai.
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
原來你們把那些圓形的房子稱為雅伊啊。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Yai actually signifies an egg.
And to Laphines, Yai could even signify what is beyond a home...
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
雅伊實際上象徵著蛋。
對於拉芬族來說，雅伊甚至象徵著超越家園的存在...

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
While I spent time and effort as much as putting my life into it, my Yai is nothing more than a fake.
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
我傾注了心血，甚至不惜付出生命，但我的雅伊不過是個贗品。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
It's called an egg and looks like an egg, but it's really not an egg!
It's just something else that just looks like an egg!
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
它叫蛋，看起來也像蛋，但它真的不是蛋！
它只是某種看起來像蛋的東西！

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Hey, wait a minute!
Are you possibly from Midgard?!
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
嘿，等一下！
你難道是來自米德加爾特嗎？！

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我是。

scripts.text: No, I am not.
scripts.translation: 不，我不是。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
I see...
You sure looked like it, but I guess not.
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
原來如此...
你看起來確實很像，但看來不是。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Ah, great!
Then would you happen to know anything about the legend that speaks of a great bird which lives in Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
啊，太好了！
那你是否聽說過關於米德加爾特有一隻巨鳥的傳說？

scripts.text:
I heard a little from various travelers.
According to rumors, there is a legend of a great bird in Midgard that lays an egg as big as a house.
scripts.translation:
我從各種旅行者那裡聽到了一些訊息。
據傳聞，米德加爾特有一隻巨鳥，它下的蛋有房子那麼大。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wow, if it's an egg as big as a house, how many days would it take to eat it all?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
哇，如果蛋有房子那麼大，吃完它得花多少天啊？

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
......

[Moreng]
When I first heard of that legend, I was so excited that I couldn't sleep for days.
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
當我第一次聽到那個傳說時，我興奮得幾天都睡不著覺。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
But as time went by, and as I aged more, I gradually forgot about it.
Isn't that how all childhood dreams are like?
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
但隨著時間流逝，我漸漸長大了，也慢慢忘記了它。
所有童年的夢想不都是這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
But not too long ago when I went to the plaza, I met my old neighbor who told me about a traveler from Midgard holding an incredibly enormous feather...
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
但不久前，當我去廣場時，遇到了我的老鄰居，他告訴我有一位來自米德加爾特的旅行者拿著一根巨大的羽毛...

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Ever since I heard about it, I can't seem to put my mind on anything else.
Could that legend possibly be true?
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
自從聽到這件事後，我就無法專心做其他事情了。
那個傳說難道是真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Truthfully, when I heard that story, I went searching all over the town but couldn't find anyone with a huge feather.
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
說實話，聽到那個故事後，我跑遍了整個城鎮，卻沒能找到任何拿著巨大羽毛的人。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Do you think that old man's story is real? Or do you think it's a lie?
I used to think of it as a forgotten legend, but now I am even afraid to find out whether it is real or fake.
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
你覺得那個老人的故事是真的嗎？還是說那是謊言？
我以前一直把它當作一個被遺忘的傳說，但現在我甚至害怕去證實它到底是真是假。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
If you are a real man, don't be so meek!
Face it head on! And if you must, you can crash and burn afterwards!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
如果你是個真正的男人，就別這麼畏畏縮縮！
正面面對它！就算最後失敗也沒關係！

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Don't crash and burn anything...
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
別失敗什麼的...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
For something like that-!
I'll be the one to ask the old man and let you know!
And if the legend sounds fake, I won't tell you so don't you worry!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
這種事-
我會親自去問那個老人，然後告訴你！
如果那個傳說聽起來像是假的，我就不會告訴你，所以你別擔心！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Sometimes you should really remind yourself what it means to say 'ignorance is bliss.'
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
有時候你真的應該提醒自己，'無知是福'這句話的含義。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Regardless, I didn't hear anything about that legend either.
Although, for a typical Laphine, something that's insignificant to us could be considered really huge...
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
不管怎樣，我也沒聽說過那個傳說。
不過，對於普通的拉芬人來說，對我們來說微不足道的事情，可能對他們來說真的很大...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
But since the land of Midgard is truly far and wide, there may be legends we haven't heard of...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
但是既然米德加爾特的土地如此廣闊，也許確實有一些我們沒聽說過的傳說...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Yes, it looks like there are no other ways than to meet the old man!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
是的，看來除了去見那個老人，沒有其他辦法了！

scripts.text:
Do you think that old man's story is real? Or do you think it's a lie?
I used to think of it as a forgotten legend, but now I am even afraid to find out whether it is real or fake.
scripts.translation:
你覺得那個老人的故事是真的嗎？還是說那是謊言？
我以前一直把它當作一個被遺忘的傳說，但現在我甚至害怕去證實它到底是真是假。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Yes, it looks like there are no other ways than to meet the old man!
Let's go to the plaza!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
是的，看來除了去見那個老人，沒有其他辦法了！
我們去廣場吧！

scripts.text:
Do you think that old man's story is real? Or do you think it's a lie?
I used to think of it as a forgotten legend, but now I am even afraid to find out whether it is real or fake.
scripts.translation:
你覺得那個老人的故事是真的嗎？還是說那是謊言？
我以前一直把它當作一個被遺忘的傳說，但現在我甚至害怕去證實它到底是真是假。

scripts.text:
Is that for real?
I can't believe the legend was true...
scripts.translation:
那是真的嗎？
我簡直不敢相信那個傳說是真的...

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
What can I say?
I feel like I can't just stay here anymore.
I have to quickly pack my bags and leave for Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
我能說什麼呢？
我覺得我不能一直留在這裡了。
我必須趕緊收拾行李，前往米德加爾特！

scripts.text: - Moreng seems like he's really about to leave soon. I should let Glaces know. -
scripts.translation: - 莫倫看起來真的快要離開了。我應該告訴格拉西斯。 -

scripts.text: I plan to leave for Midgard as soon as my birthday-farewell party with my friends is over.
scripts.translation: 我打算在和朋友們一起過完生日告別派對後，就立刻前往米德加爾特。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
I would miss my friends for sure, but I should return that much quicker.
scripts.translation:
[莫倫]
我肯定會想念我的朋友們，但我應該能更快回來。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hohoho
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Ooo~ So you changed your mind?
Ok then, I will tell you about the story that Light Standard told only me, about which he met a gold monster in the deep Midgard mountains that eats gems!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦~ 你改變主意了？
好吧，那我就告訴你那個光之標準只告訴過我的故事，關於他在米德加爾特深山深處遇到一隻吃寶石的金色魔物的事！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hohoho~!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵~！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Looks like there are a lot of interesting visitors nowadays...
When I was young, you had to put your life on the line to go into the foreign lands.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
看來現在有很多有趣的訪客...
在我年輕的時候，去外國可是要拿命去拼的。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Nowadays, things are way more convenient with de-regulation and all.
And with the warps and flying to all these places, where's all the romance in adventures anymore?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
如今隨著管制放寬，一切都方便多了。
還有傳送和飛行，想去哪就去哪，冒險還有什麼浪漫可言呢？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Young people nowadays probably don't even know how frog eggs taste like.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
現在的年輕人，大概連蛙卵是什麼味道都不知道吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
It seems like yesterday when I saved enough Jellopies to buy a Tsurugi, but even that Tsurugi is deserted somewhere in the storage.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
感覺昨天才剛攢夠Jellopie買了一把日本刀，可那把刀現在還被遺忘在倉庫的某個角落。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Time really is merciless... If I had known this then, I would have...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
時間真是無情... 如果當時我知道這一點，我可能會...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hey! Have you heard of a Laphine hero named Light Standard?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嘿！你聽說過一位名叫光之標準的拉芬英雄嗎？

scripts.text: No, I don't think so.
scripts.translation: 不，我不覺得我懂了。

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我聽過。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huhuhu...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huhuhu...
He's a hero from so long ago that this generation wouldn't even know who he is.
He is probably long forgotten...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵...
他是一位很久以前的英雄，這一代人甚至不知道他是誰。
他大概早已被人遺忘了...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huhuhu...
It's surprising how a young person like you would know of him.
I thought he would be long forgotten...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵...
像你這樣的年輕人竟然知道他，真是令人驚訝。
我還以為他早已被人遺忘了...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
With a small physique, he was not even a high-level Laphine, but he fought against and defeated incredible monsters.
The word legend seemed to have been made for him.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他身材矮小，甚至算不上高等級的拉芬，卻能與不可思議的魔物戰鬥並戰勝它們。
“傳說”這個詞似乎就是為他而造的。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
His heroic accounts were so famous that kids would sing of them in the streets.
But as Ragnarok passed and peace was found, he suddenly retired.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他的英勇事蹟非常有名，孩子們會在街上傳唱。但仙境傳說結束後，和平降臨，他突然引退了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
And he was quickly forgotten...
He had great strength, superb intelligence, and strong, wonderful comrades, but he wasn't perfect....
scripts.translation:
[老人]
很快，他就被遺忘了...
他擁有強大的力量、卓越的智慧和強大而出色的同志，但他並不完美....

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Do you know what he was missing?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你知道他缺少什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
It was a 'friend' like me.
If only if he had reliable and big-hearted friends...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他缺少像我這樣的“朋友”。
如果他有可靠且心胸寬廣的朋友就好了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
But old man, would you happen to know anything about a legend regarding the great bird in Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
但是老人，您是否知道關於米德加爾特巨鳥的傳說？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh!
You mean the legend of the great bird of Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦！
你是說米德加爾特巨鳥的傳說？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
For that, there's probably no one who knows it better than I in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
關於這個，埃克拉珠大概沒有人比我更瞭解了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Well, it wasn't too long after Light Standard arrived in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯，那是在光之標準來到米德加爾特後不久。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
He said he traveled in many adventures for a long time before coming to Midgard, but it was his first time seeing such a massive bird.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他說在來到米德加爾特之前，他經歷了許多冒險，但這是他第一次見到如此巨大的鳥。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I also honestly did not believe that there would be such a big bird.
That is, until I ran into a traveler with an immense feather at the town's entrance during my walk.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
說實話，我也不相信會有這麼大的鳥。
直到我在散步時，在城鎮入口遇到了一位旅行者，他帶著一根巨大的羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
As soon as I saw that feather, I began to believe all that Light Standard told me.
For example, a clump of dust that was wearing a cone hat in Jotunheim...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
一看到那根羽毛，我就開始相信光之標準告訴我的所有事情了。
比如，在約頓海姆，有一團戴著圓錐帽的灰塵...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm...
Earlier Moreng said he hasn't seen them in the city yet, so maybe he's still outside?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
嗯...
剛才莫倫說他在城裡還沒看到它們，所以也許它們還在城外？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Let's get to it then!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
那我們趕緊去吧！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huh? But I haven't even begun to talk about a monster he met in Midgard who can break any kind of metal!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什麼？我還沒開始講他在米德加爾特遇到的那個能擊碎任何金屬的魔物呢！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
We will hear about it later~
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
我們之後再聽嘛~

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Um...
Du already ran off...
If we let him be, I wonder what kind of trouble he'll create next.
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
那個...
杜已經跑遠了...
要是放任他不管，不知道他下次又會惹出什麼麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
To get to the city's entrance, we have to get through the bridge that Du broke, but I wonder if it has been fixed.
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
要去到城鎮入口，必須經過杜弄壞的那座橋，不知道修好了沒有。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Looks like there are a lot of interesting visitors nowadays...
When I was young, you had to put your life on the line to go into the foreign lands.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
看來現在有很多有趣的訪客...
在我年輕的時候，去外國可是要拿命去拼的。

scripts.text:
Old Man#ep14_2
Nowadays, things are much more convenient with de-regulation and all.
And with the warps and flying to all these places, where's all the romance in adventures anymore?
scripts.translation:
老人#ep14_2
如今，隨著法規的放寬，一切都方便多了。
再加上傳送和飛行，想去哪裡就去哪裡，冒險還有什麼浪漫可言呢？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Young people nowadays probably don't even know how frog eggs taste like.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
現在的年輕人，大概連蛙卵是什麼味道都不知道吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
It seems like yesterday when I saved enough Jellopies to buy a Tsurugi, but even that Tsurugi is deserted somewhere in storage.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
感覺昨天才剛攢夠Jellopie買了一把日本刀，結果那把刀現在還被遺忘在倉庫的某個角落。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Who are you?
I've never seen you before.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
你們是誰？
我好像沒見過你們。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Hey you guys, you can get into Eclage, right?
There is a cat sack merchant who's doing business in the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
嘿，你們能進埃克拉珠吧？
廣場裡有個貓麻袋商人在做生意。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Oh dear, my money...
I can't believe it was a fake...
Oy oy....
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
哎呀，我的錢...
沒想到竟然是假的...
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Oh, you came to ask me about the feather, too?
It's just a plain old decoration, but everyone really likes to bother me about it.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
哦，你們也是來問那根羽毛的事嗎？
那只是個普通的裝飾品，但大家總是喜歡拿它來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
If you are thinking about selling it, you should just give up.
I have no wishes to sell it no matter how much you beg.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
如果你是想買它，那就死心吧。
不管你們怎麼求我，我都不會賣的。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
This feather.
It's not an ordinary feather.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
這根羽毛。
它可不是一根普通的羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Heh...
Well, it's actually too recent to even brag about...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
呵...
其實事情發生得不久，也沒什麼好炫耀的...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
It's just luck that I ran into it not too long after I arrived in Alfheim.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
只是運氣好，我剛到艾爾海姆不久就遇到了它。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
It was so amazing. When it flapped its colossal wings, I couldn't even gather myself to attack because I was too busy just holding on.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那場面太壯觀了。當它扇動巨大的翅膀時，我忙著抓緊身體，根本來不及發起攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
But I am not one to give up so easily.
If I think about it, it was a very long fight.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
但我可不是輕易放棄的人。
回想起來，那是一場非常漫長的戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
That's weird. The old man earlier said that he saw it in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
這不對勁。剛才那個老人說他在米德加爾特見過它。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Eck!
No... No way.
I definitely saw it at Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
咦？
不...不可能。
我明明是在米德加爾特看到它的。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I didn't want to show you this, but this scar is the proof.
It was truly a life-threatening battle.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我本來不想給你們看的，但這道傷疤就是證據。
那真是一場生死之戰。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Hmm...
For a fight not too long ago, the scar seems very old.
From how the scar looks, it doesn't even seem like it's been treated by magic...
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
嗯...
既然戰鬥結束沒多久，這道傷疤看起來卻非常陳舊。
從傷疤的樣子來看，甚至不像受過魔法治療...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Eeck!!!!
If... If I really think about, it might be awhile back actually.
I can't remember too well having so many memoirs and souvenirs.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
咦！！！！
如...如果仔細想想，那可能確實是很久以前的事了。
因為記憶和紀念品太多，我記不太清了。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
But how did you travel to other places when you can't even enter Eclage?
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
可是你連埃克拉珠都進不去，是怎麼去其他地方的？

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
If it came near here somewhere, there's no way others haven't seen it...
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
如果它曾出現在這裡附近，不可能沒人見過...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Keeeek!!!!
Yes!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
嗚！！！！
是的！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Actually, this isn't my first time here, but I had the opportunity to go to other places during when deregulation was at its peak awhile back.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
其實這不是我第一次來這裡，只是在之前管制最嚴格的時候，我有機會去過其他地方。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Hmm... But this feather...
If I look at it very closely, the shaft is too thick for its size
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
嗯...但這根羽毛...
如果仔細看，它的羽軸相對於大小來說太粗了。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
And doesn't the end of it seem really jagged?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
而且它的末端看起來非常參差不齊？

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Really?!
Wait! Let me see!!!!
Oh my, that's really true!
How dare that cat sell me a fake?!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
真的嗎？！
等等！讓我看看！！！！
天哪，確實是這樣！
那隻貓怎麼敢賣假貨給我？！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Oh.... You bought it, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
哦...你是買來的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
You bought it, right?
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
你是買來的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Hmm... Even so, I guess this is a great piece of work. It really seems like the real thing.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
嗯...即便如此，這也是一件傑作。它看起來真的很像真品。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Hu....
You have no idea how expensive this was!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
呼....
你不知道這東西有多貴！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Hey you guys, you can get into Eclage, right?
There is a cat merchant who's doing business in the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
你們能進埃克拉珠，對吧？
廣場上有個貓商人在做生意。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
That guy just stole my money and...
Hmm...
Please catch the cat before others also lose their money!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那傢伙偷了我的錢...
嗯...
請在別人也損失錢財之前抓住那隻貓！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
At least hold him until I can get into Eclage!
I ask you!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
至少在我能進入埃克拉珠之前先攔住它！
拜託了！
求求你們了！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
That guy just stole my money and...
Hmm...
Please catch the cat before others also lose their money!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那傢伙偷了我的錢...
嗯...
請在別人也損失錢財之前抓住那隻貓！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
At least hold him until I can get into Eclage!
I ask you!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
至少在我能進入埃克拉珠之前先攔住它！
拜託了！
求求你們了！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Oh, you came to ask me about the feather, too?
It's just a plain old decoration, but everyone really likes to bother me about it.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
哦，你們也是來問那根羽毛的事嗎？
那只是個普通的裝飾品，但大家總是喜歡拿它來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
If you are thinking about selling it, you should just give up.
I have no wishes to sell it no matter how much you beg.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
如果你是想買它，那就死心吧。
不管你們怎麼求我，我都不會賣的。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
This feather..
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
這根羽毛...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Meow?
Helloeow~
I have a treasure from a place very, very fareow~
Take a lookeow~
I'll give you a good priceow~
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
喵？
你好喵~
我這裡有來自非常非常遠的地方的寶物喵~
來看看喵~
我會給你一個好價格喵~

scripts.text: Talk about the feather.
scripts.translation: 談論那根羽毛

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
That's not trueow~!
I'm seriouseow~!
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
才不是那樣喵！
我是很認真的喵！

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
That's definitely a precious item from Midgardeow.
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
那絕對是來自米德加德的珍貴寶物喵。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
This end of the feather here is not very convincing...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
這根羽毛的末端看起來不太像真的...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Meoweoweow!!!
I...I can't believe you noticedeow...Pretty sharpeow...
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
喵嗚哇哇哇！！！
我...我沒想到你會注意到喵...觀察力真敏銳喵...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Actually...
The feather is real for sure, but I modified just a tinyyy~tiny biteow...
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
其實...
羽毛本身肯定是真的，但我只是稍微~稍微改了一點點喵...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Because the feather was too big to carry around, I thought that I could cut it up into pieces and sell it to many moreow. But when I cut it, it was a bit weird so I just adjusted it, you seeow.
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
因為羽毛太大不好攜帶，我想把它切成碎片賣給更多人喵。但切的時候發現有點不對勁，所以就稍微調整了一下，你懂的喵。

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
This is just a cut piece?
Then how big was the real thing?
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
這只是切下來的一塊？
那原本有多大？

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Hmm..
It was from here to thereow.
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
嗯...
大概是從這裡到那裡那麼大喵。

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
I couldn't possibly carry something that bigeow...
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
我怎麼可能搬得動那麼大的東西喵...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Whoa whoa!
If it's that big, you could probably make a fried egg with the size of this plaza!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
哇哦！
如果真有那麼大，恐怕能煎出一個比這個廣場還大的荷包蛋吧！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
That's probably too much...
Anyways, that was important to know, so we better let Moreng know.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
那可能有點誇張了...
總之，這很重要，我們最好告訴莫倫。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Anyways, that was important to know, so we better let Moreng know.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
總之，這很重要，我們最好告訴莫倫。

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Meow?
Helloeow~
I have a treasure from a place very, very fareow~
Take a lookeow~
I'll give you a good priceow~
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
喵？
你好喵~
我這裡有來自非常非常遠的地方的寶物喵~
來看看喵~
我會給你一個好價格喵~

scripts.text: - Looks like the door is locked. -
scripts.translation: - 門好像鎖住了。 -

scripts.text: - Something seems a bit different. -
scripts.translation: - 這裡似乎有些不同。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm, the legend of a great bird?
I think there was one, but since I don't believe in myths, I didn't pay much attention.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
嗯，關於一隻大鳥的傳說？
我想是有這麼回事，但我不相信神話，所以沒太在意。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Whew...
Done...
The ones I took last time couldn't be used because of a mistake, and I was scolded so much for that...
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
呼...
終於弄完了...
上次拿來的東西因為出錯沒法用，我被罵得很慘...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Now that I'm done with work that Master wanted, I should get going to help out with the party.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
既然完成了師父交代的工作，我該去幫忙隊伍了。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
How did you get in here?
Uninvited guests are not very welcome, you know?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
你是怎麼進來的？
不請自來的客人，可不太受歡迎哦？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Make yourself at home.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
請自便。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
You didn't tell Glaces?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
你沒告訴格拉西斯嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I guess if you look at Glaces' Yai...
When I first saw the crack, I was reminded of Glace's Yai.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
我想，如果你看看格拉西斯的Yai...
當我第一次看到那道裂縫時，我想起了格拉西斯的Yai。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
In any case, finding the great bird's egg firsthand is probably better than receiving it as a gift, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
總之，親眼找到大鳥的蛋，總比收到它作為禮物要好，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Ok, I should hurry with the party preparations.
I'll send whatever is urgent to Splendide first...
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
好了，我得趕緊準備隊伍的事宜了。
我會先把緊急的東西送到輝煌領域...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
It's always exciting to place seeds in a box...
One mistake can lead to immense consequences.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
把種子放進盒子裡總是令人興奮的...
一個錯誤可能導致巨大的後果。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Please give me a minute since this is a critical process.
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
請給我一分鐘，因為這是一個關鍵的過程。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Ok, if you don't mind, could you take this to a delivery man at the plaza?
Master kindly sent me a delivery man specifically for this...
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
好的，如果不介意的話，你能把這個送到廣場的送貨員那裡嗎？
師父特意給我安排了一個送貨員...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Maybe it's an underlying statement that I would be eliminated if it's not sent right away...
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
也許這是一種暗示，如果我不馬上送出去，我就會被淘汰...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I will be on my way so I'll catch you later~
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
我要出發了，回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Be safe now~
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
注意安全哦~

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm, now what do we do?
Hey Mark, do we have some kind of schedule or whatever?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
嗯，現在我們要做什麼？
嘿，馬克，我們有什麼日程安排之類的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Aren't you even a bit tired after all that?
Let's rest up a bit.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
經歷了這麼多，你一點都不累嗎？
讓我們休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Hmm...
I'm hungry.
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
嗯...
我餓了。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Acorns!
I saw many acorns just outside the city!
I want them!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
橡子！
我剛在城外看到很多橡子！
我想要！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Acorns?!
Are they any good?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
橡子？！
它們好吃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Alright then, shall we get some acorns?
I'll bring a bunch back!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
好吧，那我們去拿些橡子吧？
我會帶一堆回來！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Hey hey hey!
I told you not to pull on my cheeks!!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
嘿，嘿，嘿！
我告訴過你不要拉我的臉頰！！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Seriously, you just don't get tired huh...
Ok, I'm going to rest here with the others, so do what you need to do.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
真是的，你就是不累啊...
好吧，我要在這裡和其他人一起休息，你去忙你的吧。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Greeeeat!
Let's go!{0}!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
太棒了！
我們走！{0}！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I will be on my way so I'll catch you later~
scripts.translation:
[尤貝]
我要出發了，回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Be safe now~
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
注意安全哦~

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm, now what do we do?
Hey Mark, do we have some kind of schedule or whatever?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
嗯，現在我們要做什麼？
嘿，馬克，我們有什麼日程安排之類的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Aren't you even a bit tired after all that?
Let's rest up a bit.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
經歷了這麼多，你一點都不累嗎？
讓我們休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Hmm...
I'm hungry.
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
嗯...
我餓了。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Acorns!
I saw many acorns just outside the city!
I want them!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
橡子！
我剛在城外看到很多橡子！
我想要！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Acorns?!
Are they any good?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
橡子？！
它們好吃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Alright then, shall we get some acorns?
I'll bring a bunch back!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
好吧，那我們去拿些橡子吧？
我會帶一堆回來！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Hey hey hey!
I told you not to pull on my cheeks!!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
嘿，嘿，嘿！
我告訴過你不要拉我的臉頰！！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Seriously, you just don't get tired huh...
Ok, I'm going to rest here with the others, so do what you need to do.
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
真是的，你就是不累啊...
好吧，我要在這裡和其他人一起休息，你去忙你的吧。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Greeeeat!
Let's go!{0}!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
太棒了！
我們走！{0}！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Acorns~~!!!
I thought you said you'll bring a whole bunch of acorns~~
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
橡子~~！！！
你不是說會帶一堆橡子回來嗎~~

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Whoa, what a delicious looking acorn!
Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
哇，這看起來真好吃！
謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Yawnnn... so sleepy...
I'm going to take a nap, so wake me up when we're leaving... Don't leave without me now~
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
哈欠...好睏...
我要去睡一會兒，出發的時候叫醒我...現在別丟下我走哦~

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Let's go!{0}!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
我們走！{0}！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
It's so good!!!
What about you Maggi?
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
太好吃了！！！
瑪姬，你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
It's very good.
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
非常好吃。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Yay!! What a feast!!
I'm full now.
Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
耶！！真是一頓盛宴！！
我吃飽了。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Oliver, eat more.
You have to eat a lot when you're young. That's how you'll grow!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
奧利弗，再吃點。
小孩子要多吃才能長身體！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Yawn...
I'm full...
I'm sleepy...
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
哈欠...
我吃飽了...
好睏...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hey Oliver, don't suddenly be so lazy now...
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
嘿，奧利弗，別突然這麼懶散...

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
But I'm so sleepy.
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
可是我好睏。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
I thought this was all a dream, but I guess it's not seeing how sleepy I am.
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
我以為這全是夢，但看我現在這麼困，應該不是夢吧。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Acorns were so good...
Zzzz....
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
橡子真好吃...
呼嚕嚕....

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
...

[Oliver]
...

[Alp Ocart]
...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
AHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
Is this that item?
I'll mail it safely, so you won't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[送貨員]
是這個物品嗎？
我會安全寄送的，您不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
Sigh...
I need to get going in order to make it on time.
scripts.translation:
[送貨員]
唉...
我得趕緊走了，不然趕不上時間了。

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
The road from Splendide to Eclage used to be dangerous, but nowadays, it's actually better to come all the way to Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[送貨員]
從輝煌領域到埃克拉珠的路以前很危險，但現在直接送到埃克拉珠反而更安全。

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
I don't know why people can't just make small amounts of pickled Poring for themselves instead of mailing them...
scripts.translation:
[送貨員]
我不明白為什麼人們不自己醃一點波利，非要郵寄過來...

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
Wait a minute...
Is it actually better to deliver it later...
I remember seeing so many boxes of pickled Poring in the storage waiting to be delivered...
scripts.translation:
[送貨員]
等一下...
其實晚點送可能更好...
我記得倉庫裡堆了很多箱等著寄送的醃波利...

scripts.text:
- Stop here !! -
- The weight is just too much that -
- you cannot receive the item. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
