- 負重太重了 -
- 無法接收物品。 -
- 請減輕負重 -
- 然後重試。 -

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm... Where did he go...?
Could he be... a ghost?!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
嗯...他去哪了...？
該不會...是幽靈吧？！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
I didn't sense any use of magic or other things of the sort...
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
我沒有感覺到魔法或其他類似的東西...

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Wait! Here's the hood that Oliver was wearing...
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
等等！這是奧利弗戴的兜帽...

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
And... doesn't it feel like this room is different from before?
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
而且...這個房間感覺和之前不一樣？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hey stop that!!
It's scaring me!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
嘿，住手！！
嚇死我了！！！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Arrrrr~~
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
啊啊啊~~

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Oh!!! I just remembered...
Oliver...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
哦！！！我想起來了...
奧利弗...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
...
Oliver Hilpert...
.........is also known as the dreaming novelist...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
...
奧利弗·希爾佩特...
.........也被稱為夢幻小說家...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
And this book...
Why didn't I remember this book when Oliver was around?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
還有這本書...
為什麼奧利弗在的時候，我不記得這本書？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hey...
Did you just take that book out from your bag?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
嘿...
你剛才把書從包裡拿出來的？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Yeah, that's because I'm a fan...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
是的，因為我是他的粉絲...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Why didn't you remember the book when you are such a fan..?
Not only that, do people usually carry books with them when they're fans?? Especially hardcover books?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
既然你是粉絲，為什麼之前不記得這本書？
而且，粉絲通常會隨身帶著書嗎？尤其是精裝書？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
......
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
......

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
You are a little bit weir...
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
你有點怪...

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
More importantly... The title of this book...
is [The City of Fairies]?
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
更重要的是...這本書的書名...
是《精靈之城》？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
And...
It's been many years since this book was published...
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
而且...
這本書出版已經很多年了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
...This is getting kind of scary...?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
...這有點嚇人...

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
......

[Maggi Steen]
......

[Alp Ocart]
......
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
......

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
But this is Volume 1. Does that mean there's more?
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
但這是第一卷。這意味著還有更多？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
It has a total of 3 volumes.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
總共有3卷。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wow, how many are you carrying with you...
Why are you bringing all of them around...
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
哇，你身上背了這麼多...
為什麼要全都帶著到處跑啊...

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Everybody calm down!!!
This has to be some kind of a dream!
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
大家冷靜一點！！！
這一定是某種夢吧！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Why are you hitting me, calling it a dream and all!
It hurts!
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
你幹嘛打我，還說什麼這是夢！
好痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Ahhhh maybe it really isn't a dream after all!!!
scripts.translation:
[馬克·艾沙]
啊啊啊，看來真的不是夢啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
...A...A...Aaaaahhhhhhhhh!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬·斯汀]
...啊...啊...啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Don't cry, Maggi~
scripts.translation:
[杜連]
別哭啦，瑪姬~

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
I wonder...
Why didn't I remember this...?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
我在想...
為什麼我沒有想起這件事...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
I... I should have.. I should have gotten his autograph!!!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾普·奧卡特]
我...我應該...我應該要讓他簽名的！！！

scripts.text:
- Stop Here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- You cannot carry any more items. -
- Lighten your load and -
- try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 停在這裡！！ -
- 您的物品太多了。 -
- 您無法再攜帶任何物品。 -
- 請減輕負重， -
- 然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I haven't seen your face before... You aren't from around here?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我好像沒見過你的臉...你不是這附近的人吧？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
{0} - Hello, what brings you here?
I thought you were busy...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
{0} - 你好，什麼事把你帶到這裡來了？
我還以為你很忙呢...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Have you met my brother yet?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
你見過我哥哥了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh, {0} Have you met my brother yet? How is he doing?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
哦，{0} 你見過我哥哥了嗎？他最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh man, even the people we found are so apathetic... What could I possibly do now...?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
天哪，連我們找到的人都這麼冷漠...我現在還能做什麼呢...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
What happened? Did you find out anything?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
發生什麼事了？你查到什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I'm still in the process of looking through the report. It's very complex, so I'll need more time.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我還在查閱報告。內容非常複雜，我需要更多時間。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Great, you got here at the right time.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
太好了，你來得正是時候。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
{0} Are you going to help me?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
{0} 你願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Did you find that high-level Laphine?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
你找到那隻高等級的拉芬了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Did you bring all the ingredients?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
你把所有材料都帶齊了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Ah... Is there anyone with more experience with this...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
啊...有沒有誰在這方面更有經驗呢...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
The research is still ongoing. If I had a thread of hope, I would hang on it, but I can't seem to find it just yet.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
研究還在進行中。如果有一絲希望，我都會緊緊抓住，但我目前似乎還找不到方向。

scripts.text: [Wuhari]
scripts.translation: [烏哈里]

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
If you are a person who has enough courage and wisdom to go to a foreign land all alone, I'm sure you have a lot of experience as well.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
如果你是一個有足夠勇氣和智慧，能獨自前往異國他鄉的人，我相信你一定擁有很多經驗。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I would like to learn the name of a great adventurer like you, so that I can talk about you elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我想請教一下像您這樣偉大的冒險者的名字，這樣我可以在別處談論您。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is {1}.

[Wuhari]
Wow! The name sure sounds like it has defeated many in the mountains, seas, and skies! It's amazing!
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
哇！這名字聽起來就像是在山川湖海中擊敗過無數敵人一樣！太了不起了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's not much.
I am not really all that great.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒什麼了不起的。
我也沒那麼厲害。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Um... {0} I ask because you look so dependable.
Could I please ask you a favor?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
嗯... {0} 我之所以這麼問，是因為您看起來非常可靠。
可以請您幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text: I'm kind of busy right now...
scripts.translation: 我現在有點忙...

scripts.text: Of course!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Really? Oh well...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
是嗎？好吧...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
抱歉打擾您了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Really?
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
真的嗎？
太感謝您了！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
For me, I have a ^0000cd big brother^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
對我來說，我有一個^0000cd哥哥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
My brother is... not an extremely well-known scholar.
Although his fame lost a bit of flare these recent years because he was stuck at home getting too fond of housework.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我的哥哥...並不是什麼特別著名的學者。
雖然近年來因為他宅在家裡沉迷於家務，名聲稍微有些黯淡了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It's been long since the last time I saw his face because I was all over the place for a while.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
因為我之前四處奔波，已經很久沒見到他的面了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I don't mean to brag, but I am also a distinguished intellectual myself, so I'm sought after by many, haha.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我也不想自誇，但我自己也是一位傑出的知識分子，所以很多人都會來找我，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Anyways, we wrote letters to each other regularly, but with a sudden drop in contact, I hurriedly came to see him to find out that ^0000cdhe was taken to jail^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
總之，我們之前一直有書信往來，但突然就斷了聯絡。我急忙趕去看他，結果發現^0000cd他被關進了監獄^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
They said something about his research but I don't know the details myself. I would like to find out more, but I am not in a situation to make my way there.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
他們說是關於他的研究，但我自己也不清楚具體細節。我想了解更多，但我現在的處境無法親自前往那裡。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
{0} would you mind ^0000cdvisiting my big brother in my place^000000 to find out what's going on and let me know?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
{0} 您介意^0000cd替我去探望一下我哥哥^000000，弄清楚發生了什麼，然後告訴我嗎？

scripts.text: I would like to help you but...
scripts.translation: 我想幫您，但是...

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I would really lke to help you, but...
Yeah, I would like to help, but...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很想幫您，但是...
嗯，我很想幫忙，可是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't really express my desire to help any other way...
But, I'm really sorry. I can't.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我實在不知該如何表達我想幫忙的心情...
但，真的很抱歉。我做不到。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh, no, no. I am sure you are really busy. I'm sorry to have asked such a favor.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
啊，不，不。我相信您一定很忙。抱歉讓您為難了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure. It's not a big deal.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然。沒什麼大不了的。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Really? Thank you so much.
It seems that a person with so much experience like you has a wonderful heart as well.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
真的嗎？太感謝您了。
看來像您這樣經驗豐富的人，心地也非常善良。

scripts.text: I wanted to help you.
scripts.translation: 我想幫您。

scripts.text: Just because.
scripts.translation: 只是順手而已。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was just wondering how things are coming along.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只是想知道事情進展得怎麼樣了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Nothing... Nothing really happened yet...
I can't do anything in my own strength... Nothing at all...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
沒什麼...還沒發生什麼...
憑我自己的力量什麼都做不了...完全無能為力...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I just couldn't pass by without doing something about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只是覺得不能就這樣置之不理。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Does that mean you would meet up with my brother?
Thank you so much!!!
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
那意思是您會去見我哥哥嗎？
太感謝您了！！！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
The prison is inside the palace, but to find it, it might be a bit difficult.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
監獄在宮殿裡面，但找到它可能有點困難。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
By the way, my brother ^0000cddoesn't talk very well to strangers.^000000
He's typically very shy and introverted.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
順便說一句，我哥哥^0000cd不太擅長和陌生人說話^000000。
他通常非常害羞且內向。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
So you might have to be a bit patient with him. Please give this ^0000cdletter^000000 to him.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
所以您可能需要對他多一點耐心。請把這封^0000cd信件^000000交給他。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Well, you must have a long way to go, so please be on your way.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
好了，您路途遙遠，請快出發吧。

scripts.text: I lost the letter.
scripts.translation: 我把信弄丟了。

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒有準備好。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Um... {0} It looks like what you have in your coat is my letter...?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
嗯... {0} 看起來您外套裡裝的是我的信...？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Sure, I'll write you another one {0}. Compared to the trouble you have to go through, this is not a problem at all.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
當然，我再給您寫一封 {0}。比起您要經歷的麻煩，這根本不算什麼。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I know I'm the one asking a favor, but could you please hurry?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我知道是我在求人幫忙，但能請您快點嗎？

scripts.text: [Wuhari]
scripts.translation: [烏哈里]

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I am really concerned about him.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我真的非常擔心他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your brother seems to be doing well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您的弟弟看起來過得很好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Compared to how he was when I first met him, he surprisingly had... lots to say...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
比起我第一次見到他時的樣子，他居然...話很多...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Yeah... He's pretty talkative, isn't he?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
是啊...他確實挺健談的，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
What did he say?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
他說了什麼？

scripts.text: - Wuhari is told about Wuhuru -
scripts.translation: - 烏哈里得知了關於烏胡魯的事 -

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Why did he do such a thing...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
他為什麼要做這種事...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Well, I guess he always had a negative self-image of his physical self.
He thought that he would be able to do anything if he was big and beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
嗯，我想他一直對自己的身體形象很負面。
他覺得如果自己能變得高大漂亮，就能做任何事了。

scripts.text: Do you have any complaints?
scripts.translation: 您有什麼不滿嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
No, I don't have any complaints at all.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
不，我完全沒有不滿。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
He always told me that since we are disadvantaged physically, we need to at least be smart and taught me very diligently.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
他總是告訴我，既然我們在身體上處於劣勢，至少要在智力上佔優勢，並且非常認真地教導我。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
For that, I am now able to support myself well, and my relationship with him is really strong.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
多虧了他，我現在能很好地養活自己，而且我和他的關係非常親密。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
And since my physique is so small, many people adore me even when I age.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
而且因為我的身材嬌小，即使年紀大了，很多人也都很喜歡我。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Thanks to that, many gave us lots of good things to eat, heh heh.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
多虧了這個，很多人給了我們很多好吃的東西，呵呵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your brother asked me to figure out a way for him to recover his body.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您的弟弟讓我想辦法幫他恢復身體。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Yes, that's not even a question. We need to not only recover his body but also rescue him from imprisonment.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
是的，這甚至不用問。我們不僅要恢復他的身體，還要把他從囚禁中解救出來。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
With regards to that, I actually have another ^0000cdfavor^000000 to ask.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
關於這件事，我其實還有另一個^0000cd請求^000000想提。

scripts.text: I would like to, but...
scripts.translation: 我想幫忙，但是...

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Yes, of course, you would be very busy. I am grateful for even letting me know about my brother.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
是的，當然，您會很忙。能告訴我弟弟的訊息，我已經很感激了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
非常感謝！

scripts.text: Well, I can help you.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我可以幫您。

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh dear~ Is there anyone who can help~~ This world is so ruthless~
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
哎呀~有沒有人能幫幫我~~
這個世界真是太殘酷了~

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Will you really?
Are you doing this because I look so sad?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
您真的願意幫忙嗎？
是因為看我這麼難過才這樣做的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Whatever it is, I thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
無論是什麼，我都非常感謝！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
First, if we were to figure out how to recover his body, we have to know exactly what happened at that moment.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
首先，如果要弄清楚如何找回他的遺體，
我們必須確切知道當時發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It would be helpful to know on what basis he carried out his research. But, I don't really know despite listening to his story.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
如果能知道他進行研究的依據就好了。
但我聽了他的故事後，還是不太明白。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It looks like we don't have ways to figure that out right now. To explore it on my own, it just seems too difficult...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
看來我們現在沒有途徑去查明這件事。
靠我自己去調查，似乎太難了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It is probably best to ask the ^0000cdpeople who may be familiar with what happened then^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
最好的辦法，大概是去問問^0000cd當時可能瞭解情況的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Please, I ask you. In the meantime, I'll carefully think about what my brother has said.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
拜託您了。在此期間，我會仔細回想我弟弟說過的話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm still looking into things.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我還在繼續調查。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I see... I ask you, please take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我明白了...拜託您了，請多費心。

scripts.text: They told me to give this to you.
scripts.translation: 他們讓我把這個交給您。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
This is... ^0000cda research report^000000. My brother, he must have seen this and...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
這是...^0000cd一份研究報告^000000。
我弟弟，他一定是看到了這個，然後...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Umm... What is it that you brought?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
那個...您帶來的是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
But hmm... this is... Were there any other reports?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
不過嗯...這個...還有其他報告嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, that was the only one I was given.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒有，我只拿到了這一份。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh... That's too bad...
Well, I'll have to analyze this in more depth. I would need some ^0000cdtime^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
哦...真可惜...
看來我得更深入地解析一下。這需要一些^0000cd時間^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh! What the...!?
Where did it go?

[{0}]
I must have dropped it on the way here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我一定是來這裡的路上把它掉了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll bring it to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會把它帶給您的。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I looked into this report, but I still don't really understand what it is telling.
The ingredients are written here but they were difficult to gather and the application methods are a bit hard to understand...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我仔細研究了這份報告，但還是不太明白它到底在說什麼。
雖然上面列出了材料，但那些材料很難收集，而且使用方法也有些晦澀難懂...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Why would they use a piece of a high-level Laphine's wings and hair from a Sapha?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
為什麼要使用高階拉菲尼的翅膀碎片，還有薩法的毛髮呢？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It's not only difficult to obtain them, but the ways you would have to obtain them are brutal...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
不僅獲取它們非常困難，而且獲取的方式也極其殘忍...

scripts.text: Your brother's physique was...
scripts.translation: 你哥哥的身體狀況是...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
What do you mean exactly by that?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
你具體是指哪方面？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
His body was bigger and glowing blue like a Sapha, and his wings were much bigger than that of a normal Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他的體型比薩法還要大，而且散發著藍色的光芒，翅膀也比普通的拉菲尼大得多。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I wonder if it's ^0000cda method to merge the unique characteristics of both races^000000...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我想知道這是否是一種^0000cd融合兩個種族獨特特徵的方法^000000...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
But even for his own experiments, my brother would have needed someone's wing and someone's hair... Would he really...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
但即使是進行他自己的實驗，也需要用到別人的翅膀和毛髮...他難道真的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
According to your brother, he received the ingredients from a high-level Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
據你哥哥所說，他是從高階拉菲尼那裡獲得了這些材料。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
The more I look at it, the stranger it gets... To think of this in the first place...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
越看越覺得奇怪...光是想到這些就已經...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Regardless, to figure out a way to recover my brother's body, I would have to study this.
I wish the instructions were more detailed.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
不管怎樣，為了找到恢復我哥哥身體的方法，我必須研究這個。
真希望說明能更詳細一些。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then should I go and ask your brother again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我去再問問你哥哥？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
That's probably no use. My brother also must have used these instructions to experiment, but he must have become that way because he failed.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
那可能沒用。我哥哥肯定也是用這些說明進行實驗的，但他之所以變成那樣，一定是因為實驗失敗了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
To understand these instructions accurately, we have to ^0000cdfind the Laphine who provided this report^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
要準確理解這些說明，我們必須^0000cd找到提供這份報告的拉菲尼^000000。

scripts.text: That's seems too uncertain.
scripts.translation: 這似乎太不確定了。

scripts.text: Shall I look for that Laphine?
scripts.translation: 我去找那隻拉菲尼？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Yes. I know. That's why {0} I asked you to help.
{1} You have much experience and have the necessary skills.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
是的，我知道。所以我才請{0}幫忙。
{1}你經驗豐富，具備必要的技能。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
That's exactly my request!
Wow, your veteran sensibilities are truly amazing.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
這正是我的請求！
哇，你的老練直覺真是驚人。

scripts.text: [Wuhari]
scripts.translation: [烏哈里]

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
But I guess it's still too much.
It must be too much...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
不過我想這要求還是太高了。
這肯定太為難你了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
In any case, thanks so much!
It looks like I'll have to depend on you again! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
總之，非常感謝！
看來我又得依賴你了！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
First, please go find that Laphine and ask how to return his body back. And also please ask why the report was given to my brother in the first place.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
首先，請去找那個拉芬，問問如何把他的身體還回來。另外，也請問問為什麼那份報告會交到我哥哥手裡。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It's probably best to ask the ^0000cdpeople in the village first^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
最好先去問問^0000cd村裡的人^000000。

scripts.text: It's important to help others.
scripts.translation: 幫助他人很重要。

scripts.text: No, I'm just passing by.
scripts.translation: 不，我只是路過。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Thank you so much!!!
Awesome! The world hasn't let me down just yet! I know it was too big of a favor..
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
非常感謝！！！
太棒了！這個世界還沒有讓我失望！我知道這要求太大了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Really?
But I'm a little busy right now.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
真的嗎？
不過我現在有點忙。

scripts.text: [Wuhari]
scripts.translation: [烏哈里]

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Please go find that Laphine and ask how to return his body back. And also please ask why the report was given to my brother in the first place.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
請去找那個拉芬，問問如何把他的身體還回來。另外，也請問問為什麼那份報告會交到我哥哥手裡。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It's probably best to ask the ^0000cdpeople in the village first^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
最好先去問問^0000cd村裡的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... That Laphine ^0000cdwas already dead.^000000

[Wuhari]
What? He was dead?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
什麼？他死了？

scripts.text: - It's probably better not to tell him Wuhuru's story -
scripts.translation: - 最好不要告訴他烏胡魯的故事 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You see, when I went to the field where he was last seen, he was already dead.
Could it be that the palace noticed how a risky research was being done and sent a person to take care of things?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看，當我去他最後出現的那個地方時，他已經死了。
會不會是宮殿注意到了這項危險的研究，派人來處理了？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Possibly...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
有可能...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
But why of all people did they entrust my brother with that research?
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
但為什麼偏偏是我哥哥被委託做這項研究？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It might be that they took advantage of his inferiority complex toward his physique and his superb intellect.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也許他們利用了他對自己體型的自卑感，以及他卓越的智力。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If he succeeded, they might have involved lower-level Laphines into the matter for less than desirable purposes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果他成功了，他們可能會讓低階的拉芬參與進來，用於不可告人的目的。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Ahh, how terrible..
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
啊，太可怕了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It could have been better off for your brother to have failed.
Even though it's unfortunate for him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
對你哥哥來說，失敗可能反而是好事。
雖然這對他來說很遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Could it mean that my brother is...
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
難道說，我哥哥是...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
No, I'm sure there is some way.
I'll recover his body no matter what even if I were to do it by myself.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
不，我相信一定有辦法的。
無論如何，我都會把他的身體找回來，哪怕是我一個人去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is there anything I can do to help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有什麼我可以幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
You already helped me so much... If so, I'll ask you for even another favor. It's probably going to be the last one.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
你已經幫了我很多了...既然如此，我想再拜託你一件事。這大概會是最後一次了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
All of the ^0000CDingredients^000000 in this research report are very difficult for me to gather myself. {0} I would like to ask for your help.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
這份^0000CD研究報告^000000裡列出的材料，我自己很難收集到。{0}我想請你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Ingredients I need are ^0000CDone of each of the following: Laphine's Wing Fragment, Hair of Sapha, Karvodailnirol, Purified Bradium, Rune of Darkness, Rune of Blood^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我需要的材料是^0000CD以下物品各一個：拉芬的翅膀碎片、薩法的頭髮、卡勒波迪藥水、精煉魔力之石、黑暗的輪、鮮血的輪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
All I can trust is you {0}. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我只信任你，{0}。謝謝你。

scripts.text: I brought them all.
scripts.translation: 我都帶來了

scripts.text: What were they again?
scripts.translation: 需要哪些材料來著？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Ingredients I need are ^0000cdone of each of the following: Laphine's Wing Fragment, Hair of Sapha, Karvodailnirol, Purified Bradium, Rune of Darkness, Rune of Blood ^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我需要的材料是^0000cd以下物品各一個：拉芬的翅膀碎片、薩法的頭髮、卡勒波迪藥水、精煉魔力之石、黑暗的輪、鮮血的輪 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course!

[Wuhari]
Um... Where did you say the items were {0}?
I couldn't work without them.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
那個...剛才說材料在哪裡來著，{0}？
沒有它們我沒法進行研究。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It must have been really difficult! Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
一定很不容易吧！非常感謝你！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I'll try to continue the research with these.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
我會試著用這些繼續研究的。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Thank you for helping me through all of this.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
謝謝你在我最困難的時候幫助我。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
This is nothing, but it's just a token of my appreciation.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
這不算什麼，只是我的一點心意。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I wish you best of luck in the coming future {0}.
scripts.translation:
[烏哈里]
祝你未來一切順利，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
Um... Excuse me.
I'm looking for someone.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個...打擾一下。
我在找人。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
Hello?

[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
Can you hear me?
EXCUSE ME!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你能聽到我嗎？
喂！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
Who is this guy?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這傢伙是誰？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me. You can hear me, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下。你能聽到我說話吧？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
I'm not a bad person. I'm just looking for someone in this prison.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是壞人。我只是想在這座監獄裡找個人。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
Ahhh! How irritating!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！真是煩死了！！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......
- The suspicious man doesn't seem to want to talk at all -
scripts.translation: - 那個可疑的男子似乎完全不想說話 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, if you are asked something, would you at least respond?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂，我問你話，你至少能回應一下嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......

[Suspicious man]
......

[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
All I am trying to do is just deliver this to him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只是想把這個交給他而已！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This right here! This thing!
Right? Can you see this? This thing!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就是這個！這個東西！
對吧？你能看到這個嗎？這個東西！！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
What did you say you have?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
你說你帶了什麼？

scripts.text: - The letter was nowhere to be found -
scripts.translation: - 那封信不知去向 -

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
A... letter...?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
一...封信...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes! A letter! I'm trying to deliver this to him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯！是一封信！我想把它交給他！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would you know who Wuhuru is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道烏胡魯是誰嗎？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
Wu...huru...? That's...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
烏...胡魯...？那是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It looks like ^0000cdyou are Wuhuru^000000. Your little brother wanted me to deliver this ^0000cdletter^000000 to you.
Although I didn't expect the delivery to be this way.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來^0000cd你就是烏胡魯^000000。你的弟弟讓我把這封^0000cd信^000000交給你。
雖然我沒料到送信會是這種方式。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Thank...you.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
謝...謝你。

scripts.text: - You leave Wuhuru alone to read through the letter -
scripts.translation: - 你讓烏胡魯獨自閱讀那封信 -

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I, I can't believe I did this to my little bro... Is Wuhari alright?
Ah.. What have I done...?
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我...我竟然對弟弟做了這種事...烏哈里沒事吧？
啊...我都幹了些什麼...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Have you met Wuhari? What a relief.
I can finally relax a little bit even in this prison.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
你見過烏哈里？真是讓人放心。
即使在這座監獄裡，我也能稍微放鬆一下了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Any good news?
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
有什麼好訊息嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Please, I ask you.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
拜託了，求求你。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
......

[Wuhuru]
If you have met Wuhari, as you can see, I didn't look like this originally. My brother and I had ^0000cdparticular small physiques.^000000 even among the lower-level Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
既然你見過烏哈里，你也看到了，我原本不是這副模樣。我和弟弟在低階拉菲涅斯中，^0000cd身材都特別嬌小。^000000

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
So among Laphines, who value aesthetics so much, we couldn't help but always feel inferior.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
所以在極度重視美感的拉菲涅斯中，我們總是忍不住感到自卑。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Being physically disadvantaged relative to others, we always studied at home. Thanks to that, we were able to become much smarter than others.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
因為身體條件不如別人，我們一直在家自學。也多虧了這一點，我們的智力遠超常人。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
One day, a high-level Laphine named ^0000cdMwaridica^000000 came to visit me.
He said that he is a member of a research facility, and that he wanted my help in a secret research project they were working on.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
有一天，一位名叫^0000cd姆瓦利迪卡^000000的高階拉菲涅斯來拜訪我。
他說他是研究機構的成員，希望我協助他們進行一項秘密研究專案。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
And that's when he gave me a research report that had some instructions and necessary ingredients.
It was a research project to ^0000cdstrengthen one's physique to make the Laphines stronger and more beautiful^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
就在那時，他給了我一份研究報告，上面寫著說明和所需材料。
那是一項旨在^0000cd強化體格，讓拉菲涅斯變得更強壯、更美麗^000000的研究。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I immediately said yes. For me, it was clearly a way of being recognized. There was no reason for hesitation.
And also, if I were to find the means to make myself bigger...
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我立刻答應了。對我來說，這顯然是獲得認可的機會，沒有任何猶豫的理由。
而且，如果能找到讓自己變大的方法...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He requested that I wouldn't share any of this information. So I complied with all of his requests.
I didn't even share it with my brother who I trust so much.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他要求我保密這些資訊。所以我完全照做了。
我甚至沒有告訴我最信任的弟弟。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I don't know if that was good or bad...
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我不知道這樣做是對是錯...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
In any case, through much research, I finally had the results right before me.
But we had no experimental subjects at hand.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
總之，經過大量研究，我最終得出了成果。
但我們手頭沒有實驗物件。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
So I let myself become one.
And as you can see, the consequence was...
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
於是，我讓自己成為了實驗物件。
正如你所見，結果...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
As soon as the experiment failed, that Laphine just withdrew himself right away.
I tried to take care of things on my own, but I ultimately ended up here.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
實驗失敗後，那位拉菲涅斯立刻撤走了。
我試圖獨自處理，但最終落得如此下場。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
After obtaining this body, I realize that I'd rather have my small body back.
As it is now, I am a monster.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
擁有了這副身體後，我意識到我寧願變回原來的小個子。
現在的我，不過是個魔物罷了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I didn't want this for myself... My greed was excessive.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我並不想這樣...是我的貪婪過頭了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Only if I had known earlier...
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
要是早點知道就好了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I'm sorry, I talked too much.
Regardless, I think it's over for me to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
抱歉，我說了太多。
無論如何，我覺得我出不去了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
If you can make it out of here, could you please let my brother know to figure out a way for me to return to my original self.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
如果你能逃出去，請告訴我的弟弟，讓他想辦法讓我恢復原狀。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
My brother, he is smaller than I, but has always been the smarter one.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我的弟弟比我更矮小，但一直比我更聰明。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Please, I ask you.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
拜託了，求求你。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
This jail cell feels particularly warm today.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
今天的牢房感覺格外溫暖。

scripts.text: I saw a dead corpse of a Laphine in the field.
scripts.translation: 我在野外看到了一具拉菲涅斯的屍體。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
...A dead Laphine corpse?
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
...一具拉菲涅斯的屍體？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^0000cdIt was a dead corpse of a high-level Laphine.^000000 The way he seemed was suggestive of the Laphine who requested the research from you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^0000cd那是一具高階拉菲涅斯的屍體。^000000 他的樣子暗示著，正是那位向你提出研究請求的拉菲涅斯。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And I also met someone who witnessed another bigger Laphine chasing after that Laphine before you were imprisoned here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我還遇到了一個人，他目睹了在你被關押到這裡之前，另一隻體型更大的拉菲涅斯追趕那隻拉菲涅斯的情景。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And then he was murdered.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
隨後，他就遇害了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
What are you trying to say?
Are you telling me that I am a murderer?
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
你想說什麼？
你是想告訴我，我是個殺人犯嗎？

scripts.text: Did you murder him out of anger?
scripts.translation: 你是出於憤怒殺了他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
What does it matter even if I were to... Reveal that I am a murderer...?
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
就算我承認...承認我是個殺人犯...那又怎樣？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I am trapped in this body no matter what...
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
無論發生什麼，我都被困在這具身體裡...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He tricked me, you see!
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他騙了我，你知道嗎！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He convinced me that the goal of the research was to beautify and strengthen the Laphines and even set me up as the experimental subject!
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他說服我，說研究的目標是美化並強化拉菲涅斯，甚至把我安排成了實驗物件！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
And as soon as the experiment failed, he ran away!
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
而一旦實驗失敗，他就逃跑了！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He told me the truth only right before his death.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他直到臨死前才告訴我真相。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
His true goal was to prove to his authorities that ^0000cdhis skills as a researcher was for real^000000.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他的真正目標，是向他的上級證明^0000cd他作為研究員的實力是真實的^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He said that he didn't even examine the content of the experment or the ingredients themselves.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他說他根本沒有檢查實驗的內容，甚至沒有檢視過那些材料本身。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
And he also used dirty means to obtain the hair of a Sapha!
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
他還用卑鄙的手段獲取了薩法的毛髮！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
The palace then discovered the means of this research, chased us down, and captured me for participating in the project.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
後來宮殿發現了這項研究的手段，追捕我們，並因為我參與了該專案而將我逮捕。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
What exactly did I do wrong?
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我到底做錯了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I was only a pawn in his ambitious schemes.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
我只是他野心勃勃計劃中的一枚棋子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It looks like his goals to engage in the study were similar to your own goals to participate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來他參與研究的目標，和你參與的目標很相似。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While you are a victim of his schemes, it is hard to justify what you have done... But
the way you are imprisoned here seems like you are paying for your actions.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雖然你是他陰謀的受害者，但很難為你所做的事辯護...不過，你被關押在這裡的樣子，似乎是在為你的行為付出代價。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
......

[Wuhuru]
Please... don't share this story with Wuhari.
I implore you.
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
請...不要把這件事告訴烏哈里。
我懇求你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, I will act as though I have never made it here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我會假裝我從未到過這裡。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Thank you... I am indebted to you...
scripts.translation:
[烏胡魯]
謝謝你...我欠你一個人情...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Whoa! Hey!
Would you please stop appearing out of nowhere?
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
哇！嘿！
你能不能別總是突然從不知道哪裡冒出來？

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Whoa! Hey!
What's going on! You shocked me!
What are you trying to do to me?
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
哇！嘿！
怎麼回事！嚇我一跳！
你想對我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Masione]
I'm a fragile, sensitive being!
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
我可是個脆弱又敏感的人！

scripts.text: Um, about Wuhuru...
scripts.translation: 嗯，關於烏胡魯的事...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Oh, I was shocked for no reason.
About Wuhuru... Well, I don't really know the messy details...
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
哦，我白擔心了。
關於烏胡魯...嗯，那些亂七八糟的細節我也不太清楚...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
I don't know how a guy who lived so peacefully all his life became like that.
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
我不知道一個一直過著平靜生活的人，怎麼會變成那樣。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Come to think of it, on the day that it happened, I heard a ^0000cdreally loud scream^000000...
Many in the village were too scared to go out for awhile after hearing that.
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
說起來，事發那天，我聽到了一聲^0000cd非常響亮的尖叫^000000...
村裡很多人聽到後嚇得好一陣子都不敢出門。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
And not too long after, many people from the palace came over and took Wuhuru away.
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
沒過多久，宮裡來了很多人，把烏胡魯帶走了。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
For me, it was the first time I got out of the house in a while so all I saw was Wuhuru being captured.
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
對我來說，那是我很久以來第一次出門，所以我只看到烏胡魯被抓走的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
But Wuhuru's appearance at the time... his appearance...
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
但當時烏胡魯的樣子...他的樣子...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Anyways, ^0000cdGoatie^000000 was also there with me, so ask him too.
He's really sharp with these kind of things so he might remember more.
scripts.translation:
[馬西奧內]
總之，^0000cd山羊仔^000000當時也和我在一起，你也可以問問他。
他對這類事情很敏銳，可能記得更多。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Did you want to know about something else?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
你還想知道別的什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Have you ever been to the palace?
They say that it is so much more beautiful than our Yai's could ever be.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
你去過皇宮嗎？
聽說那裡比我們雅伊的宮殿還要美麗得多。

scripts.text: I came after talking with Masione...
scripts.translation: 我是和馬西奧內談完話後過來的...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Masione sent you? What's the problem?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
馬西奧內讓你來的？出什麼事了？

scripts.text: I wanted to ask you about Wuhuru.
scripts.translation: 我想問問你關於烏胡魯的事。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Oh, you came for Wuhuru. But I don't know much either...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
哦，你是為了烏胡魯來的。但我也不怎麼知道...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Ah! I just remembered seeing Wuhuru right before that happened!
He came by with some ^0000cdstranger^000000...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
啊！我剛想起來，事發前我見過烏胡魯！
他和一個^0000cd陌生人^000000一起來的...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
At any rate, in all my days knowing Wuhuru, it's the first time I've seen him so happy.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
總之，在我認識烏胡魯的這麼多年裡，還是第一次見他這麼開心。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
When I asked him why he was so happy, he showed me some ^0000cdpieces of paper^000000 and told me that he was going to look great soon...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
我問他為什麼這麼高興，他給我看了一些^0000cd紙片^000000，說很快他就會變得很帥氣...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
And the guy next to him would hint at him to keep quiet...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
而他旁邊的那個人則暗示他保持安靜...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Well, I was a bit concerned, but seeing him so happy, I couldn't say anything.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
嗯，我有點擔心，但看他那麼開心，我也就沒說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
And it was after that when the big accident occurred.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
就在那之後，大事故發生了。

scripts.text: What was the piece of paper?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼紙片？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
That thing? Hmm, I don't know. I was too far to tell...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
那個東西？嗯，我不知道。我離得太遠，看不清楚...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
That's right, why don't you go see my ^0000cdhusband^000000. He was pretty close to Wuhuru so he might know more.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
對了，你不妨去見見我的^0000cd丈夫^000000。他和烏胡魯關係不錯，也許他知道得更多。

scripts.text: I want to hear about the high-level Laphine who Wuhuru was working with.
scripts.translation: 我想聽聽關於烏胡魯合作的那隻高等級拉芬的事。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Oh the high-level Laphine...? Yes~ I remember!
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
哦，高等級拉芬...？是的~ 我想起來了！

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
The stranger who came by with Wuhuru was a high-level Laphine. Are you talking about him?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
和烏胡魯一起來的那個陌生人是一隻高等級拉芬。你說的是他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
If you are talking about him, he quietly left the place after staying with Wuhuru for a bit.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
如果你說的是他，他在和烏胡魯待了一會兒後，就悄悄離開了那裡。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
After that, Wuhuru would just spend his days in his Yai.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
之後，烏胡魯就整天待在他的巢穴裡。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
But that Laphine, ^0000cdhe did have impressive, beautiful wings that made him seem very elegant, but his gaze and something about him made him very suspicious^000000.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
不過那隻拉芬，^0000cd他確實有一雙令人印象深刻的美麗翅膀，看起來非常優雅，但他的眼神和某種氣質讓他顯得非常可疑^000000。

scripts.text: Do you remember anything else?
scripts.translation: 你還記得其他什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Hmm, come to think of it, ^0000cdPompe told me one day that he saw a terrible thing happening to a high-level Laphine in the land of blooming flowers^000000.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
嗯，仔細想想，^0000cd蓬佩有一天告訴我，他在花之國度看到一隻高等級拉芬遭遇了可怕的事情^000000。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
He did say that the Laphine that he saw at the time also had ^0000cdparticularly large and beautiful wings...^000000.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
他說當時看到的那隻拉芬也有^0000cd特別巨大且美麗的翅膀...^000000。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Go see Pompe and check with him.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
去見見蓬佩，問問他吧。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
I guess people who have nothing can only dream.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
我想，一無所有的人只能做做夢罷了。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Do you need something from me?
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
你需要我做什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Svery]
It's my wife's big wish to visit the palace.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
去皇宮參觀是我妻子最大的心願。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I know why you are here!
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我知道你為什麼來這裡了！

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Do you need something else from me?
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
你還需要我做什麼嗎？

scripts.text: I was wondering about the paper that Wuhuru was holding.
scripts.translation: 我在想烏胡魯手裡拿的那張紙。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Yeah, that's right. My wife told me that he was holding something like that, but I have no idea what that was.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
沒錯，就是這樣。我妻子告訴我他拿著那樣的東西，但我完全不知道那是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
But who would you be to look for such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
不過，你是誰，為什麼要找那樣的東西？

scripts.text: Wuhari asked me a favor.
scripts.translation: 烏哈里拜託我幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Oh really? Come to think of it, I forgot to tell this to Wuhari.
Before Wuhuru was caputured away, Wuhuru's ^0000cdletter^000000 was placed on our window.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
哦，是嗎？仔細想想，我忘了告訴烏哈里這件事。
在烏胡魯被抓走之前，他的^0000cd信件^000000被放在我們的窗臺上。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
He must have written it in preparation for his fate.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
他一定是在預見到自己的命運後寫下的。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
He asked me to deliver a sealed ^0000cddocument^000000 to his brother.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
他讓我把一封密封的^0000cd檔案^000000交給他的兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
However!
We were so busy that we couldn't meet up with Wuhari even when we heard that he came back around here.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
但是！
我們太忙了，即使聽說烏哈里回到這一帶，也沒能和他碰上面。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Hmm, I wonder if that sealed document is the paper that my wife was talking about?
Whatever is it, give this to Wuhari.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
嗯，我想知道那封密封的檔案是不是我妻子說的那張紙？
不管是什麼，請把這個交給烏哈里。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Let me see... Where did I put it...
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
讓我看看...我把它放在哪裡了...

scripts.text: - Shuffle -
scripts.translation: - 翻找聲 -

scripts.text:
- Shuffle -
- Shuffle -
scripts.translation:
- 翻找聲 -
- 翻找聲 -

scripts.text:
- Shuffle -
- Shuffle -
- Shuffle -
scripts.translation:
- 翻找聲 -
- 翻找聲 -
- 翻找聲 -

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Yes, here it is.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
是的，在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I told myself that I'll keep it really safe, and that's why it's like this.
It's a bit wrinkled and stained, but it should be just fine to read.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我告訴自己一定要把它保管好，所以它才變成這樣。
雖然有點皺和汙漬，但應該還是能讀的。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Please help those poor kids.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
請幫幫那些可憐的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I don't know how nice kids like them became like that...
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我不知道像他們那樣好的孩子怎麼會變成那樣...

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I want to grant that wish for her, but how could that ever be possible.
Especially given our situation...
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我想幫她實現那個願望，但怎麼可能呢。
尤其是考慮到我們現在的處境...

scripts.text:
[Svery]
You dropped this, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
你掉東西了吧？

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Tsk tsk. How could a young one like you be so forgetful.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
嘖嘖。像你這樣年輕的人，怎麼這麼健忘。

scripts.text: Who's the high-level Laphine?
scripts.translation: 那個高等級的拉芬是誰？

scripts.text:
[Svery]
A high-level laphine? Hmm? I'm not sure who that was.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
高等級的拉芬？嗯？我不記得那是誰。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I never saw him before. And that was also the last time I saw him.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我以前沒見過他。而且那也是我最後一次見到他。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Why don't you go see my wife? She was with me.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
你為什麼不問問我的妻子？她當時和我在一起。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
My wife is much sharper than me with these kind of things, so she'll probably be more helpful.
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我妻子在這方面比我敏銳得多，她可能更有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I want to grant that wish for her, but how could that ever be possible.
Especially given our situation...
scripts.translation:
[斯維裡]
我想幫她實現那個願望，但怎麼可能呢。
尤其是考慮到我們現在的處境...

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I saw it!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我看見了！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Ouch! Whoa! Who is this? Is it a ghost?
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
哎喲！哇！這是誰？是幽靈嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I really saw it!!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我真的看見了！！

scripts.text: I was sent by Goatie...
scripts.translation: 我是山羊仔派來的...

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Goatie sent you? What's the problem?
Is it because of what they gave me last time? Tell them they have to wait a bit longer.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
山羊仔派你來的？出什麼事了？
是因為上次給我的東西嗎？告訴他們還得再等等。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's not it. I was just curious about the Laphine you saw in the field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是。我只是好奇你在田裡看到的那個拉芬。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Oy! That Laphine?
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
哦！那個拉芬？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Whoa! Don't even start with me!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
哇！別跟我提這個！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I was doing my business in the field in the middle of a night, but there suddenly appeared two dark shadows!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我半夜在田裡幹活，突然出現了兩個幽冥火球！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
At first, a ^0000cdhigh-level Laphine^000000 disappeared into distance so fast, and it was such a beautiful sight that I looked on for a while.
^0000cdThe wings were really big and pretty.^000000
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
起初，一個^0000cd高等級的拉芬^000000迅速消失在遠處，那景象太美了，我看了好一會兒。
^0000cd翅膀真的很大很漂亮。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
And then! Not too long after, suddenly!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
然後！沒過多久，突然！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
So suddenly!!!
^0000cdA huge Laphine^000000 was chasing after that high-level Laphine!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
太突然了！！！
^0000cd一隻巨大的拉芬^000000在追那個高等級的拉芬！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I'm not sure if it was because it was so dark at the time, but ^0000cdhis body was so dark^000000 that I couldn't tell who it was.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我不確定是不是因為當時太黑了，但^0000cd它的身體非常黑暗^000000，我根本看不清它是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I didn't think much into it and returned home. But some time later a scream, so loud that could shake the entire field, ripped through the air.
It was such a scary scream.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我沒多想就回家了。但過了一會兒，一聲巨大的尖叫聲劃破長空，震得整片田地都在顫抖。
那聲音太可怕了。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
And I was too afraid to go out for a while after that.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
從那以後，我嚇得好一陣子都不敢出門。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
And a few days ago, when I went out to the field, I saw in the corner ^0000cda big corpse^000000!
I also saw many ^0000cdsuspicious tree branches^000000 scattered in the area.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
幾天前，當我再次去田裡時，我在角落看到了^0000cd一具巨大的屍體^000000！
我還看到周圍散落著許多^0000cd可疑的樹枝^000000。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
It was so disquieting that I didn't get near it...
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
那景象太令人不安了，我根本不敢靠近...

scripts.text: A corpse?
scripts.translation: 屍體？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Yeah! I don't know what kind of terrible thing happened, but ^0000cda big wing was ripped, and the more I think about it, it looks like the corpse of the Laphine that I saw^000000.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
是的！我不知道發生了什麼可怕的事，但^0000cd一隻巨大的翅膀被撕裂了，我越想越覺得，那具屍體就是我之前看到的那隻拉芬^000000。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Oh dear~~ I don't know why this kind of thing happened so suddenly.
A high-level Laphine should have great magic powers, but to see him dead so easily, the other huge Laphine must be something else.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
天哪~~ 我不知道為什麼這種事會突然發生。
高等級的拉芬應該擁有強大的魔力，但它卻這麼輕易地死了，那隻巨大的拉芬一定不是普通生物。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
That's why I'm afraid to go out to the field.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
所以我才不敢去田裡。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
What if that huge Laphine attacks me when I'm out and about in the field?
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
萬一我在田裡活動時，那隻巨大的拉芬突然襲擊我怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
My kids are too young, and I need to take care of them! I need to stay safe, you see!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我的孩子還太小，我必須照顧他們！我必須保證自己的安全，你明白嗎！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
You should stay away, too, if you can.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
如果你能避開的話，最好也離那裡遠一點。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Excuse me, if it's not too much trouble, could I talk to you for a second?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
打擾一下，如果不麻煩的話，能佔用您一點時間嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Did you find something?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
您發現什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Did you need something from me?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
您有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I went to go see my father.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我去找神父了。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I wonder where he went. It should be around here...
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
不知道他去了哪裡。應該就在這附近...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Did you find something?
Oh... I see you haven't yet...
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
您發現什麼了嗎？
哦...看來您還沒有...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Father... Sob sob...
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
神父...嗚嗚...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Where did he go...?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
他到底去哪裡了...？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
You really seem like you have an impressive aura.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
您身上似乎散發著令人印象深刻的氣息。

scripts.text: Do you know the way?
scripts.translation: 您知道路嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I'm sorry? Do I know the way...?
No, no, I'm not someone like that.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
抱歉？我知道路...？
不不，我不是那種人。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I noticed from earlier that you are looking for something. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我剛才就注意到您在尋找什麼東西，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I'd like to make a ^0000cdsuggestion^000000.
Would you like to hear it?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我想提一個^0000cd建議^000000。
您願意聽聽嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, I'll hear you out.
scripts.translation: 好的，我聽聽看。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
It won't be a waste of your time. To be honest, I'm actually ^0000cdlooking for someone^000000 here too.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
不會浪費您的時間的。說實話，其實我也^0000cd正在尋找某人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
My father hasn't returned home for some time now, and when I visited his work, they said that he hasn't shown up there for a while either.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我父親已經很久沒回家了，我去他的工作地點找他，他們說他也有一段時間沒出現了。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
He's not one to vanish like that, so I asked around.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
他不是一個會突然消失的人，所以我四處打聽了一下。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I heard that people saw him around here, but I can't find a trace of him anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我聽說有人在這附近見過他，但我到處都找不到他的蹤跡。

scripts.text: Did you try asking the authorities?
scripts.translation: 您問過當局嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I already did. In fact, they were already searching for him.
I'm guessing they didn't make much progress.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我已經問過了。事實上，他們已經在尋找他了。
我想他們應該沒有取得什麼進展。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I'm worried something might have happened to him, so I came out searching for him myself.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我擔心他可能出了什麼事，所以出來親自尋找他。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
So, my suggestion is why don't we help each other find what each other needs throughout this search?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
所以，我的建議是，我們在這次搜尋中互相幫助，各自尋找自己需要的東西，怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
What do you think? I'm sure doing this together would be better than doing it alone.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
您覺得如何？我相信一起行動會比獨自行動更好。

scripts.text: What's he look like?
scripts.translation: 他長什麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Oh great, that means you'll take my suggestion, right?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
太好了，這意味著您接受我的建議了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
My father is similar to me. ^0000cdHe has particularly large wings and has a generally red aura around him.^000000
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我父親和我很像。^0000cd他的翅膀特別大，而且周身通常環繞著紅色的氣息。^000000

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
His name is ^0000cdMwadirica^000000.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
他的名字是^0000cdMwadirica^000000。

scripts.text: I'm looking for him too!
scripts.translation: 我也在找他！

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Oh, really? Why are you looking for my father?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
真的嗎？您為什麼在找我父親？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Actually, let's talk about this later and search for my father now.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
其實，這件事我們稍後再談，現在先去找我父親吧。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
If we find something, let's meet back here.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
如果我們找到了什麼，就回到這裡碰頭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I brought this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我帶來了這個。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
What... Did you say you found something?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
什...您說您找到了什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm? Where did it go? Did I drop it on the way?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？它去哪了？我是不是在路上弄丟了？

scripts.text: - You describe the corpse that you found in the field and show the piece of wing -
scripts.translation: - 您描述了在田野中發現的屍體，並展示了那片翅膀 -

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Oh, oh....! This is.... Definitely my father's...
Sob... NOoo!
How could this be...?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
哦，天哪....！這是....絕對是我父親的...
嗚...不！
怎麼會這樣...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He's in the eastern part of the field among the tall grasses. Should I accompany you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他在田野東邊的高草叢裡。需要我陪您去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
No, no. I'll go alone.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
不，不用。我要獨自去。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Before that, I would like to hear about why you were looking for my father.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
在那之前，我想聽聽您為什麼在找我父親。

scripts.text: - You share Wuhuru's research story -
scripts.translation: - 您分享了烏胡魯的研究故事 -

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
My father? He was certainly working on something very hard recently...
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我父親？他最近確實在非常努力地研究某件事...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Ah, who in the world... did such a thing...
A kind person like him...
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
啊，究竟是誰...做了這種事...
像他那樣善良的人...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
In any case, thanks a lot. You found my father...
This couldn't possibly be enough compensation, but please take it.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
總之，非常感謝。您找到了我父親...
這點補償可能遠遠不夠，但請收下。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
And please tell Wuhuru about my father.
They worked together, so he should hear about my father.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
還有，請告訴烏胡魯關於我父親的事。
他們曾一起工作，他應該知道關於我父親的事。

scripts.text: I need a piece of your father's wing.
scripts.translation: 我需要您父親的一片翅膀。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Isn't that what you already have in your hand right now?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
那不是您現在手裡正拿著的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Why would you need a piece of my father's wing...?
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
您為什麼需要我父親的一片翅膀...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What! When did it get here?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼！它什麼時候跑到這裡來的？！

scripts.text: - You briefly share Wuhuru's story -
scripts.translation: - 你簡要講述了烏胡魯的故事 -

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I see... It resulted from their research together...
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
原來如此...這是他們共同研究的結果...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Ok, sure. I will give it to you. I'm sure that's what my father would have liked you to have it.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
好吧，沒問題。我就把它給你。我相信我父親也會希望你擁有它的。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Please tell him I wish him the best.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
請告訴他，我祝他一切順利。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I would like to reminisce a bit more about my father here.
scripts.translation:
[吉蘭尼]
我想在這裡再多回憶一下關於我父親的事。

scripts.text: - An unidentifiable figure that looks like a huge flower bud -
scripts.translation: - 一個看起來像巨大花蕾的無法辨認的身影 -

scripts.text: This looks like the Laphine corpse that Pompe talked about.
scripts.translation: 這看起來像是蓬佩提到的拉芬屍體。

scripts.text: Looking at the shape of the wing, ^0000cdit is Mwaridica's high-level Laphine wing as described by Wuhuru and Giranni^000000.
scripts.translation: 觀察翅膀的形狀，^0000cd正如烏胡魯和吉蘭尼所描述的那樣，這是姆瓦里迪卡的高階拉芬翅膀^000000。

scripts.text: Seeing various scars on the body, he seems to have been ^0000cdmurdered^000000 after a fight.
scripts.translation: 看到身體上的各種傷痕，他似乎是在戰鬥後^0000cd被謀殺^000000的。

scripts.text: If he were to be overpowered, it must have been ^0000cda creature of large physique^000000 that surpasses a high-level Laphine.
scripts.translation: 如果他被擊敗，那一定是^0000cd體型巨大的生物^000000，超越了高階拉芬。

scripts.text: Let's pick up these scattered wing pieces and go tell Giranni about this.
scripts.translation: 讓我們撿起這些散落的翅膀碎片，去告訴吉蘭尼這件事。

scripts.text: The scattered wing pieces are collected.
scripts.translation: 散落的翅膀碎片已收集完畢。

scripts.text: - Around the corpse are some hair strands of a Sapha that look like tree branches -
scripts.translation: - 屍體周圍有一些看起來像樹枝的薩法毛髮 -

scripts.text: - Since this is a research ingredient, let's take some -
scripts.translation: - 既然這是研究材料，那就拿一些吧 -

scripts.text: - A high-level Laphine corpse -
scripts.translation: - 高階拉芬的屍體 -

scripts.text:
[Dandy]
Take a look at me! How's this? Am I not so fabulous?
scripts.translation:
[丹迪]
看看我！怎麼樣？我是不是非常迷人？

scripts.text:
[Dandy]
A Laphine can freely change in between different clothes, but not any Laphine looks this great!
scripts.translation:
[丹迪]
拉芬可以自由更換不同的衣服，但不是每個拉芬都能穿得這麼好看！

scripts.text:
[Lafiki]
What nonsensical nonsense are you saying? No matter who looks at it, this region's best looker is me!
scripts.translation:
[拉菲基]
你在說什麼胡話？不管誰看，這個地區最好看的都是我！

scripts.text:
[Lafiki]
My fashion sense today is excellent as usual. Heh-
scripts.translation:
[拉菲基]
我今天的時尚感一如既往地出色。嘿嘿-

scripts.text:
[Lafiki]
Hello~ My beautiful body~
Every strand of hair is so beautiful!
scripts.translation:
[拉菲基]
你好~我美麗的身軀~
每一根頭髮都如此美麗！

scripts.text:
[Dandy]
Yes, it's definitely your garbage fashion sense that wreaks of trash as usual.
scripts.translation:
[丹迪]
沒錯，你那一如既往散發著垃圾味道的糟糕時尚感。

scripts.text:
[Wutapoa]
I recently moved out of my parent's place!
I am so glad I finally have my own Yai!
scripts.translation:
[武塔波阿]
我最近搬出了父母家！
終於有了自己的小屋，真是太開心了！

scripts.text:
[Wutapoa]
I'm going to make it the most decorative, beautiful Yai in Eclage!
scripts.translation:
[武塔波阿]
我要把它裝飾成埃克拉珠最漂亮的小屋！

scripts.text:
[Wutapoa]
Yay, woohoo!!!
scripts.translation:
[武塔波阿]
耶，萬歲！！！

scripts.text:
[Mijani]
You are not from around here?
Welcome.
scripts.translation:
[米賈尼]
你不是這裡的人吧？
歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Mijani]
Of course, as long as you don't disrupt Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[米賈尼]
當然，前提是你不要擾亂埃克拉珠的安寧。

scripts.text:
[Markoza]
I also want to visit foreign lands.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾科扎]
我也想去看看外面的世界。

scripts.text:
[Markoza]
But would foreigners leave me be when I am this adorable?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾科扎]
但是，像我這麼可愛的人，外國人會放過我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Markoza]
Man, wherever I go, my cuteness just complicates everything...
scripts.translation:
[馬爾科扎]
唉，不管去哪裡，我的可愛總是讓事情變得複雜...

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Do you like things that twinkle?
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
你喜歡閃閃發光的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
I love them so much!
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
我超喜歡它們的！

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Twinkle twinkle~ Twinkle twinkle~
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
一閃一閃~ 一閃一閃~

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Twinkle twinkle~ Twinkle twinkle~
Sparkle sparkle~ Sparkle sparkle~
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
一閃一閃~ 一閃一閃~
亮晶晶~ 亮晶晶~

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Twinkle twinkle~ Twinkle twinkle~
Sparkle sparkle~ Sparkle sparkle~
Mmhahah~ Hahaha~ Hehehe~
Heh heh heh~ Huhuhe~ Hoho~
Kehehe~ Halala~ Fufu~
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
一閃一閃~ 一閃一閃~
亮晶晶~ 亮晶晶~
嘿嘿嘿~ 哈哈哈~ 呵呵呵~
嘿嘿嘿~ 呼呼呼~ 呵呵~
嘻嘻嘻~ 啦啦啦~ 噗噗~

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
But there's nothing twinkling here...
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
但是這裡沒有什麼閃閃發光的東西...

scripts.text:
[Warao]
Ah~ I'm so hungry. What should I eat today?
scripts.translation:
[瓦拉奧]
啊~好餓。今天該吃什麼好呢？

scripts.text:
[Warao]
Come to think of it, I wonder how this foreigner will taste?
scripts.translation:
[瓦拉奧]
說起來，不知道這個外地人吃起來是什麼味道？

scripts.text:
[Warao]
Hey hey, you know I'm kidding, right?
scripts.translation:
[瓦拉奧]
嘿，你知道我在開玩笑吧？

scripts.text:
[A kneeling boy]
Why am I kneeling like this?
scripts.translation:
[跪著的男孩]
我為什麼跪在這裡？

scripts.text:
[A kneeling boy]
At first, it was because it was comfortable. Now it's because I can't stretch my legs out anymore.
scripts.translation:
[跪著的男孩]
一開始是因為這樣很舒服。現在是因為我的腿伸不直了。

scripts.text:
[A kneeling boy]
I try to stretch them out, and my legs are all asleep!!
Does that mean I have to fly around with my legs flexed like this?
scripts.translation:
[跪著的男孩]
我試著把腿伸直，結果腿都麻了！！
難道我要一直這樣蜷著腿飛來飛去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Catering]
Wahahaha! How do you do!
It's perfect weather for a picnic, no?
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦]
哇哈哈！你好啊！
今天天氣真好，正適合野餐呢，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Catering]
You say it's hard to pack for a picnic?
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦]
你說野餐很難準備嗎？

scripts.text:
[Catering]
Don't you worry!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦]
別擔心！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
This is a specialty combining acorns with 7 different kinds and 7 different levels of flavor collected by squirrels of Eclage!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦]
這是我們的特色菜，由埃克拉珠的松鼠們採集了7種不同種類、7種不同風味的橡果精心製作而成！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
This specialty to-go box is only 2,999 coins!!!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦]
這款特色外帶盒只要2,999金幣！！！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
Such a remarkable price!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦]
價格非常划算哦！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
If you order now, we also give you a disposable fork that feels like new even with a hundred uses!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承辦]
現在訂購，我們還贈送一次性叉子，用一百次都像新的一樣！

scripts.text:
[A blushing girl]
Do you see this balcony up top?
Mayor Jun appears there everytime there is an important occasion!
scripts.translation:
[臉紅的女孩]
你看到上面那個陽臺了嗎？
每逢重要場合，朱恩市長都會出現在那裡！

scripts.text:
[A blushing girl]
He's so handome!! Ahhh~
scripts.translation:
[臉紅的女孩]
他好帥啊！！啊嗚~

scripts.text:
[Choir conductor]
We are Eclage's Tree Wing Choir~
We bring you heavenly harmonies~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班指揮]
我們是埃克拉珠的樹翼唱詩班~
為您帶來天籟般的和聲~

scripts.text:
[Choir conductor]
Hello foreigner, we'll give you a taste of our harmony~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班指揮]
你好，外地人，讓我們為你展示一下我們的和聲~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班]
啊~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~~
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班]
啊~~
啊~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班]
啊~~~
啊~~
啊~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~~~~
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~

[Choir]
Aaa~~~~~
Aaa~~~~
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~

[Choir]
Aaa~~~~~~
Aaa~~~~~
Aaa~~~~
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~

[Choir]
Uhhurukukuruhuuhhurukukuruhuuh
Try to feel this~ The melody that flows~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班]
烏呼嚕庫庫魯呼呼呼嚕庫庫魯呼呼
試著感受一下吧~ 這流淌的旋律~

scripts.text:
[Choir conductor]
How is it!! Our harmony!!
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班指揮]
怎麼樣！！我們的和聲！！

scripts.text:
[Choir member]
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱詩班成員]
啊~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shuffle... Shuffle...
Tap... Tap... Creak... Creak...
Thud thud thud...
Thud Thud!!! Creak~ Thud!
What are these sounds?
scripts.translation: 這些聲音是什麼？

scripts.text: Ignore them and move on.
scripts.translation: 無視它們，繼續趕路。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are weird sounds of some kind...
I should go in and check it out.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
裡面傳來奇怪的聲音...
我應該進去看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's probably nothing.
I should just go on my way~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大概沒什麼事吧。
我還是繼續趕路~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello~
Is there something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好~
出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
- Something hits you
over the head really hard.
Your body loses its strength and your vision goes blurry -
scripts.translation:
- 有什麼東西重重地砸在你的頭上。
你的身體失去了力氣，視線變得模糊 -

scripts.text: - Oh, I can't lose my consciousness like this -
scripts.translation: - 啊，我不能就這樣失去意識 -

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
What just happened?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
剛才發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
There's no way the house is
in this much disarray without
a thief breaking and entering...
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
家裡這麼凌亂，
肯定是盜賊闖進來了...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Just earlier, my necklace
was stolen!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
剛才，我的項鍊
被偷走了！

scripts.text:
[Poppy]
Bow wow! Bow wow!
Grrrrr Bow Wow!
scripts.translation:
[波比]
汪汪！汪汪！
嗚嗚 汪汪！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
This darn dog always
bites random strangers
that other Laphines hate it!
How many times did I say
that we should kick
this dog out for good?
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
這隻討厭的狗總是
咬那些陌生的路人，
其他拉菲尼人都討厭它！
我說過多少次了，
我們應該把這狗趕出去！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Poppy~ Be nice~
This person is not
someone to be afraid of,
Shh~ Shh~~
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
波比~ 乖一點~
這個人不是
需要害怕的物件，
噓~ 噓~~

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
And how many times 
did I tell you to lock the doors
properly, my dear!!
This is all because of you
not caring for our house enough!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
還有多少次了，
我告訴過你要把門鎖好，親愛的！！
這都是因為你
不夠關心我們的家！

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Hey, hey, you keep
blaming me too much!
Aren't we lucky enough 
that we are not
hurt anywhere?
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
嘿，嘿，你總是
責怪我太多！
我們沒受傷，
難道不是運氣很好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
What did you say?
My goodness!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
你說什麼？
天哪！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm?
I think that person's awake!
Hey, are you okay?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
嗯？
我覺得那個人醒了！
嘿，你沒事吧？

scripts.text: My head hurts so much...
scripts.translation: 我的頭好痛...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
If the human's awake, get rid of it!
Our house just got robbed
and we don't have the 
luxury of taking care of someone!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
既然那個人類醒了，就趕緊把他趕走！
我們家剛被搶了，
哪有餘力照顧別人！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Still, you shouldn't say that to someone who's been knocked out...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
可是，你不該對剛昏迷醒來的人說這種話...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
How do you feel?
You were in front of our house, unconscious so we brought you inside.
What happened to you?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
你感覺怎麼樣？
你當時昏倒在我們家門口，所以我們把你帶了進來。
你身上發生了什麼？

scripts.text: Someone came out... and...
scripts.translation: 有人衝出來...然後...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Wow... I can't believe something like that happened.
I think the person who knocked
you unconscious is the one 
who robbed our house.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
哇...真不敢相信發生了這種事。
我覺得那個把你打暈的人，
就是搶了我們家的人。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
How can you believe what {0} saying?
How do you know {1} not lying
after robbing our stuff {2}?
Search {3} possessions immediately!!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
你怎麼能相信{0}說的話？
搶了我們東西之後，
你怎麼知道{1}沒有說謊{2}？
立刻搜查{3}的隨身物品！！

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
No, how could you say such things?
In common sense, why would the robber be lying down in front of the house?
I think what this person is
saying is probably true...
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
不，你怎麼能這麼說？
按常理來說，小偷怎麼會躺在房子前面呢？
我覺得這個人說的
應該是真的...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
In any case. What do you plan to do?
Because our house just got robbed,
we don't have the means to take care of you.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
不管怎樣。你打算怎麼辦？
因為我們家剛被搶了，
沒有能力照顧你。

scripts.text: I'm not the type to be bullied around.
scripts.translation: 我不會任人欺負。

scripts.text: I'll help you catch the thief.
scripts.translation: 我會幫你們抓住小偷。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm... The way you look
seems like you would have 
been bullied around in the past..
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
嗯...看你的樣子，
過去似乎經常被人欺負...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm, I guess
we'll need
your help
with this.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
嗯，看來
我們需要
你的幫助
來處理這件事。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm, since you say that,
I can't trust you 100%, but
I'll trust you as best as I can.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
嗯，既然你這麼說，
我沒法百分之百信任你，
但我會盡力信任你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I'll definitely
find the jerk who hit
me over my head.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我一定會
找到那個從背後偷襲我的混蛋。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Before anything, I'll first listen to your
observations on what may have happened.
Please give me your best cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
首先，我要先聽聽你們
對可能發生的事情的觀察。
請全力配合我。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Sure, you got it.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
好的，沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I don't know about this...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我對這件事沒什麼把握...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Alright, let's go for it.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
好吧，那就試試看吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm... The stories you told me...
Now I've processed through them..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...你們告訴我的故事...
我現在已經整理清楚了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are some points of interest
that I am considering right now...
First of all..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有幾個關鍵點
我正在考慮...
首先...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The likely suspect is...
A person with short, red hair.
We aren't sure whether the
person is male or female, but
has a familiar face...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嫌疑人很可能是...
一個留著紅色短髮的人。
我們還不確定
此人是男是女，但
看起來很面熟...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Dames came back from meeting with a friend..
The friend is nice.
He's a bit immature, but doesn't
seem to be of a particular problem.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
達姆斯神父是和朋友見面後回來的。
那位朋友人不錯。
他有點不成熟，但似乎
並沒有特別的嫌疑。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rosa was coming back from shopping.
Since I was lying unconscious
and the house was a mess,
she was afraid of me and left me 
there and stayed inside the house.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
羅莎修女是購物回來時發現的。
因為我當時昏迷不醒，
家裡又一片狼藉，
她嚇壞了，把我留在那裡，
自己躲進了屋裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I thought the daughter discovered
me first but Rosa was already
in the house by then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我原以為是女兒
先發現我的，但那時
羅莎修女已經在屋裡了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The daughter told me that 
she saw Balumin passing
by the house...
He seemed to be preoccupied
with something...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
女兒告訴我，
她看到巴盧明
從房子旁邊經過...
他似乎心事重重...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
In other words... the person who
discovered me first was Rosa
and I was lying in front of
the house.
The house was in much disarray
And...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也就是說...第一個
發現我的人是羅莎修女，
而我當時正躺在
房子門口。
家裡一片混亂，
而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But why was I just passed
by when I was unconcious?
Something's not right.
And...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但我昏迷時，
為什麼只是被人
路過而已？
這不對勁。
而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, Dames actually
suspects Rosa the most.
Their marriage has been becoming
more difficult. She's been asking him for
more things. Their relationship doesn't seem healthy.
And..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
然而，達姆斯神父
其實最懷疑羅莎修女。
他們的婚姻
越來越艱難。她總是
向他索要更多東西。他們的關係
似乎很不健康。
而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The stolen necklace was
what the husband bought for his wife..
Recently, the wife asked him to 
buy her a necklace, but he refused.
That's why he suspects her.
And..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
被偷的項鍊
是丈夫買給妻子的...
最近，妻子讓他
買一條項鍊，但他拒絕了。
所以他懷疑她。
而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She said she doesn't suspect anyone.
She trusts her family entirely.
The stolen necklace was
something that she
really cared for.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她說她不懷疑任何人。
她完全信任家人。
被偷的項鍊
是她
非常珍視的東西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are no particularly expensive
items in the house and neither was the necklace.
It was just a meaningful item.
It is weird that it was stolen
when it didn't seem very expensive.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
家裡沒有特別昂貴的
物品，項鍊也不貴。
它只是一個有意義的物品。
它看起來並不值錢，
卻被偷了，這很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The analysis is enough for now and
the second thing I have to do is...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前的分析已經足夠了，
接下來我要做的是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Field examination!
The robber must have left
some evidence!
Shall I start?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現場勘查！
竊賊一定
留下了證據！
要開始嗎？

scripts.text: - Let's examine Poppy first -
scripts.translation: - 先檢查波比 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the messy
bookshelves first -
scripts.translation: - 先檢查凌亂的書架 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the damaged
book first -
scripts.translation: - 先檢查破損的書 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the
container first -
scripts.translation: - 先檢查容器 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the
messed up table first -
scripts.translation: - 先檢查凌亂的桌子 -

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh......
What should I do...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
啊......
我該怎麼辦...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh... What happened here?
I can't believe that the house was robbed...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
啊...這裡發生了什麼？
我不敢相信家裡被偷了...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I hope the robber
is caught soon..
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
希望小偷能儘快被抓到...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok then,
I will begin interviewing
the victims.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，
我開始對受害者進行詢問。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't ask twice
so please respond carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只問一次，
請仔細回答。

scripts.text: Where were you coming from?
scripts.translation: 你是從哪裡來的？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I was taking a walk
in the land of blooming flowers.
I was reading a book and enjoying the breeze.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我本來在花海中散步。
一邊看書，一邊享受著微風。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
If I go to a place where there are soft breezes,
I feel much better and
forget everything about the house.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
如果去有柔和微風的地方，
我就會感覺好很多，
也能忘掉家裡的事。

scripts.text: Was there anyone suspicious?
scripts.translation: 有看到可疑的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm... I'm not sure.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
嗯...我不太確定。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh! Come to think of it, there was!
There was a person with short, red hair hurriedly going somewhere.
I wondered to myself
what's the big hurry?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
啊！想起來，有一個人！
有個紅短髮的人匆匆忙忙地趕著去某處。
我當時還納悶，
這麼著急幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
It was an uncommon hair color
so it made me stare at the person 
for a bit, wondering who it was.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
那個髮色很少見，
所以我盯著那個人看了一會兒，
想知道那是誰。

scripts.text: Was the person male or female?
scripts.translation: 那個人是男性還是女性？

scripts.text: Do you know anyone with short, red hair?
scripts.translation: 你認識紅短髮的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
That I'm not sure...
Hmm, now that you ask.
I wonder what the gender is.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
這個我不太清楚...
嗯，被你這麼一問。
我也想知道那是男是女。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm...
No matter how much I think about it...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
嗯...
我怎麼想都想不起來...

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女兒 露恩]

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
The physique seems
more masculine, but
the hair seemed more
feminine...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
身材看起來比較像男性，
但髮型又比較像女性...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
And... Something about
the person was familiar
to me..
I'm not exactly sure though.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
而且...那個人
讓我覺得有點熟悉...
不過我也說不太準。

scripts.text: Who's the first person to find me?
scripts.translation: 誰第一個發現我的？

scripts.text: Have you seen short, red hair elsewhere?
scripts.translation: 你在別的地方見過紅短髮的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I think... I was the 
first one to discover you...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我想...應該是
我第一個發現你的...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No, I didn't see the person again
but on my way back home,
I saw my dad's friend
Balumin passing by
the house.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
不，我沒有再見到那個人。
不過在我回家的路上，
我看到爸爸的朋友巴盧明
從我家門前經過。

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女兒 露恩]

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
When I first found you,
you were lying in
front of the house unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我第一次發現你的時候，
你正躺在屋前，
而且已經失去了意識。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I was shocked thinking
that it was a dead corpse,
but thankfully you were breathing.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我當時嚇了一跳，
還以為是一具屍體，
但幸好你還有呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
So I was hastily trying
to bring you inside the house,
but I was shocked again seeing
the house in so much disarray.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
所以我急忙想把你抱進屋裡，
但看到屋裡一片狼藉，
我又嚇了一跳。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
But inside the house, my mom
was already there.
I mean, if a person is lying in front of the house
unconscious, how could she just
go inside the house without doing anything?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
不過屋裡的時候，
媽媽已經在那裡了。
我是說，如果有人在屋前
失去意識地躺著，
她怎麼可能什麼都不做就進屋呢？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
So I guess if I were to answer
that again, the first person to see you
was probably my mom.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
所以如果讓我再回答一次的話，
第一個看到你的人
應該是媽媽。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I saw him far away
so I didn't see in much detail
but he was sweating
a whole lot at the time.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我離他比較遠，
所以沒看清細節，
但他當時滿頭大汗。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I couldn't talk to him,
but he seemed very
preoccupied with something.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我沒有和他說話，
但他看起來
心事重重。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Come to think of it,
if he passed by our house,
he must have seen you unconscious body but I wonder why he didn't do anything?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
仔細想想，
如果他經過我家，
肯定看到了你失去意識的樣子，
但我不明白他為什麼什麼都沒做？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Anyways, I think that's pretty much all I know.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
總之，我想我知道的大概就是這些了。

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你的坦誠回答。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No problem.
I hope that was helpful 
at least somewhat.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
不客氣。
希望能幫上你一點忙。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I hope we can catch the robber.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
希望能抓住那個強盜。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No, I have never seen anyone else with that hairstyle.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
不，我從未見過其他人
留那樣的髮型。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
At least from the people that I know,
I don't think there was ever a person like that.
Yeah... Not at all!
This I know for sure!
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
至少在我認識的人裡，
我覺得從來沒有過這樣的人。
是的...絕對沒有！
這一點我確信無疑！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
If it was a color as 
obvious as that,
there is no way I wouldn't remember!
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
如果是那麼明顯的顏色，
我不可能不記得！

I hope we can catch the robber.
