希望能抓住那個強盜。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Did you say you are going to do a field examination?
Is there anything
I can help with?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
你說過要進行現場勘查嗎？
有什麼我可以幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
You were working on the field examination, right?
But I guess you aren't done.
Please let me know what you find
when you are done.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
你正在做現場勘查，對吧？
看來還沒做完。
結束後請告訴我你的發現。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
You finished with all of the
field examination!
Did you find anything?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
你已經完成了所有的現場勘查！
有什麼發現嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Maybe...
The necklace wasn't stolen, but
was just lost somewhere in the house...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
也許...
項鍊並沒有被偷，
只是掉在屋子裡的某個地方了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Unfortunately, that wasn't the case,
and I should do a 
survey investigation of
various people.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不幸的是，情況並非如此，
我應該對相關人員
進行調查詢問。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh, I see...
But aren't you doing
too much for us?
Honestly, we are very
thankful for what
you've already done...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
噢，我明白了...
但是，你為我們做的
是不是太多了？
說實話，對於你已經做的，
我們非常感激...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
What are you saying?
No matter what! My necklace!
And the thief who took it!
We have to find them!
No matter what!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
你在說什麼？
無論如何！我的項鍊！
還有偷走它的小偷！
我們必須找到它們！
無論如何！

scripts.text:
- Footstep sounds -
- It sounds like someone is walking toward the house -
scripts.translation:
- 腳步聲 -
- 聽起來有人正朝房子走來 -

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Mother~ Father~
I'm back~!
What the...?!
What happened to the house?
Was it robbed?!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
媽媽~ 爸爸~
我回來啦~！
天哪...？！
房子怎麼了？
被搶劫了嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
How am I possibly
your mother??
You take that back right away!!
How many times did I tell you to
stay away from my daughter, huh?!
Get out of the house right now!!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我怎麼可能
是你媽媽？？
你馬上給我收回這句話！！
我告訴過你多少次
離我女兒遠點，嗯？！
現在立刻給我滾出去！！

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Mother!! If something
has been robbed, I will
definitely find it for you!
You can trust me, mother!!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
媽媽！！如果有什麼
東西被偷了，我絕對
會幫你找到的！
你可以相信我，媽媽！！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
You are just a nuisance.
Get out of the house right now!!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
你只是個討厭鬼。
現在立刻給我滾出去！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That guy must be Luen's
boyfriend... Before it
gets messier here, I should
get on with my
survey investigation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這傢伙肯定是露恩的
男朋友... 在事情變得更糟之前，
我應該繼續進行
我的調查詢問。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Did you say you are going to do a field examination?
Is there anything
I can help with?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]

scripts.text: I found out who the robber was.
scripts.translation: 我已經查出了小偷是誰。

scripts.text: I haven't figured things out yet.
scripts.translation: 我還沒有查明真相。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]

The necklace is even more important...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh my.. Really?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
天哪.. 真的嗎？

[{0}]

[{0}]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now..
I'll let you know the 
results of my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在..
我會告訴你
我的調查結果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then why don't I gather all of the victims and suspects and go through the thought process with you.
This place is not appropriate so let us go to another location.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼，為什麼不把所有受害者和嫌疑人召集起來，和我一起梳理一下思路呢。
這裡不太合適，我們去別的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's get going.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們出發吧。

scripts.text:
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 在繼續對話前，我需要減輕負重 -

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I told my parents and
all the others.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
我已經告訴了我的父母
和其他所有人。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
That my boyfriend was the one.
I knew about it already.
But, I couldn't tell my parents because if they were to find out the truth,
they would oppose him even more...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
那個小偷就是我的男朋友。
我早就知道了。
但我不能告訴父母，因為如果他們發現真相，
就會更加反對他...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
But thank you so much for helping us both physically and emotionally.
This is just a small token of my appreciation.
Thanks again.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
非常感謝你在身體和精神上都幫助了我們。
這只是我的一點心意，聊表謝意。
再次感謝。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Thank you so much for helping us
both physically and emotionally.
Thanks again.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
非常感謝你在身體和精神上都幫助了我們。
再次感謝。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Heh, this kind of thing.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
呵，真是這種事。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
It's the first time this kind of
thing ever happened to us.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
這是第一次發生這種事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As you may have heard, to figure out the thief responsible for this, I will begin my interview with you.
Please give me your best cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想必你也聽說了，為了查明這起盜竊案的兇手，我將開始對你進行詢問。
請全力配合。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't ask twice so
please respond carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只問一次，
請仔細回答。

scripts.text: Where were you coming from?
scripts.translation: 你是從哪裡來的？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I was coming back from
meeting with a friend.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
我剛從和朋友見面的地方回來。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I talked to him about my daughter.
I talked to him about my wife.
I talked to him about life.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
我和他聊了聊我女兒的事。
也聊了聊我妻子的事。
還聊了聊生活。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Then I came back home
and it was a mess.
My wife and daughter were devastated.
And you were lying unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
然後我回到家，發現一片狼藉。
我的妻子和女兒都崩潰了。
而你當時正昏迷不醒。

scripts.text: What kind of friend is he?
scripts.translation: 他是怎樣的朋友？

scripts.text: Did you talk about anything else?
scripts.translation: 你們還聊了什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
He's not anyone particularly mean or bad.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
他並不是什麼特別壞或刻薄的人。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Although he's a bit immature
no matter how much he ages...
To put it positively, he lives young, but to put it negatively, he's just an immature kind of a guy.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
雖然無論長多大，他都挺不成熟的...
往好了說，他活得年輕；往壞了說，他就是個不成熟的人。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Aside from that,
he is no trouble at all.
He's that kind of a friend.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
除此之外，
他完全沒什麼麻煩。
他就是那種朋友。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Actually..
Not too long ago,
the guy asked
me a favor..
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
其實..
不久前，
那傢伙
求了我一個忙..

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
He said he has an urgent need
for some money..
And asked me to help him out..
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
他說他急需一筆錢..
然後讓我幫幫他..

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
So since I didn't have money myself
and it's not the best to exchange money
between friends,
I told him that I was sorry
and sent him off after
treating him to a meal.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
我自己手頭也不寬裕，
而且朋友之間互相借錢也不太合適，
所以我向他道了歉，
請他吃了頓飯就把他送走了。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Aside from that,
I don't see anything
suspicious about him..
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
除此之外，
我覺得他沒有什麼可疑的地方..

scripts.text: Has he been suspicious before?
scripts.translation: 他以前有可疑的行為嗎？

scripts.text: Do you suspect him after the incident?
scripts.translation: 事發後您懷疑他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
To be honest,
I suspect my wife.
She has been complaining about
every little thing recently.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
說實話，
我懷疑的是我妻子。
她最近總是為了一點小事就抱怨。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
No matter what I say, she either says 'no' or 'I don't like it.'
It's not for any specific reason but she just opposes me for
the sake of opposing me.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
不管我說什麼，她要麼說“不”，要麼說“我不喜歡”。
並沒有具體的理由，她就是單純地為了反對而反對。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Recently, she's been asking for this and that, and getting mad about this and that.
It's really been tough.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
最近，她總是這也要那也要，又因為這那而生氣。
真的很難應付。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
The item that was stolen is my wife's necklace...
It's a necklace that I got for her.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
被偷的東西是我妻子的項鍊...
那是我送給她的。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
When the house was robbed I was really worried.
But when I found out that it was the necklace...
I recalled what my wife had told me not too long ago.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
家裡被偷的時候，我非常擔心。
但當我發現被偷的是那條項鍊時...
我想起了妻子不久前對我說的話。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
She said that she wants a new necklace.
I told her that I will buy her one for her next birthday...
She was mad still.
I wonder if this kind of thing happened because of that in the end.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
她說想要一條新項鍊。
我告訴她下個生日我會買給她...
但她還是很生氣。
我想，這件事最後是不是就是因為這個才發生的。

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你的坦誠回答。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Not a problem.
I hope my responses 
will help you.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
沒問題。
希望我的回答能幫到你。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Only if we can
catch that robber soon,
how wonderful that would be.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
只要我們能儘快抓到那個小偷，
那就太好了。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I see you are getting through your field examination.
I ask that you would
give your all.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
看來你正在接受實地考核。
希望你能全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I see you are continuing your investigation.
Are you thinking of 
talking to my friend as well?
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
看來你還在繼續調查。
你打算也去問問我的朋友嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
How is the
investigation going?
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
調查進展如何？

scripts.text:
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 在繼續對話前，我需要減輕負重 -

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I heard most of the story
from Cruyan.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
我從克魯揚那裡
聽說了大部分的事情。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
It was pretty shocking...
but in some ways, I could
see why he did it.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
這讓人挺震驚的...
但在某種程度上，
我也能理解他為什麼會這麼做。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Thank you for helping us
throughout this time.
You went through a lot for us.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
謝謝你這段時間的幫助。
你為我們付出了很多。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I know that it's up to us
from now to figure
things out...
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
我知道接下來
要靠我們自己
去弄清楚事情了...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Here's something for you.
Thanks again and
I hope that all your work
in the future will go well.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
這是給你的。
再次感謝，
希望以後你的工作一切順利。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Thanks again and
I hope that all your work
in the future will go well.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
再次感謝，
希望以後你的工作一切順利。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As you may have heard, to figure out the thief responsible for this,
I will begin my interview with you.
Please give me your best cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想必你也聽說了，為了查明這起盜竊案的幕後黑手，
我將開始對你進行詢問。
請全力配合。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't ask twice so please respond carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只問一次，請仔細回答。

scripts.text: Where were you coming from?
scripts.translation: 你是從哪裡來的？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I don't really trust you
but I'll talk to you for
the sake of my necklace.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我其實不太信任你，
但為了我的項鍊，
我還是願意和你談談。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I was shopping around
in the store nearby
to see if there's anything
I should get.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我本來是在附近的商店裡逛逛，
看看有沒有什麼需要買的東西。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I didn't really have anything 
I liked, so I just came back home.
That's all.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
沒什麼我喜歡的，
所以我就回家了。
就是這樣。

scripts.text: Why did you just go into the house?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼直接進屋了？

scripts.text: Was there anything suspicious?
scripts.translation: 有沒有什麼可疑的地方？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
When I first saw you
lying down, I was shocked
out of my mind, and actually
thought that if you were alive,
I need to do something about it!
I'm not that bad, you know!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
當我第一眼看到你倒在那裡時，
我嚇壞了，
心想如果你還活著，
我得做點什麼才行！
我可不是那種見死不救的人！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
But the world today, is it all that simple?
There are so many kinds of accidents these days!
A feeble housewife like me really can't do much!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
但如今的世界，哪有那麼簡單？
現在的意外事故太多了！
像我這樣手無縛雞之力的家庭主婦，
真的幫不上什麼忙！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
So I first went into the house,
and planned to pick you up
with the rest of my family!
But when I went into the house,
the house was in chaos
as if it was robbed!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
所以我先進了屋，
打算叫上家人一起把你抬起來！
但當我進屋時，
家裡一片狼藉，
像是被搶劫過一樣！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
A person lying at the door!
A robbed house!
I was so scared that
I couldn't go out to get you!
Do you understand me?
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
門口躺著一個人！
家裡被洗劫一空！
我嚇得不敢出去救你！
你明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
When I came into the house,
aside from it being so messy,
there wasn't anything else!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我進屋後，
除了亂糟糟的，
沒發現其他異常！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Of all things, why was my
necklace stolen...?
Why couldn't the robber
just take that useless
dog instead!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
偏偏我的項鍊被偷了...
那個強盜為什麼不去偷那隻沒用的狗呢！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
The more I think about, the more annoying it gets!
......
............
I'm sorry... I was venting
on you for no reason...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
越想越氣！
......
............
對不起...我不該無緣無故
對你發火...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Anyways, I don't think there was
anything peculiar about it.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
總之，我覺得沒什麼特別的地方。

scripts.text: Do you suspect anyone?
scripts.translation: 你懷疑誰嗎？

scripts.text: Is there anything else missing?
scripts.translation: 還有別的東西丟失嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Not sure.
Even though my husband is apathetic to me, he's not a bad person.
My no-good daugther doesn't listen to me when I tell her to break up with her boyfriend.
But she's still a nice girl...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
不確定。
雖然我的丈夫對我很冷淡，但他不是壞人。
我那不爭氣的女兒不聽勸，不肯和男朋友分手。
但她還是個不錯的女孩...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
And it's not that our house is 
filled with expensive items,
and the necklace is one
precious item that I
truly treasure...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
而且我們家也沒什麼貴重的東西，
那條項鍊是我
真正珍視的
寶物之一...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
That's what got robbed!
It's not my family for sure!
There's no way I'd suspect them!
Not at all!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
被偷的就是那個！
肯定不是我們家人乾的！
我絕對不會懷疑他們的！
完全不會！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
We don't have anything in our house that's particularly expensive.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我們家沒有什麼特別貴重的東西。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
In fact, the necklace is also not
all that expensive. But it's just 
that it's an object of multiple
significance...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
其實，那條項鍊也不算太貴。
只是它有著
多重意義...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
It's obvious that the necklace 
is not that pricey.
Even if you sell it..
I don't think it would be all that much.
I have no idea why it was stolen.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
很明顯，那條項鍊並不值錢。
就算把它賣了...
我想也賣不了多少錢。
我不知道為什麼會被偷。

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你的坦誠回答。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I really wish...
that you would find my necklace.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我真的希望...
你能找到我的項鍊。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
That necklace. It's what
my husband got me.. So it's
very important to me.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
那條項鍊。是我丈夫
送給我的...所以對我來說
非常重要。

scripts.text:
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 在繼續對話前，我需要減輕負重 -

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
......
I heard the whole story.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
......
我聽到了整個故事。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I never really liked Cruyan in the first place but I feel more disappointed in my daughter.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我本來就不太喜歡克魯揚，但對我女兒感到更加失望。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I was actually pretty doubtful...
With all that, I sincerely appreciate you for being so helpful.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我其實挺懷疑的...
儘管如此，還是真心感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
But...
It turns out that 
Cruyan or my daughter
don't have the necklace.
For that I'm still pretty upset.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
但是...
結果發現
克魯揚和我女兒
都沒有那條項鍊。
這讓我還是很生氣。

scripts.text:
- While carefully handing -
- Rosa her necklace -
- I tell her where it was found -
scripts.translation:
- 小心地將 -
- 項鍊遞給羅莎 -
- 告訴她項鍊是在哪裡找到的 -

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I see... I didn't know it
was in such a place.
You had already found it but to figure out the truth behind everything.
You kept it all to yourself until now.
I didn't know you put such deep consideration for this...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
原來如此...我不知道它
會在那麼遠的地方。
你早就找到了，但為了查明真相。
你一直把它藏在身邊直到現在。
我不知道你竟然考慮得這麼周到...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I am just
speechless.
Thank you very very much.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我真是
無話可說。
非常感謝，非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I don't have much...
If this is alright with you,
this is just my gratitude.
Thank you very very much.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我沒有多少錢...
如果你不介意的話，
這只是我的一點心意。
非常感謝，非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Oh my. How could this be...?
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
天哪。怎麼會這樣...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I would have never imagined
that our house would be robbed!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我從來沒想過
我們家會被入室盜竊！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
You are going to do a field examination?
Great, do what you need to do!
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
你要進行現場勘查嗎？
太好了，請隨意調查！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
You'll be carrying out your
investigation carefully, right?
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
你會仔細
進行調查的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Is the investigation going
alright...?
Somehow I can't really... trust...
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
調查進展順利嗎...？
我總覺得...不太...放心...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I am just
speechless.
Thank you very very much.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
我真是
無話可說。
非常感謝，非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello.
You must be Luen's boyfriend
who just visited the house, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。
你就是剛剛來家裡拜訪的魯恩的男朋友吧？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Oop.
...
Yes. That's right.
And you are...
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
哎呀。
...
是的，沒錯。
而你是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the detective who 
is responsible for this case.
I have a few questions to ask and I would appreciate your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是負責這個案件的偵探。
我有幾個問題要問，希望你能配合。

scripts.text: Where were you 10 minutes ago?
scripts.translation: 十分鐘前你在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Your possessions are too 
heavy that I can't confirm
my alibi. Please lighten
your load and come back.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
你攜帶的物品太重了，我無法核實你的不在場證明。
請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
At the time, I was in the land of blooming flowers.
I heard that monster infestations are increasing,
so I was just taking care of some as exercise.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
當時，我在花之國度。
聽說那裡魔物氾濫，所以我只是去那裡打怪鍛鍊一下。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I did not steal
the necklace!

scripts.text: Hmm... I don't think so, but...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.

scripts.text:

That's such ludicrous logic!!
Why are you blaming my husband?
Why don't you think straight?!
scripts.translation:

這邏輯太荒謬了！！
為什麼你要指責我的丈夫？

scripts.text: I... I see...
scripts.translation: 我...我明白了...

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
I'm the robber??
No way!!
scripts.translation:
[巴盧明]
我是強盜？？
不可能！！

scripts.text:
{0}
Balumin is
definitely the robber!!
The reason being~!!
Because Dames wouldn't lend him money...
scripts.translation: 因為達姆斯不肯借給他錢...

scripts.text:
{0}
He said that he met with Dames
and that his financial state 
is unstable recently.
And I heard that you secretly
asked to borrow some money.
scripts.translation:
{0}
他說他和達姆斯見過面，
而且達姆斯最近財務狀況不穩定。
我還聽說你私下裡想借點錢。

scripts.text:
{0}
But I know that Dames didn't
lend you money.
And I'm sure that made you
feel disappointed and upset.

{0}
With the financial need,
you ultimately decided
to rob the house!!!!

scripts.translation:
{0}
現在~ 你會向所有人展示項鍊並認罪嗎？

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
This is just unfair!
As you saw earlier,
all I did today was
hunting in the land
of blooming flowers..
scripts.translation:
[巴盧明]
這太不公平了！
正如你之前看到的，
我今天只是在開滿鮮花的土地上打獵...

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
How could I go and
rob the house, too?
scripts.translation:
[巴盧明]
我怎麼可能還去搶劫房子呢？

scripts.text: That's because....
scripts.translation: 那是因為....

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞錯了。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
Besides, Dames and I
are friends of 20 years.
Do you think I'll do
something like that just
for some money?
scripts.translation:
[巴盧明]
而且，我和達姆斯是二十年的朋友。
你覺得我會為了點錢做這種事嗎？

scripts.text: Hmm... I don't think so, but...
scripts.translation: 嗯...我不這麼認為，但是...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞錯了。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
That's right.. There's no way
my friend would do such a thing!!
Even if he did so,
I won't hold him responsible!
It would probably be my fault that
I didn't understand him better.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
沒錯...我的朋友絕對不會做這種事！！
就算他真做了，
我也不會怪他！
大概是因為我不夠了解他，
才會發生這種事吧。

scripts.text: I... I see...
scripts.translation: 我...我明白了...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I'm th... the robber?
That's not fair!!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
我...我是那個小偷？
這也太不公平了！！

scripts.text: Revenge on Luen's parents
scripts.translation: 向露恩的父母復仇

scripts.text: To prepare for his personal expenses
scripts.translation: 為了支付個人開銷

scripts.text: To gain permission to date Luen
scripts.translation: 為了獲得與露恩交往的許可

scripts.text:
{0}
He must have stolen the 
necklace to take revenge on 
the opposition he faced from
Rosa regarding his relationship with Luen!

{0}
As you saw earlier, Rosa would
frequently yell at Cruyan, and
anyone who received that kind of 
treatment will begin developing
some kind of vindictiveness.

[Cruyan]
That's not fair!!
I'm... I'm not the robber!!
Prove it!!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
這也太不公平了！！
我...我不是小偷！！
請證明給我看！！

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I love Luen!!
If I committed such a crime,
I might never be able
to meet Luen again.
Why would I do such 
a crazy thing?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
我愛露恩！！
如果我犯了這種罪，
我可能再也見不到露恩了。
我為什麼要做這種瘋狂的事？

scripts.text: Well, that's because...
scripts.translation: 那是因為...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞錯了。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Besides, if I did such a thing, Luen probably wouldn't like me anymore.
Who would like a guy
that is vindictive against
her own mother?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
而且，如果我做了這種事，露恩大概就不會再喜歡我了。
誰會喜歡一個對她母親心懷怨恨的男人呢？

scripts.text: But...
scripts.translation: 但是...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞錯了。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I want to earn her trust and become a worthy son-in-law.
Why would I do such a reckless thing?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
我想贏得她的信任，成為一個合格的上門女婿。
我為什麼要做這種魯莽的事？

scripts.text: I... I see...
scripts.translation: 我...我明白了...

scripts.text:
{0}
Since you ran out of your
personal money, you
decided to rob the necklace
of your girlfriend's mother!!

{0}
He didn't end just there.
He also stole two
bottles of alcohol as well.

{0}
The Wandering Merchant was 
drunk and you may think he could
have been the culprit, but 
I'm sure it was Cruyan who traded
the alcohol for more gambling
as he ran out of money.
scripts.translation:
{0}
那個流浪商人喝醉了，你可能覺得他是嫌疑人，
但我確信是克魯揚用酒換了更多的賭資，
因為他沒錢了。

scripts.text:
{0}
And the main reason for
his relationship with Luen
being opposed is probably that
he likes such things as gambling
and alcohol. He must have
instinctively commited the crime!!

[Cruyan]
It's true that I like alcohol 
and gambling, but since
Luen's mother doesn't like that,
I've been living a clean life
to earn her trust!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
確實，我喜歡喝酒和賭博，
但既然露恩的母親不喜歡這些，
為了贏得她的信任，
我過著清心寡慾的生活！

scripts.text: Why would I believe that?
scripts.translation: 我為什麼要相信？

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞錯了。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
While that wandering merchant
smells of alcohol, I don't have the
slightest hint of alcohol smell do I!?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
那個流浪商人身上有酒味，
而我身上連一點酒味都沒有，不是嗎！？

scripts.text: But...
scripts.translation: 但是...

scripts.text: I must have gotten something wrong.
scripts.translation: 我一定是搞錯了。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
And I have never seen that merchant before!
Should I ask him?
Whether I gambled
with him or not?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
我從來沒見過那個商人！
我應該問問他嗎？
我到底有沒有和他賭過？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Merchant]
I remember all of my
customers, but
Hmm, I don't think I've
seen Cruyan.
I'm sure of it~ Hiccup~
scripts.translation:
[流浪商人]
我記得我所有的顧客，
嗯，我想我不記得見過克魯揚。
我敢打賭~ 呃~

scripts.text: I... I see...
scripts.translation: 我...我明白了...

scripts.text:
{0}
He committed such a crime
to earn the approval for
his relationship with Luen!

[Mother Rosa]
What... What in the 
world do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[羅莎修女]
什... 什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Heh... Let's first
hear him out.
scripts.translation:
[達姆斯神父]
呵... 先聽聽他怎麼說吧。

scripts.text:
{0}
From the beginning,
Cruyan who likes gambling and alcohol was never liked by Rosa. 
He tried to change himself in a variety of ways, but...

[Cruyan]
Haha... What on earth are you talking about? Huh?
I was hunting in the land of blooming flowers during the time of crime.
The Concentration Potion is the proof.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
哈哈... 你們到底在說什麼？哼？
案發的時候我正在花之國度打獵。
集中藥水就是證明。

scripts.text: I see... Hmm...
scripts.translation: 我明白了... 嗯...

scripts.text: I'm afraid that's not true.
scripts.translation: 恐怕這不是真的。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Of course!
I'm innocent!!
Why don't you find
the real culprit now?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
當然！
我是無辜的！！
你們現在去找出真正的兇手吧？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
What about it is not true?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
哪裡不是真的？

scripts.text: According to Luen's statements...
scripts.translation: 根據露恩的證詞...

scripts.text: According to Balumin's statements...
scripts.translation: 根據巴盧明的證詞...

scripts.text:
{0}
Luen said she definitely
didn't see you before
you came over.

{0}
However, if you were really
hunting in the land
of blooming flowers,
would it have been possible
for you to get from there
to the house in such a short time?
scripts.translation:
{0}
不過，如果你真的在花之國度打獵，
怎麼可能在這麼短的時間內
從那裡趕到這棟房子？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I'm a Laphine!!
Maybe you aren't familiar,
but I have wings and
can fly that kind of distance
in no time!!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
我是拉芬族！！
也許你不熟悉，
但我有翅膀，
瞬間就能飛過那麼遠的距離！！

scripts.text: Oh, I didn't know you could.
scripts.translation: 哦，我不知道你能飛。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I'm innocent!!
Why don't you find
the real culprit now?
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
我是無辜的！！
你們現在去找出真正的兇手吧？

scripts.text:
{0}
Balumin said
that even though he hunted 
in the land of blooming flowers
where you presumably were
hunting also, he never caught
a sight of you.
scripts.translation:
{0}
巴盧明說，
即使他在你據稱也在打獵的
花之國度打獵，
他也從未見過你。

{0}
而且，你作為不在場證明給我的那瓶集中藥水，
並不是在花之國度能買到的東西。
已經確認那是從流浪商人那裡買到的。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Even... Even if that were true,
I don't have the necklace!!
It's true!!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
就算...就算那是真的，
我也沒有那條項鍊！！
我說的是真的！！

scripts.text: Look through his possessions.
scripts.translation: 搜查他的隨身物品。

scripts.text: Explain it without looking.
scripts.translation: 不搜查，直接解釋。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Ok, look through it all you want.
I really don't have the necklace!!
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
好吧，隨便你們怎麼搜。
我真的沒有那條項鍊！！

scripts.text: - You search through Cruyan's possessions -
scripts.translation: - 你搜查了克魯揚的隨身物品 -

scripts.text: - You find nothing -
scripts.translation: - 你什麼也沒找到 -

scripts.text:
{0}
That's because when you
were about to steal the
necklace, you were caught
by Luen.

{0}
Although Luen 
was shocked to see her
boyfriend trying to rob and 
going through the house,
she got to hear his side of
the story.
scripts.translation:
{0}
雖然露恩看到男友試圖入室行竊
感到震驚，
但她還是聽了他這邊的說法。

scripts.text:
{0}
She must have sympathized
with how you felt, but probably
disagreed with you. She must 
have physically resisted you 
trying to steal the necklace, and
in the process, the necklace was lost...
scripts.translation:
{0}
她一定對你當時的感受產生了同情，
但可能並不認同你的做法。她一定
在身體上阻止了你偷項鍊，
在這個過程中，項鍊丟失了...

scripts.text:
{0}
And that's when I was coming in
from outside. And since you
didn't want to be caught,
you knocked me out...
scripts.translation:
{0}
就在那時，我從外面走了進來。
由於你不想被抓，
你就把我打暈了...

scripts.text:
{0}
You were both afraid of
what might have happened to me..
The necklace was lost in the process..
And since your parents were about
to return home, you hurriedly
left the house.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你們兩人都害怕
我可能會遭遇不測...
項鍊在這個過程中丟失了...
而且因為你的父母
快要回家了，你匆忙離開了房子。

scripts.text:
{0}
You tried to do something
with me, but Rosa was
already on her way back at
the time, so you couldn't do anything.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你試圖對我做什麼，
但當時羅莎已經在回來的路上了，
所以你什麼也沒做成。

scripts.text:
{0}
And Cruyan, as soon as you
got to the house, you said
that the necklace was stolen.
How did you know that when
nobody had told you
about it?
scripts.translation:
{0}
而克魯揚，你一回到家，
就說項鍊被偷了。
既然沒人告訴過你這件事，
你怎麼會知道？

{0}
混亂的傢俱，
沒有對竊賊吠叫的波比，
以及露恩和克魯揚在震驚中編造的拙劣藉口，
如果你順著這些線索追查...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Stop... Please stop...
I don't want to be even more miserable
than I already am...
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
停...請停下來...
我不想讓自己變得更慘了...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Yes... I am the thief...
I won't try to 
justify that.
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
是的...我就是那個小偷...
我不會試圖為自己辯解。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
As for Luen... my girlfriend
did nothing wrong..
It's all my fault..
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
至於露恩...我的女朋友
沒有任何錯..
一切都是我的錯..

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
The rest of this,
I'll confess and explain everything..
And I'll make my apologies...
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
剩下的部分，
我會坦白並解釋一切...
我會道歉...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I ask you...
Please don't involve yourself any further...
scripts.translation:
[克魯揚]
拜託你...
請不要再捲入其中了...

scripts.text:
{0}
I... I guess
I must have gotten something wrong.
I'll think about it more and figure out who the robber is...
scripts.translation:
{0}
我...我想我一定是
弄錯了什麼。
我會再仔細想想，
查出那個小偷是誰...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Thank you for lightening 
our burdens...
Cruyan and I will resolve
the rest of this issue.
Would you please go outside now?
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
謝謝你幫我們減輕了負擔...
我和克魯揚會解決剩下的問題。
請你現在出去好嗎？

scripts.text: Leave the house.

scripts.text: Leave after a bit.

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Thank you for everything...
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
謝謝你做的一切...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Please let us know
when you're leaving.
scripts.translation:
[女兒 露恩]
請在你離開時
告訴我們一聲。

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女兒 露恩]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
