scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Oww, my stomach hurts!!
What are you looking at?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎喲，我肚子好痛！！
你在看什麼？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Oww, my stomach hurts!!
Aren't Green Herbs so common?
I can't believe they're not in stock!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎喲，我肚子好痛！！
綠色藥草不是很常見嗎？
居然沒貨，真不敢相信！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Hmm...I'm sure I took the right medicine...
but why isn't it getting better?
Maybe it's not just a stomachache?
Could it be that I have...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯...我確定我吃了正確的藥...
但為什麼不見好？
也許不僅僅是胃痛？
難道我得了...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Cecilia is so random
She already knows that I like books...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
塞西莉亞真隨性，
她居然已經知道我喜歡看書了...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Did I read any books recently?
Umm...yea, I read a lot usually.
I don't have anything else to do at the clinic.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我最近有看書嗎？
嗯...是的，我平時看得很多。
在診所裡我也沒什麼別的事可做。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Is Cecilia investing something?
Right? Isn't she? Am I right? Right?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
塞西莉亞是不是在搞什麼鬼？
對吧？不是嗎？我說得對吧？對吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Well, then...
Should I start punishing Dominic for giving a stomachache to this beautiful lady!!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
那麼...
我要開始懲罰多米尼克了，居然讓這位美麗的女士胃痛！！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Are you done yet?
I'm tired of waiting~
Let's hurry it up a little more.
Pranks are not fun if you think about it too much.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
好了嗎？
我都等煩了~
動作快一點啦。
惡作劇想太多就不好玩了。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I'm all ready here.
Now, I mix what you brought like this, and...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我這邊都準備好了。
現在，把你帶來的東西像這樣混合一下，然後...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Hmm? It's weird.
There's something weird about you.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯？有點奇怪。
你身上有股奇怪的味道。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Have we...have we succeeded at last?!
Now, go plant this secretly around Dominic's bookshelves.
If he finds random weeds growing near the bookshelves he'll be so mad, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我們...我們終於成功了嗎？！
現在，悄悄地把這個種在多米尼克書架周圍。
如果他發現書架旁邊莫名其妙長出了雜草，肯定會氣瘋的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Kekeke, I could hear Dominic screaming from here.
Is he really upset now?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿嘿，我都能聽到多米尼克在尖叫了。
他真的很生氣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Poor little Dominic he won't dare mess with me again.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
可憐的小多米尼克，他再也不敢惹我了。

scripts.text: [Eirinn]
scripts.translation: [艾琳]

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I haven't really eaten anything unusual these days but why am I getting stomach aches so often!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我最近沒吃什麼奇怪的東西，為什麼總是胃痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I haven't really eaten anything unusual these days but why am I getting stomach aches so often!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我最近沒吃什麼奇怪的東西，為什麼總是胃痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Are you still there?
Good, you came at just the right moment.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你還在嗎？
很好，你來得正是時候。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I was going to get a perscription for my stomachache but, they don't have herbs for it in the warehouse anymore.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我本來想去開個胃痛的藥方，但倉庫裡已經沒有那種藥草了。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Just like an old saying,
'Even green herbs are difficult to find when you need them.'
Could you go out and find herbs and things like that?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
就像那句老話說的，
“急需時，連綠色藥草都難找。”
你能出去找找藥草之類的東西嗎？

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 為什麼我要這麼做？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Fine, then don't bother me
and go away.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
好吧，那就別煩我了，
快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I need
^ff000010 Green Herbs^000000
I hope you hurry before Eclage is filled with the sounds of my groaning.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我需要
^ff000010 綠色藥草^000000
希望你在埃克拉珠充滿我呻吟聲之前快點回來。

scripts.text: Give Herbs
scripts.translation: 給予藥草

scripts.text: Go somewhere else.
scripts.translation: 去別的地方

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Didn't your kindergarten teacher tell you?
'Lying is bad!'
I wonder if she said something about helping those in need, too.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你的幼兒園老師沒教過你嗎？
“說謊是不對的！”
不知道她有沒有說過要幫助有需要的人。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Ah, thank you so much!
I'll prepare my medicine then.
I hope it helps...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
啊，太感謝你了！
那我去準備藥了。
希望能有用...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
By the way, I was looking through the warehouse and I found some herbs. They're not for stomachaches so, I'll give you some to repay your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
對了，我翻倉庫的時候發現了一些藥草。雖然治不了胃痛，但為了報答你的好意，我送你一些吧。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
You can usually find them around here but it's really effective, so a lot of the adventurers like them.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
通常在這裡都能找到，不過效果真的很好，所以很多冒險者都喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Something serious? Like, something untreatable??
Am I going to be like the leading actress who plays a tragic role in a soap opera?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
很嚴重？比如，治不好的那種？？
難道我要像肥皂劇裡演悲劇角色的女主角一樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
If you remember any other stories, tell me again.
and if you remember, ask Cecilia why she asked such a question.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
如果你還記得其他的故事，再告訴我一遍。
如果記得的話，問問塞西莉亞為什麼問這種問題。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Ah, before I had this stomach ache,
I borrowed a book.
It was about where you came from and it was really interesting. But why?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
啊，在我胃痛之前，
我借了一本書。
那是關於你從哪來的，真的很有趣。但是為什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Cecilia is so random
She already knows that I like books...
Anyway, tell her I said so.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
塞西莉亞真隨性
她明明知道我喜歡書...
總之，替我告訴她我這麼說了。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Wing for wing, feeler for feeler, and trick for trick!
This is our law.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
翅膀對翅膀，觸角對觸角，詭計對詭計！
這就是我們的法則。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Since Dominic takes good care of the bookshelves, should I make a mess around that area to annoy him?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
既然多米尼克很愛護書架，我要不要在那附近弄得一團糟來惹他生氣？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Okay, I've decided.
Let me ask you another favor, please?
Could you bring me a plant stem and Green Herb, one each?
I'm going to do some magic here.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
好的，我決定了。
請再幫我一個忙好嗎？
能幫我帶一根植物莖和綠色藥草，各一個嗎？
我要在這裡施法。

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 為什麼我要這麼做？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Umm...I guess I can't help it if you don't want to.
I should look for someone else...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯...如果你不願意的話，我也沒辦法。
我應該去找別人...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
It's very simple, so it shouldn't take that long, right?
I'll be preparing here, so hurry and make a quick trip!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
很簡單，應該不會花太長時間，對吧？
我會在準備，快去快回吧！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
What I need is a stem of the plant and Green Herb, one each.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我需要一根植物莖和綠色藥草，各一個。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Ta-da~
A simple summoning tool: sprout is finished!
It's available for everyone~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
噹噹~
簡單的召喚工具：嫩芽完成了！
大家都能用~

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Scripts written by Eirinn!
Featuring{0}!
The villain's role played by Dominic
We're all here and the props are ready!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
艾琳編劇！
主演{0}！
多米尼克飾演反派
大家都到齊了，道具也準備好了！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Now if we plant this secretly around the bookshelves that Dominic is taking care of, our mission is completed!
If he finds random weeds growing near the bookshelves he'll be so mad, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
現在如果我們悄悄地把這個種在多米尼克照顧的書架周圍，任務就完成了！
如果他在書架附近發現長出的雜草，肯定會很生氣，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Come on, it's no fun if you take too much time.
Let's go and do this thing!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
快點，花太多時間就沒意思了。
我們去辦這件事吧！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Now, take this again and don't forget to plant it secretly around Dominic's bookshelves.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
現在，再把這個拿好，別忘了悄悄種在多米尼克的書架周圍。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Come on, it's no fun if you take too much time.
Let's go and do this thing!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
快點，花太多時間就沒意思了。
我們去辦這件事吧！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Too bad I couldn't see for myself how he was creating a scene there.
I should try it again later.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
真可惜，我沒親眼看到他在那裡大鬧一場。
以後應該再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
How strange. I've been losing my stuff recently like things I put in my pocket or even the things I put away properly.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
真奇怪。最近我老是丟東西，比如放進口袋裡的，或者明明收好的東西。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Uh oh, you... didn't you promise
to give a good spanking to the little guys outside?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
哎呀，你...你不是答應過要狠狠教訓外面那些小傢伙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You'll see them right outside the door so I don't have to tell you the exact location right?
Give the 20 fairies outside what they deserve and come back, please~
scripts.translation:
[波本]
它們就在門外，不用我告訴你具體位置吧？
去把外面那20只妖精好好教訓一頓，然後回來，拜託了~

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Hmm? You're done already?
Puhahahah!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嗯？你已經搞定了？
噗哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
How strange...
I can't find my pen anywhere.
I've been using it pretty often...
Who would have done this to me...
scripts.translation:
[波本]
真奇怪...
我到處都找不到我的筆。
我明明經常用它...
是誰對我做了這種事...

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
All of a sudden, people from Midgard started to visit Eclage more and more.
So, we're getting information about Midgard as well and I'm interested, too.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
突然之間，來自米德加爾特的人開始頻繁造訪埃克拉珠。
所以我們也在收集關於米德加爾特的情報，我也很感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Books? Well, I like books a lot.
There are many books on Midgard that just came out recently so I read them myself.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
書？嗯，我很喜歡書。
最近米德加爾特出版了很多新書，所以我自己也讀了一些。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Hmm...I smell it...
I smell something fun going on here...
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嗯...我聞到了...
我聞到這裡有什麼有趣的事情正在發生...

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
A real gentleman should give what he has received!
I will not tolerate this.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
真正的紳士應該回報他所收到的！
我絕不容忍這種事。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Wooo, I'm on fire!!
My whole body is filled with the spirit of pranks!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
哇哦，我熱血沸騰了！！
我的全身都充滿了惡作劇的精神！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Good!
I'm ready as well.
Let's see...it's been a while since the last time I used a material conversion spell.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
很好！
我也準備好了。
讓我看看...距離我上次使用物質轉換魔法已經有一段時間了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
No, something's weird here.
I feel like there's something wrong.
Ah, whatever! Take this anyway.
I don't want to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
不，這裡有些不對勁。
我感覺有什麼地方有問題。
啊，算了！反正拿著吧。
我不想再想這些了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Throw what you received in front of Dominic.
It'll become a rat and start moving around him.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
把你收到的東西扔在多米尼克面前。
它會變成一隻老鼠，然後在他身邊亂跑。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Ahah~by the way,
What could Dominic have done about the rat?
It wouldn't come back at me like a boomerang, would it?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
啊哈~順便問一下，
多米尼克能拿那隻老鼠怎麼辦？
它不會像迴旋鏢一樣飛回我身上吧？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I hope he learned that I'm a step above him when it's comes to pranking, so that he won't try to mess with me again.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我希望他明白，在惡作劇方面我比他高出一籌，這樣他就不會再試圖捉弄我了。

scripts.text: [Bourbon]
scripts.translation: [波本]

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Right, I'm sure the little pranksters outside are doing this to me.
They must have taken my stuff while I wasn't here.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
沒錯，肯定是外面那些小搗蛋鬼在搞鬼。
他們一定趁我不在的時候拿走了我的東西。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I would like to teach them a lesson but I have a work to do and I can't go anywhere.
And if I leave for personal reasons like this I'll get in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我想教訓他們一頓，但我有工作要做，不能離開。
如果我因為這種私人原因離開，我會惹上麻煩的。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
So, you're here just in time!
Could you teach the little gangsters outside, a lesson on my behalf?
How does that sound, will you?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
所以，你來得正好！
你能替我教訓一下外面那些小流氓嗎？
怎麼樣，願意嗎？

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 為什麼我要這麼做？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Hmm, I guess I can't force you.
I should look for someone else...
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嗯，我想我也不能強迫你。
我應該找別人...

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Good, you promised.
Go outside and give 20 fairies what they deserve.
Then I'll feel much better.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
很好，你答應了。
去外面把那20只妖精好好教訓一頓。
那樣我會感覺好多了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You'll see them right outside the door so I don't have to tell you the exact location right?
Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[波本]
它們就在門外，不用我告訴你具體位置吧？
祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I think something went wrong here.
Could you talk to me again?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我覺得這裡出了點問題。
你能再和我談談嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Good luck, then.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
那麼，祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You need to brush off your clothes.
You have feathers all over.
Would it have been that hard...?
Hmm, it seems like you've suffered badly. Let me give you a reward.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
你得把衣服上的羽毛拍掉。
你身上全是羽毛。
這很難嗎...？
嗯，看來你受了不少苦。讓我給你一點獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Anyway, thanks.
But I feel like somebody took my pen while you were gone...who could it be...?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
總之，謝謝。
但我感覺你不在的時候有人拿走了我的筆...會是誰呢...？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
It doesn't seem like a perfect place to live but it definitely sounds like a fun place.
I wonder if there's any new book that came out...
I should go check.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
這裡似乎不是完美的居住地，但聽起來確實是個有趣的地方。
不知道有沒有什麼新書出版...
我應該去看看。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I was interested seeing how there's a sudden influx of visitors from your village into Eclage.
It doesn't seem like a perfect place to live but it definitely sounds like a fun place.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我很好奇，為什麼突然有很多來自你村莊的人湧入埃克拉珠。
這裡似乎不是完美的居住地，但聽起來確實是個有趣的地方。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Let's see what Dominic hates the most...
Ahah~I'm all fired up.
My name is Bourbon a real prankster from birth.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
讓我看看多米尼克最討厭什麼...
啊哈~我興奮起來了。
我叫波本，是個天生的惡作劇者。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I'm sure he said he hates something small, swift, and with a long tail.
The more I think about doesn't it sound like a...rat?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我記得他說他討厭某種小而快、長著長尾巴的東西。
我越想越覺得，這聽起來像...老鼠？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Right, it's a rat. Nothing's going to stop me now.
I shall release some rats then!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
沒錯，是老鼠。現在沒有什麼能阻止我了。
我要釋放一些老鼠！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
...but come to think of it there are no rats here, right?
Let me ask you another favor.
This is a matter of my pride. Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
...不過仔細想想，這裡沒有老鼠，對吧？
讓我再求你個忙。
這關乎我的尊嚴。你會幫我的，對吧？

scripts.text: I'd rather not...
scripts.translation: 我不想...

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
What? How could you!
Can't you hear my heart beating like a drum?
It's not reasonable if you pretend not to see and turn your back on me.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
什麼？你怎麼能這樣！
你聽不到我的心跳像鼓一樣嗎？
如果你假裝沒看見並背過身去，那是不合理的。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Now that's the spirit!
You're just like me a cheeky little monkey!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
這才對嘛！
你就像我一樣，是個調皮的小猴子！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I'll fill you in on the details once we're done preparing and what we need right now is 2 rat tails
Obviously we don't have rats here so it might take you sometime to find one.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
等我們準備完畢，我會告訴你細節。現在我們需要2根鼠尾。
顯然這裡沒有老鼠，所以你可能需要花點時間去找。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Thanks, my friend.
Hahahahaha!
We're already in the same camp.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
謝謝，我的朋友。
哈哈哈哈！
我們已經站在同一邊了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
...umm?
You couldn't find any rat tails yet?
I know it's pretty hard but I'm counting on you, my friend!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
...嗯？
你還沒找到鼠尾嗎？
我知道這很難，但我指望你了，我的朋友！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You see, this is just a small tail right now but it'll be a great...
well, it's just a rat and not a 'great' rat after all but still, with a mysterious power
scripts.translation:
[波本]
你看，現在這只是個小尾巴，但它會成為很棒的...
嗯，畢竟它只是一隻老鼠，不是一隻“偉大”的老鼠，但依然擁有神秘的力量。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Shazam! The spell is now done.
Throw what you received next to Dominic!
It'll become a rat and start moving around him.
This completes our 'mission'!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
沙扎姆！咒語完成了。
把你收到的東西扔在多米尼克旁邊！
它會變成一隻老鼠，並開始在他周圍走動。
這就完成了我們的“任務”！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
hehehe...
I'm soooo excited.
What are you doing? Go!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嘿嘿嘿...
我太興奮了。
你在幹什麼？快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Throw this in front of Dominic.
It'll become a rat and start moving around him.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
把這個扔在多米尼克面前。
它會變成一隻老鼠，並開始在他周圍走動。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
hehehe....
I'm soooo excited.
What are you doing? Go!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嘿嘿嘿...
我太興奮了。
你在幹什麼？快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I'm sure Dominic couldn't have movednot even a finger.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我敢打賭，多米尼克連一根手指頭都動不了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I hope he learned that I'm a step above him when it's comes to pranking, so that he won't try to mess with me again.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我希望他明白，在惡作劇方面我比他高出一籌，這樣他就不會再試圖捉弄我了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Mm...mm... what should I do...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
嗯...嗯...我該怎麼辦...

scripts.text: - She seems too busy to talk to you. -
scripts.translation: - 她似乎太忙了，沒空和你說話。 -

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Mm...mm...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
嗯...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
What should I do?
No matter how many times I check some items are missing...
Is it because of the wanderers randomly showing up in town nowadays?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我該怎麼辦？
不管檢查多少次，總有些物品不見了...
是因為最近經常有浪姬舞者隨機出現在鎮上嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Hey~ hey~ listen!
Hey you, what are you doing over there?
You heard everything I said just now didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
嘿~ 嘿~ 聽著！
喂，你在那邊幹什麼呢？
剛才我說的話你都聽到了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It can't be that we have thieves in Eclage.
The more I think about it seems like an outsider is responsible for this.
Don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
不可能是在埃克拉珠出現了盜賊。
越想越覺得是外人在搞鬼。
你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
For that reason you, who knows that our supplies are missing and who happens to be an outsider as well.
Must be a thief!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
因此，你，一個知道我們物資丟失且恰好是外人的傢伙。
一定是盜賊！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You have the right to have an attorney present and... no, never mind.
Let's hear what you have to say after putting you in prison first.
Here, you're accused of stealing how do you feel now?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你有權要求律師在場... 不，算了。
先把你關進監獄，再聽聽你有什麼要說的。
喂，你被指控偷竊，現在感覺如何？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You see, we suffer an unforeseen misfortune in life sometimes.
We're all like that.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你看，生活中難免會遇到意想不到的不幸。
大家都一樣。

scripts.text: [Cecilia]
scripts.translation: [塞西莉亞]

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, you want to exercise your right and just remain silent?
Let's see how long you can hold your tongue!
I have an idea. Do you want to hear about it?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
哦，你想行使權利保持沉默？
讓我看看你能憋多久！
我有個主意。想聽聽嗎？

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Here's your last chance!
It's something that could save both of us.
You want to hear about it?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
這是你最後的機會！
這是能救我們倆的事。
你想聽聽嗎？

scripts.text: I don't want to!
scripts.translation: 我不想聽！

scripts.text: Fine.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, well!
Then I'll have to hand you over to prove my innocence.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
哦，好吧！
那我只能把你交出去，以證明我的清白。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What kind of a fairy is this, so immoral?!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（這是什麼妖精，這麼不道德?!）

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Now, should I start to plant evidence on you?
You just need three fairies to make up anything even if it's the Yggdrasil Tree.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
現在，我該開始在你身上栽贓了嗎？
只要三個妖精，哪怕是世界樹也能編出來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Maybe I should just run away.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（也許我該直接逃跑。）

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
There's a simple and ordinary solution for this.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
解決這個問題有一個簡單又普通的方法。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
That is you finding what's missing and refilling the shelves.
I can't go anywhere because I have to look after the warehouse.
It's better to take some trouble than being accused of stealing, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你要做的就是找出缺失的物品，並把貨架補滿。
我得看著倉庫，不能離開。
與其被指控偷竊，不如多費點手腳，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Let me tell you what you need to find.
First of all, ^66000010 Piles of Acorns^000000, ^66000010 Worn Out Pages^000000, and lastly, ^66000010 Mould Powders^000000.
It's strange how 10 of each item are missing exactly...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
讓我告訴你需要找什麼。
首先，^66000010堆橡果^000000、^66000010頁破舊的書頁^000000，最後是^66000010黴菌粉末^000000。
奇怪的是，每種物品恰好都少了10個...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
We're in the same boatnow.
Technically, we call it 'accomplices'.
Now, good luck!
You'll be able to find them easily around here.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我們現在是一條船上的螞蚱了。
嚴格來說，這叫“共犯”。
那麼，祝你好運！
你應該能在附近很容易找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You didn't get caught, right?
Let's see what you have then...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你沒被抓到吧？
讓我看看你帶了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It's still not enough...
You didn't forget what I asked for, did you?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
還是不夠...
你沒忘記我讓你找什麼吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You're more skilled than I thought.
Everything is as written in the books now.
So, we're both safe.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你比我想像的更熟練。
現在一切都和賬本上寫的一樣了。
所以，我們都安全了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You need to find Piles of Acorns, Worn Out Pages, and Mould Powders, 10 of each.
Don't forget this time.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你需要找10堆橡果、10頁破舊的書頁和10份黴菌粉末。
這次別再忘了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
When you come back again you'd better be bringing everything we need.
If they find out that some items are missing, then...
No, I don't want to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
下次回來時，最好把所有需要的東西都帶齊。
如果他們發現有些物品不見了，那麼...
不，我不想往那方面想。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
We're in this together so I don't have to thank you, right?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
既然我們是一條船上的，我就不必謝你了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I'll go check if there's anything else missing as well.
It's so strange how these missing items were all very trivial.
Besides, exactly 10 of each item were stolen.
I feel like this is more than just a theft.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我去檢查一下是否還有其他東西缺失。
奇怪的是，這些丟失的物品都很瑣碎。
而且，每種物品恰好都少了10個。
我覺得這不僅僅是偷竊那麼簡單。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
How strange...
I'm sure I organized everything but why is it so messy here.
Could it be that someone really hates me...?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
真奇怪...
我明明整理過一切，為什麼這裡這麼亂。
難道真的有人很討厭我嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, by the way,
I heard you met Eirinn and Bourbon.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
哦，對了，
我聽說你遇到了艾琳和波本。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I heard Eirinn has a stomachache and I also heard that you helped Bourbon find lost items.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我聽說艾琳胃痛，還聽說你幫波本找到了丟失的物品。

scripts.text: - Cecilia seems to be lost in deep thought -
scripts.translation: - 塞西莉亞似乎陷入了沉思 -

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
If things that have never happened before happened, then there's something new going on.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
如果以前從未發生過的事情發生了，那就說明有新情況。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Now, shall we go find out what it is?
This time, it's not a theft, of course.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
那麼，我們要去弄清楚那是什麼嗎？
當然，這次不是偷竊。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Could you go ask Eirinn and Bourbon about reading books?
Ask them if they have borrowed or read any books recently.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你能去問問艾琳和波本關於讀書的事嗎？
問問他們最近是否借過或讀過什麼書。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Could you go ask Eirinn and Bourbon about reading books?
Ask them if they have borrowed or read any books recently.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你能去問問艾琳和波本關於讀書的事嗎？
問問他們最近是否借過或讀過什麼書。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I met both of them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我兩個都遇到了。

scripts.text: ^000088You tellCecilia what Eirinn and Bourbon said.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000088你告訴塞西莉亞艾琳和波本說了什麼。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Mmm, I see.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
嗯，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
So, they have recently borrowed and read books, too?
Good, this solves the mystery!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
所以，他們最近也借書並閱讀了嗎？
很好，這就解開了謎團！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I borrowed some books as well to learn about people from Midgard since there are so many visitors coming from that area lately.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我也借了一些書，因為最近有很多來自米德加爾特的訪客，我想了解一下那裡的人。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Eirinn, Bourbon, and I have one thing in common.
That is, we all read books recently.
But I don't understand why that brought bad luck to all three of us.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
艾琳、波本和我有一個共同點。
那就是我們最近都讀了書。
但我不明白為什麼這給三個人都帶來了厄運。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I have a feeling that Dominic might know something.
He might know...or...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我有一種感覺，多米尼克可能知道些什麼。
他可能知道...或者...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Eirinn, Bourbon, and I have one thing in common.
That is, we all read books recently.
But I don't understand why that brought bad luck to all three of us.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
艾琳、波本和我有一個共同點。
那就是我們最近都讀了書。
但我不明白為什麼這給三個人都帶來了厄運。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, did you visit Dominic by any chance?
Dominic takes care of the bookshelves and I feel like he might know something.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
哦，你碰巧去見過多米尼克了嗎？
多米尼克負責管理書架，我覺得他可能知道些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, and as the manager of the warehouse let me give you something in return.
You found lost items and helped here and there...so, think of it as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
哦，作為倉庫管理員，讓我給你一些回報吧。
你找回了失物，又在這裡幫忙...就當作是獎勵吧。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You'll be able to read as many books as you want from the bookshelves in the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
你可以隨意閱讀廣場上書架裡的任何書籍。

scripts.text: [Cecilia]
scripts.translation: [塞西莉亞]

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I have a feeling that Dominic might know something.
He might know...or...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我有一種感覺，多米尼克可能知道些什麼。
他可能知道...或者...

scripts.text: Tell Cecilia about Dominic.
scripts.translation: 告訴塞西莉亞關於多米尼克的事

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
So I was right.
It was somebody's prank.
Dominic has always been like that so petty and strange.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
所以我猜對了。
這是某人的惡作劇。
多米尼克一直都很小氣且古怪。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I hope you don't misunderstand us.
Most of the residents in Eclage;
No, an absolute majority of the residents here are never against outsiders.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
希望你們不要誤會我們。
埃克拉珠的大多數居民；
不，這裡的絕大多數居民都從不排斥外來者。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It's just Dominic who's acting very weirdly so I hope you don't have a prejudice against us.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
只是多米尼克表現得非常奇怪，希望你們不要因此對我們產生偏見。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Anyway, now that I found out about it,
I shouldn't just sit silently!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
總之，既然我已經查明瞭真相，
我就不應該只是沉默地坐在這裡！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Let's start planning for revenge, shall we?
I'll give Eirinn and Bourbon notice in advance.
You should go talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
讓我們開始計劃復仇吧？
我會提前通知艾琳和波本。
你應該去和他們談談。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I'll get permission from above so that you can read any books from the bookshelves that Dominic is in charge of.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
我會向上面申請許可，讓你可以閱讀多米尼克負責的那些書架上的任何書籍。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It's about where you came from and I'm sure you'll like it.
If your perspective on something changes, the way you evaluate that object changes as well.
Explore Midgard from our perspective~!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
這是關於你來自哪裡的內容，我相信你會喜歡的。
如果你對某事物的看法改變了，你評價該事物的方式也會隨之改變。
從我們的視角來探索米德加爾特吧~！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Hope you have a good time in Eclage.
I have to take inventory now,
so I can't talk to you anymore, sorry~
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞]
祝你在埃克拉珠玩得開心。
我現在必須去盤點庫存了，
所以不能再和你多聊了，抱歉~

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Mmm...what do you want?
I won't stop you from walking around in Eclage but I hope you don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嗯...你想要什麼？
我不會阻止你在埃克拉珠四處走動，但希望你不要打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I won't stop you from walking around in Eclage but, don't bother me you outsider!
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我不會阻止你在埃克拉珠四處走動，但別打擾我，你這個外來者！

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Bah, tell them if you want to!
I'm not scared at all.
They should know how scary I can be.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
哼，你想告訴他們就告訴他們吧！
我一點都不害怕。
他們應該知道我可以有多可怕。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I feel...something's not right.
I feel like something bad is going to happen any minute...
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我總覺得...有什麼不對勁。
感覺隨時都會有壞事發生...

scripts.text: Cecilia says...
scripts.translation: 塞西莉亞說...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Cecilia told me that someone's fooling around with people who borrowed books recently.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
塞西莉亞告訴我，最近有人在惡作劇，針對那些借閱書籍的人。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Huh? Kekeke.
In principle, people living here in the capital of Eclage are not supposed to discriminate against outsiders, but not everyone is like that.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
哈？呵呵呵。
原則上，住在埃克拉珠首都的人不應該歧視外來者，但也不是每個人都這樣。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I hate it so much when people in Eclage are talking about Midgard.
Why are they so fascinated about foreign areas when this place is perfect and peaceful.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我真的很討厭埃克拉珠的人談論米德加爾特。
既然這裡如此完美和平，他們為什麼對外地那麼著迷呢。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I don't like fairies here writing about Midgard nowadays and I hate how those books are distributed far and wide.
So, I decided to play a little trick on them.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我不喜歡這裡的精靈最近寫關於米德加爾特的內容，更討厭那些書被廣泛傳播。
所以，我決定給他們一點小小的惡作劇。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Bah, tell them if you want to!
I'm not scared at all.
They should know how scary I can be.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
哼，你想告訴他們就告訴他們吧！
我一點都不害怕。
他們應該知道我可以有多可怕。

scripts.text: - Do you want to throw the rat tail? -
scripts.translation: - 你要扔出鼠尾嗎？ -

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: - The rat tail became a rat even before hitting the ground. -
scripts.translation: - 鼠尾在落地前變成了一隻老鼠。 -

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
What, where did it come from out of the blue!
I'm sure people from Midgard brought it here!
You little filthy thing, ah!
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
什麼，這東西哪來的！
肯定是米德加爾特的人帶來的！
你這骯髒的小東西，啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(His reaction is not that fun.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（他的反應並不怎麼有趣。）

scripts.text: - You were told to plant weeds. -
scripts.translation: - 你被要求種植雜草。 -

scripts.text: Don't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做

scripts.text: Do it.
scripts.translation: 開始吧。

scripts.text: - Plant weeds secretly . -
scripts.translation: - 偷偷種植雜草。 -

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Hey, what are you doing over there?
You'd better not be doing anything weird.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嘿，你在那邊幹什麼？
最好別做什麼奇怪的事。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Mmm...what the...
Why are weeds growing here?
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嗯...這什麼...
為什麼這裡會長出雜草？

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Well, I don't care.
I guess there's no such thing as 'weeds.' Every plant is special in its own way.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
好吧，我不在乎。
我想不存在所謂的“雜草”。每株植物都有其獨特之處。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What's up with his reaction?)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（他的反應是怎麼回事？）

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本書，伸手去拿。我想那是關於米德加爾特的內容。 -

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Hey, outsider who said you can touch my books?
Stay away from my bookshelves!
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嘿，外來者，誰讓你碰我的書了？
離我的書架遠點！

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about cities in Rune-Midgarts. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本書，伸手去拿。我想那是關於盧恩·米德加茲城市的內容。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 離書架遠點

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看書架上的書

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不該讀它的。

scripts.text: Prontera, the capital of Rune-Midgarts, is filled with beautiful buildings that were thoroughly designed.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉是盧恩·米德加茲的首都，這裡充滿了設計精美的宏偉建築。

scripts.text: Here, they have a leader called 'king,' who used to arrange marriages.
scripts.translation: 這裡有一位被稱為“國王”的首領，過去曾負責安排婚姻。

scripts.text: There are many arenas, in which warriors race and wrestle to compete with each other.
scripts.translation: 這裡有許多競技場，戰士們在那裡賽跑和摔跤，互相競爭。

scripts.text: The group of winners are supposedly to get some kind of rewards, but seems like it lost its popularity nowadays.
scripts.translation: 據說獲勝者會獲得某種獎勵，但如今似乎已經不再流行了。

scripts.text: You need to be careful because there are some people in Prontera with superhuman powers.
scripts.translation: 你需要小心，因為普隆德拉有一些擁有超能力的人。

scripts.text: They're able to destroy any type of weapons or armors with a few punches, and what they use for that is just a small hammer.
scripts.translation: 他們能用幾拳摧毀任何型別的武器或盔甲，而他們使用的工具只是一把小錘子。

scripts.text: I don't understand why adventurers keep laying tools at their feet. Could it be that they're priests and people are offering a tribute to them?
scripts.translation: 我不明白為什麼冒險者總是把工具放在腳邊。難道他們是牧師，人們是在向他們供奉嗎？

scripts.text: There's a village called Payon in the forest. It has a place called 'Palace' as well, although its purpose is unclear.
scripts.translation: 在普勒斯特森林裡有一個叫斐揚的村莊。那裡也有一個被稱為“宮殿”的地方，雖然其用途不明。

scripts.text: Maybe it's a place used before Prontera became the capital of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation: 也許那是普隆德拉成為盧恩·米德加茲首都之前使用的地方...

scripts.text: Humans, too, establish border towns close to the boundary of their residential area, and the city of Aldebaran is one of them.
scripts.translation: 人類也會在居住區邊界附近建立邊境城鎮，阿爾貝塔就是其中之一。

scripts.text: In the middle of the village, there are clock-shaped monsters living in a clock tower. Further investigation is needed to find out why monsters appear in the middle of the village.
scripts.translation: 在村莊中央，有一座鐘樓，裡面住著鐘形的魔物。需要進一步調查為什麼魔物會出現在村莊中央。

scripts.text: Although it's called a clock tower, there are more monsters inside than clocks. I personally count them my self, I really did!
scripts.translation: 雖然叫鐘樓，但裡面的魔物比鍾還多。我親自數過，真的！

scripts.text: Geffen, a city built by great wizards, is characterized by Tower of Wizards in the middle of the city.
scripts.translation: 吉芬是由偉大的巫師建造的城市，其特點是城市中央有一座巫師塔。

scripts.text: Come to think of it, there's a fountain in the center of Prontera, a clock tower in Aldebaran, and a tower in Geffen as well.
scripts.translation: 仔細想想，普隆德拉中央有一個噴泉，阿爾貝塔有一座鐘樓，吉芬也有一座塔。

scripts.text: Maybe human's urban planning is based on symmetry or circular placement. I think it's less sophisticated.
scripts.translation: 也許人類的城市規劃基於對稱或圓形佈局。我覺得這不夠精緻。

scripts.text: Izlude is a port city and is the gateway to Prontera. Since humans can't fly, they travel in big boxes.
scripts.translation: 依斯魯得島是一個港口城市，是通往普隆德拉的門戶。既然人類不會飛，他們就在大箱子裡旅行。

scripts.text: I'm sure they think that big boxes made a great contribution to their civilization...but is it true?
scripts.translation: 我確信他們認為這些大箱子對他們的文明做出了巨大貢獻...但這是真的嗎？

scripts.text: Alberta is a place that people of Rune-Midgarts visit when they need to travel to other countries.
scripts.translation: 艾爾貝塔是盧恩·米德加茲的人們需要前往其他國家時訪問的地方。

scripts.text: There are many ships--a moving box that floats on water--ready and people travel on them.
scripts.translation: 有許多船隻——一種漂浮在水面上的移動箱子——隨時待命，人們乘坐它們旅行。

scripts.text: Seriously, human capability is...so disappointing. If they're wise enough, they'll use Warp-portal.
scripts.translation: 說真的，人類的能力真是...令人失望。如果他們足夠聰明，就會使用傳送門。

scripts.text: Morocc Village is known to be a place where Morocc, the king of demons, rests.
scripts.translation: 莫洛村以是惡魔之王莫洛歇息之地而聞名。

scripts.text: Making waterways and lakes in the barren inhospitable desert...what an exceptional piece of work for humans.
scripts.translation: 在貧瘠荒涼的沙漠中開鑿水道和湖泊...這對人類來說真是非凡的傑作。

scripts.text: I think it's a very peaceful place...at least until monsters appear in the buildings where their leader is burried.
scripts.translation: 我覺得那裡非常寧靜...至少直到魔物出現在埋葬他們首領的建築裡之前。

scripts.text: There is the sea in the east of Rune-Midgarts, a desert in the south, forest and vegetation in the middle, and mountains in the north.
scripts.translation: 盧恩·米德加茲的東部是海洋，南部是沙漠，中部是森林和植被，北部是山脈。

scripts.text: If you ask children to draw a world, wouldn't they draw it like this?
scripts.translation: 如果你讓小孩子畫一個世界，他們不會畫成這樣嗎？

scripts.text: However, it's not an ideal place nor is it a great place to live.
scripts.translation: 然而，它既不是理想之地，也不是偉大的居住地。

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about cities in Rune-Midgarts. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本書，伸手去拿。我想那是關於盧恩·米德加茲城市的內容。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 離書架遠點

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看書架上的書

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不該讀它的。

scripts.text: Humans often find great joy in venturing their lives in uncertain future.
scripts.translation: 人類常常在冒著生命危險探索不確定的未來時，找到巨大的快樂。

scripts.text: Comodo is a place for people who gamble with their future for something called 'fortune.' It seems irrelevant to ruling the kingdom though.
scripts.translation: 克魔島是那些為了所謂的“運氣”而賭上未來之人的地方。這似乎與統治王國無關。

scripts.text: Unidentifiable groups such as 'Female and Foot Volleyball' and 'Play Ranking Committee' got rid of games in that city.
scripts.translation: 像“女性與腳排球”和“遊戲排名委員會”這樣的不明組織，取消了該城市的比賽。

scripts.text: Comodo was known to be a beach city filled with pleasure, and it used to be a place where you could find all sorts of entertainment. But I can't really say if it's still like that.
scripts.translation: 克魔島曾以充滿歡樂的海濱城市而聞名，過去是尋找各種娛樂的地方。但我無法確定現在是否依然如此。

scripts.text: There's a female priest, who is admired by the people of the village, and there seems to be good reasons for her existence.
scripts.translation: 那裡有一位女性牧師，受到村民的敬仰，她似乎有存在的正當理由。

scripts.text: People bring her diamonds as a tribute, and she gives them gods' gifts in return. Although it seems like you have to be pretty lucky to receive it...
scripts.translation: 人們向她獻上鑽石作為貢品，她則回贈神明的禮物。不過，似乎需要相當幸運才能收到...

scripts.text: First of all, I would like to start this book by expressing my respect to the challenging spirit of humans.
scripts.translation: 首先，我想在這本書的開頭表達對人類挑戰精神的敬意。

scripts.text: In Umbala, where a gigantic tree forms a village, there are people who challenge themselves to jump off from tall trees for various reasons.
scripts.translation: 在汶巴拉，一棵巨大的樹形成了一個村莊，那裡有人出於各種原因挑戰自己從高大的樹上跳下來。

scripts.text: It's kind of strange if you think about it. I thought jumping off from a tree was a type of coming-of-age ceremony for human males. I can't believe there's another reason for it.
scripts.translation: 仔細想想，這有點奇怪。我以為從樹上跳下來是人類男性的成年禮。我無法相信還有其他原因。

scripts.text: Comodo is the only village in the southern part of this continent.
scripts.translation: 克魔島是這個大陸南部唯一的村莊。

scripts.text: Then, what is Paros Lighthouse for?
scripts.translation: 那麼，帕羅斯燈塔是做什麼用的？

scripts.text: Further investigation is delayed because only a sailor is stationed in that area currently and I couldn't find any evidence to suggest that a political or social organization is involved in that area.
scripts.translation: 由於目前該區域只有一名水手駐守，且未找到任何證據表明有政治或社會組織參與其中，進一步的調查被推遲了。

scripts.text: You can get to an island called Bahia by boat, and you can find an underground cave there.
scripts.translation: 乘船可以到達一座名為巴伊亞的島嶼，那裡有一座地下洞穴。

scripts.text: The existence of such a deep and long cave in an island is a geographical mystery!
scripts.translation: 在島嶼上存在如此深邃且漫長的洞穴，是一個地理學上的謎團！

scripts.text: Moreover, would any scholar be able to explain how humans here can breathe without gills in a place filled with water?
scripts.translation: 而且，有哪位學者能解釋這裡的人類為何在沒有鰓的情況下，還能在充滿水的地方呼吸呢？

scripts.text: Prontera is a big city, so ensuring the stable supply of resources is very important.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉是一座大城市，因此確保資源的穩定供應至關重要。

scripts.text: Especially, the supply of water resources is important for humans are vulnerable and they can't survive even for 30 days without water.
scripts.translation: 尤其是水資源的供應，因為人類很脆弱，沒有水連30天都活不下去。

scripts.text: Therefore, they built a huge building that looks like a water and sewer facility...
scripts.translation: 因此，他們建造了一座看起來像水利和排汙設施的巨大建築...

scripts.text: But why can't I find the entrance inside the city? Is it a structural problem? Or is it for security?
scripts.translation: 但我為什麼找不到城市內部的入口呢？是結構問題？還是出於安全考慮？

scripts.text: Glast Heim, the ruins of what was once a great castle.
scripts.translation: 葛拉斯特海姆，曾經是一座宏偉城堡的廢墟。

scripts.text: Soon, they're going to reveal what have happened here and the story behind it. So, let's focus on the development of the situation.
scripts.translation: 很快，這裡發生的一切及其背後的故事就會揭曉。所以，讓我們關注事態的發展吧。

scripts.text: Anyway, there are a number of monsters living together in more than 10 regions; all in the upper and lower parts of Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 總之，有超過10個區域，許多魔物共同生活在葛拉斯特海姆的上下兩部分。

scripts.text: More detailed geographic information on this region is...so limited that I want to just grab any urban engineer by the collar and start asking.
scripts.translation: 關於這個地區的詳細地理資訊...太有限了，我真想抓住任何一位城市工程師的衣領開始質問。

scripts.text: Although human civilization is advanced enough to establish a country, humans are not accumulating knowledge but merely shifting their focus from one to another,
scripts.translation: 雖然人類文明已經先進到足以建立國家，但他們並沒有積累知識，只是將注意力從一個領域轉移到另一個領域，

scripts.text: and it seems like they're no longer able to differentiate a certain tree or grass from another.
scripts.translation: 而且他們似乎已經無法分辨某棵樹或某株草與其他有什麼不同。

scripts.text: Otherwise, they wouldn't have named this well-organized forest as 'the mysterious forest.' I can't believe they gave such a strange name to this forest just because they can't find their way out.
scripts.translation: 否則，他們不會把這片井然有序的森林命名為“神秘森林”。我無法相信他們僅僅因為找不到出口，就給這片森林起了這麼奇怪的名字。

scripts.text: They might have believed that language is an exclusive possession of human. But I'm sure they changed their mind after meeting us, the fairies.
scripts.translation: 他們可能曾認為語言是人類獨有的。但我很確定，在遇見我們精靈之後，他們改變了想法。

scripts.text: However, they're not surprised to see that some cats, much bigger in size than normal ones, are living in a socialized society and are able to communicate with humans.
scripts.translation: 然而，看到一些體型比普通貓大得多的貓，生活在社會化的群體中並能與人類交流，他們並不感到驚訝。

scripts.text: There's something I don't know. Should I reveal the truth?
scripts.translation: 有些我不知道的事情。我應該揭露真相嗎？

scripts.text: Breaking News: Thoughts on a secret place.
scripts.translation: 突發新聞：關於一個秘密地點的思考。

scripts.text: There is constant exploitation and harassment going on in a monastery, not far from Prontera.
scripts.translation: 在距離普隆德拉不遠的修道院，存在著持續的剝削和騷擾行為。

scripts.text: They lure people who attempt to walk in god's way and make them gather mushrooms or run long distances...why is this acceptable!
scripts.translation: 他們誘騙那些試圖行善的人，讓他們去採蘑菇或跑長距離...這怎麼能被接受！

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about the northern parts of Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本書，便伸手去拿。我想，那大概是關於米德加爾特北部地區的。-

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 離書架遠點

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看書架上的書

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不該讀它的。

scripts.text: Humans continued to float big boxes on water and the sea, and finally, they began to use the sky.
scripts.translation: 人類繼續讓巨大的箱子漂浮在水面和海洋上，最終，他們開始利用天空。

scripts.text: Where are they going next? Underground? Or are they going to transcend time and space?
scripts.translation: 他們下一步要去哪裡？地下？還是說他們要超越時間和空間？

scripts.text: At this rate, people will be willing to travel to the past. Human's technological advancements require attention.
scripts.translation: 照這個速度發展下去，人們甚至願意穿越回過去。人類的科技進步值得警惕。

scripts.text: Einbroch is filled with machines. They don't seem to manufacture a lot of industrial goods, but machines are their weapons definitely.
scripts.translation: 艾音布羅克充滿了機器。他們似乎並沒有生產大量的工業品，但機器絕對是他們的武器。

scripts.text: What are those numerous factories producing, and for what are people working?
scripts.translation: 那些眾多的工廠在生產什麼？人們又是在為什麼而工作？

scripts.text: Don't they know that civilization development doesn't necessarily improve the value of life?
scripts.translation: 他們難道不知道，文明的發展並不一定能提升生命的價值嗎？

scripts.text: If you take a train in Einbroch, you can get to a village called Einbech.
scripts.translation: 如果在艾音布羅克乘坐火車，就能到達一個叫艾音貝赫的村莊。

scripts.text: Of course I hate this form of transportation (smells like iron too much), but it's a useful for humans because of its cheap price and transport capacity.
scripts.translation: 當然，我討厭這種交通工具（鐵鏽味太重了），但因為它價格便宜且載貨量大，對人類來說非常實用。

scripts.text: By the way, don't they have enough materials to make railroad tracks? When will they make extensions to the train routes?
scripts.translation: 順便問一下，他們難道沒有足夠的材料來鋪設鐵軌嗎？什麼時候才能延長火車線路呢？

scripts.text: Hugel, a small rural village, is like Comodo of southern region.
scripts.translation: 毀葛，一個小小的鄉村，就像南方的克魔島一樣。

scripts.text: There are a variety of mini games and the landscape is very idyllic as well.
scripts.translation: 那裡有各種各樣的小遊戲，風景也非常田園詩意。

scripts.text: But aren't those entertainment facilities supposed to be in the center of a country?
scripts.translation: 但是，這些娛樂設施不應該建在國家的中心嗎？

scripts.text: A city called Juno is even floating in the sky! How incredible is this.
scripts.translation: 甚至有一個叫朱諾的城市漂浮在天空中！這簡直太不可思議了。

scripts.text: And there is a special reward for those who escape the maze: there is a place where rebirth is given.
scripts.translation: 而且，對於逃出迷宮的人還有特別的獎勵：那裡有一個可以重生的地方。

scripts.text: Humans are truly scary. But I feel like I've seen this maze somewhere...
scripts.translation: 人類真是可怕。但我感覺我好像在某個地方見過這個迷宮...

scripts.text: In Rahel, the capital of Arunafeltz, there lives a small, cute, and white creature that seems really soft.
scripts.translation: 在阿魯納菲茲的首都拉赫爾，生活著一種小巧、可愛且白色的生物，看起來非常柔軟。

scripts.text: If you thought of Siroma, you are wrong. It's not marine either.
scripts.translation: 如果你想到的是小雪怪，那就錯了。它也不是海洋生物。

scripts.text: The answer is a girl who is both a priest and a leader. This is because Arunafeltz is a theocratic entity.
scripts.translation: 答案是，她既是一位牧師，也是一位首領。這是因為阿魯納菲茲是一個神權實體。

scripts.text: In the plains of Audhumbla, there lives many monster flowers and herbivore animals.
scripts.translation: 在奧杜姆布拉的平原上，生活著許多魔物花朵和食草動物。

scripts.text: Although one would think that they are not herbivores seeing how they attack humans, but
scripts.translation: 雖然看到它們攻擊人類，人們可能會認為它們不是食草動物，但

scripts.text: if they were really carnivores, what food would they live on? Moreover, there is no record of them eating the adventurers who travel by after attacking them.
scripts.translation: 如果它們真的是食肉動物，那它們靠什麼為食呢？而且，也沒有記錄顯示它們會吃掉被它們攻擊的冒險者。

scripts.text: Veins, a village built on a hill, seems like a well-planned city.
scripts.translation: 伯仁斯，一座建在山丘上的村莊，看起來像是一座規劃良好的城市。

scripts.text: While it's confusing to know where you would exit and enter from, but
scripts.translation: 雖然讓人困惑的是不知道從哪裡進出，但

scripts.text: if you want to see interesting sights such as a stone eating up a coin you dropped, it's a good place to visit.
scripts.translation: 如果你想看一些有趣的景象，比如石頭吃掉你掉落的硬幣，那裡是一個不錯的去處。

scripts.text: There was also a place that was extremely hot somewhere in Arunafeltz..
scripts.translation: 在阿魯納菲茲的某個地方，還有一個極其炎熱的地方...

scripts.text: The heat there felt like it would burn through my wings in their entirety. The residents of that place also did not seem very friendly.
scripts.translation: 那裡的熱浪彷彿要將我的翅膀完全燒燬。那裡的居民看起來也不太友好。

scripts.text: So I had to stop the expedition. I hope that you, the readers, would also distance yourselves from that place.
scripts.translation: 所以我不得不中止探險。希望讀者們也能遠離那個地方。

scripts.text: Well...It's not that I was afraid of the guardian there, you see!
scripts.translation: 嗯...並不是因為我害怕那裡的守衛，你知道嗎！

scripts.text: In Lighthalzen, there is a colossal building constructed by technicians. Although what they exactly do in there is a little suspicious...
scripts.translation: 在裡希塔樂鎮，有一座由技術人員建造的巨大建築。雖然他們在裡面具體做什麼有點可疑...

scripts.text: I'm not sure if a profit-seeking corporation should be doing something like that.
scripts.translation: 我不確定一家追求利潤的公司是否應該做這樣的事情。

scripts.text: It's also very strange that clean and dirty areas in the city are divided...
scripts.translation: 城市裡清潔區和髒亂區被分開，這也非常奇怪...

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about various regions in Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本書，伸手去拿。我想它是關於米德加爾特各個地區的。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 離書架遠點

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看書架上的書

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不該讀它的。

scripts.text: If you ride the boats in Alberta, you can get to various destinations.
scripts.translation: 如果你乘坐艾爾貝塔的船隻，可以到達各種目的地。

scripts.text: I don't know why so many of these boats end up at Alberta specifically, but for that, traveling is much easier.
scripts.translation: 我不知道為什麼這麼多船最終都停在艾爾貝塔，但因此，旅行變得更加容易了。

scripts.text: Places you can reach through Alberta are as follows.
scripts.translation: 通過艾爾貝塔可以到達的地方如下。

scripts.text: A country of Gods, Amatsu, a place of refuge, Kunlun, Luoyang where many martial art experts reside, Ayothaya in which a huge sculpture is present, and many others.
scripts.translation: 神國櫻花城、避難所崑崙、居住著許多武術專家的洛陽、擁有巨大雕像的哎喲泰雅，以及許多其他地方。

scripts.text: I can see that more places would be available in the future as delegates from many other countries are arriving there more recently.
scripts.translation: 我可以看到，隨著最近來自許多其他國家的代表抵達那裡，未來會有更多地方可供訪問。

scripts.text: Among those places that can be reached by boats, there is one famous destination.
scripts.translation: 在可以通過船隻到達的地方中，有一個著名的目的地。

scripts.text: Regrettably for them, they didn't take me just because I am a lone traveler. It wasn't even that they would give me a discount on the boat ride.
scripts.translation: 遺憾的是，他們只因為我是一個獨自旅行者而沒有帶我。他們甚至沒有給我船票打折。

scripts.text: As a scholar, I couldn't be more enraged by the ignorance of the Jawaii-bound ship's captain. Even during wars, historians are exempt from hostility.
scripts.translation: 作為一名學者，對於前往爪哇的船長那種無知，我感到無比憤怒。即使在戰爭中，歷史學家也應被豁免於敵意之外。

scripts.text: Also from Alberta, there is an island known for its high concentration of turtles.
scripts.translation: 此外，從艾爾貝塔出發，還有一座以海龜密度極高而聞名的島嶼。

scripts.text: There are no regular routes, but after a long research, I found out that there is a captain who travels specifically to that place.
scripts.translation: 那裡沒有定期航線，但經過長時間的研究，我發現有一位船長專門前往那個地方。

scripts.text: Upon getting there, there were many exotic turtles including cold turtles, hot turtles, and ninja turtles.
scripts.translation: 到達那裡後，我看到了許多奇異的烏龜，包括冷龜、熱龜，還有忍者龜。

scripts.text: From Clock Tower Village, I could arrive at a snowing village through an elderly man who wears thick, red clothes all year around.
scripts.translation: 從鐘樓村莊出發，通過一位全年都穿著厚重紅色衣服的老人，我到達了一個正在下雪的村莊。

scripts.text: The entire village was covered by snow, and as expected from a place that is preparing for a celebration, the atmosphere was great.
scripts.translation: 整個村莊都被白雪覆蓋，正如一個正在準備慶典的地方那樣，氣氛非常熱烈。

scripts.text: Inside the village, there was also a place that produces toys for children, but for some reason, they chased me out.
scripts.translation: 在村莊裡，還有一個生產兒童玩具的地方，但不知為何，他們把我趕了出去。

scripts.text: Among those places that can be reached by boats, there is a small island where a wrecked ship rests.
scripts.translation: 在可以通過船隻到達的地方中，有一座小島，上面停泊著一艘沉船。

scripts.text: I'm not sure if the ship was to be salvaged, but it was already occupied by strange creatures.
scripts.translation: 我不確定那艘船是否打算被打撈，但它已經被一些奇怪的生物佔據了。

scripts.text: The main god of the faith practiced in this continent is Odin. Accordingly, there is a temple for Odin as well.
scripts.translation: 在這個大陸上信仰的主神是奧丁。因此，這裡也有一座奧丁神廟。

scripts.text: I was also outcasted here. People had no conception of hospitality and generosity toward outsiders.
scripts.translation: 我也在這裡被驅逐了。人們對外來者完全沒有待客之道和慷慨之心。

scripts.text: Near the south of the village were some docks. I researched a long time to see how these docks were being used, but I just couldn't find the answer.
scripts.translation: 在村莊的南部附近有一些碼頭。我研究了很久，想知道這些碼頭是如何被使用的，但始終找不到答案。

scripts.text: But soon, I discovered the destination from those docks by following adventurers who secretly utilized them.
scripts.translation: 但很快，我通過跟隨那些秘密利用這些碼頭的冒險者，發現了那裡的目的地。

scripts.text: As scary as it was, what I saw there was truly shocking.
scripts.translation: 儘管那裡很可怕，但我在那裡看到的景象確實令人震驚。

scripts.text: It is only right for an adventurer to record all that was seen, but because it is a politically sensitive material to be revealed, I will leave it at that.
scripts.translation: 冒險者記錄所見到的一切是理所當然的，但由於這是政治敏感材料，不便公開，我就到此為止了。

scripts.translation: 馬拉格多，一座貓島。那麼柔軟，那麼溫柔，啊...這是一座充滿可愛貓咪的島嶼。哇，我該怎麼辦...它們都太可愛、太討人喜歡了，我想抱抱...

scripts.text: Then my +9 Violet Fear shattered into pieces. I was so shocked because it was the only weapon that I had.
scripts.translation: 然後我的+9納戶特基格的雙劍碎成了碎片。我很震驚，因為那是我的唯一武器。
