scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
嗯，對我們來說穿越迷霧森林太難了，而且因為裂縫，道路也被封鎖了...
這是個很大的問題。壓力讓我都變老了！

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Mails from Eclage are sent along with the supplies for the base.
Before, it was hard to send mails from this side to that side. But thanks to you, we no longer have a problem sending mails and we're so happy.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
來自埃克拉珠的信件是隨基地補給一起送來的。
以前，從這邊寄信到那邊很困難。但多虧了你，我們現在寄信不再有問題了，真讓人高興。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
You're from Eclage?
Hmm? Roy? I see. I've been waiting for so long.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
你是從埃克拉珠來的？
嗯？羅伊？我明白了。我已經等了很久了。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
I knew it'd be almost impossible to get here...but I was waiting just to be sure.
What a relief that you came on Roy's behalf!
Give this box to Roy, please.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
我知道這幾乎不可能...但我還是等著以防萬一。
你代表羅伊來了，真是鬆了一口氣！
請把那個箱子交給羅伊。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Well, most of them are personal letters, so it's more of a mail delivery.
Please, help us out.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
嗯，大部分是私人信件，所以這更像是送信。
請幫幫我們。

scripts.text: Yes, that's what I'm for.
scripts.translation: 是的，這是我的職責。

scripts.text: No, that's not why I'm here.
scripts.translation: 不，我不是為此而來的。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Here, take this.
Everyone in the base is so excited
that they can send anything they want.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
給你，拿著這個。
基地裡的每個人都很興奮，
因為他們現在可以寄任何想要的東西了。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Huh...really.
That's sad.
Well.. What can I say.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
啊...是嗎。
真可惜。
唉...我也沒什麼好說的。

scripts.text: [Contact Officer]
scripts.translation: [聯絡官]

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Don't dump anything on the way or throw anything,
but deliver them safely, please.
scripts.translation:
[聯絡官]
路上不要丟棄或扔任何東西，
請安全送達。

scripts.text:
A female Laphine and a male Laphine are talking about something.
But they stopped talking as soon as they saw me. 
I think I've interrupted the conversation.
scripts.translation:
一隻女性拉菲尼和一隻男性拉菲尼正在交談。
但看到我後，他們立刻停止了說話。
我想我打擾到他們的談話了。

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
Ahhhh I didn't say anything. I didn't...
It's true that I'm one of the most talkative Laphines in town, but I don't tell everything down to the last detail.
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
啊...我什麼都沒說。我沒有...
雖然我是鎮上最健談的拉菲尼之一，但我不會把每個細節都告訴別人。

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
So, you'd better not try to find out something from me, outsider!
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
外鄉人，你最好別試圖從我這裡套出什麼話來！

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
You shouldn't get involved in the matters of other races.
Especially when it's something like family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼]
你不該插手其他種族的內政。
尤其是像家事這種私事。

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
You're visiting Eclage?
I hope you have a good time here.
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼]
你是來埃克拉珠遊玩的嗎？
希望你在這裡度過愉快的時光。

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
Honestly, aren't you concerned?
It's been a good while, but
you can't say it will never happen again.
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
說實話，你不擔心嗎？
雖然已經過了很久，
但也不能說這種事永遠不會再發生。

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
...Hmm.
It's true that it goes against common sense.
But isn't it okay as long as he doesn't tyrannize like Seneth did?
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼]
……嗯。
確實，這違背常理。
但只要他不像塞內斯那樣暴政，不就沒問題了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
That's what I'm concerned about.
No one can be sure that he won't do the same.
To be honest, I never experienced it myself. But just listening about the times when Seneth was Mayor is more than enough.
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
這正是我擔心的地方。
沒人能保證他不會重蹈覆轍。
老實說，我自己並沒有經歷過那段時期。但光是聽聽塞內斯當市長時的事情，就足以讓人不寒而慄了。

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
I'm glad I wasn't there during that time.
Don't you think Mayor...has to be perfect?
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
我很慶幸自己沒在那段時間待在這裡。
你不覺得……市長必須是完美的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
Well, but there's no guarantee that the new Mayor will do the same?
You think having a new Mayor is a good thing, too.
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼]
嗯，但也沒法保證新市長不會那樣做吧？
你也覺得換一位新市長是件好事。

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
That's true. But why does it have to be 'him'....
If it wasn't for that, I wouldn't be concerned like this...
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
沒錯。但為什麼偏偏是“他”……
如果不是因為那個人，我也不會這麼擔心……

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
That's enough.
That foreigner can hear you.
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼]
夠了。
那個外鄉人聽得見。

scripts.text: Actually, I've already heard you. Could you tell me more about it?
scripts.translation: 其實，我已經聽到了。能多告訴我一些嗎？

scripts.text: What was it about?
scripts.translation: 那是關於什麼的？

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
No, I don't think we should.
Hahaha...
It's about us Laphines, so...
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼]
不，我覺得不該說。
哈哈……
畢竟這是我們拉菲尼自己的事……

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
A foreigner like you doesn't need to know.
Stop eavesdropping and mind your own business.
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
像你這樣的外鄉人不需要知道。
別偷聽了，管好你自己的事吧。

scripts.text:
Mayor and tyrant? And what's Seneth?
Anyway, they seem to be worried about Kardui, the current Mayor.
Let's stop worrying and ask Kardui instead!
scripts.translation:
市長和暴君？還有塞內斯是誰？
總之，他們似乎很擔心現任市長卡爾杜伊。
別擔心了，直接去問卡爾杜伊吧！

scripts.text:
What Laphines said is interesting.
A story about a tyrant..should I listen to what other Laphines have to say?
scripts.translation:
拉菲尼們說的話很有趣。
關於暴君的故事……我該聽聽其他拉菲尼怎麼說嗎？

scripts.text:
Two Laphines from the upper class are talking about something.
One of them seems to be working and very annoyed. 
As if they were aware of my stare, they waved me away with a show of irritation.
scripts.translation:
兩隻上流階層的拉菲尼正在談論著什麼。
其中一隻看起來正在工作，而且非常煩躁。
彷彿察覺到了我的目光，它們帶著惱怒的神情揮了揮手，示意我離開。

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
It's not appropriate for a foreigner to pay too much attention to our domestic affairs.
scripts.translation:
[來訪的拉菲尼]
外鄉人過分關注我們的內政，是不合適的。

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
I don't understand why there is a series of bad events in town...
Mayor was disconnected from Yggdrasil,
he became obsolete because of that,
and there's the rift, too.
scripts.translation:
[來訪的拉菲尼]
我不明白為什麼鎮上接二連三地發生壞事……
市長與伊格德拉希爾斷開了連線，
因此變得過時了，
而且還有裂縫的問題。

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
I heard the rift is created by the king of demons, and Saphas are in trouble because of that.
What's more, the new Mayor is...kind of...
scripts.translation:
[來訪的拉菲尼]
我聽說裂縫是由惡魔之王造成的，薩法也因此陷入了困境。
更糟糕的是，新市長……有點……

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
Could this be the sign of the end of the world?
Didn't we have something like this before?
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[來訪的拉菲尼]
這難道是世界末日的徵兆嗎？
我們以前好像也發生過類似的事情？
你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Working Laphine]
...I'm working. Don't bother me.
My head aches when I think about the rift. There is a big snag in sending supplies to Splendide because of that.
scripts.translation:
[工作中的拉菲尼]
……我在工作。別打擾我。
一想到裂縫我就頭疼。正因為如此，向輝煌領域運送物資遇到了很大的麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
Ah, come to think of it, you know humans that came through Hazy Forest.
I don't know what is on Mayor's mind, but he invites them and gives them works.
scripts.translation:
[來訪的拉菲尼]
啊，對了，你知道那些穿過迷霧森林的人類嗎。
我不知道市長在想什麼，但他邀請他們，並給他們安排工作。

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
The current Mayor is exceptionally young,
and 'that'...
and he tries to meet foreigners...
Why is he like that?
scripts.translation:
[來訪的拉菲尼]
現任市長異常年輕，
而且“那個”……
他還試圖會見外鄉人……
他為什麼這樣？

scripts.text:
[Working Laphine]
You mean a foreigner like the guy over there who's been listening to us?
Mayor meets him pretty often nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[工作中的拉菲尼]
你是指像那邊一直在偷聽我們的那個傢伙一樣的外鄉人嗎？
市長最近經常見他。

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
Ekk?!
Since when were you here?!
Don't sneak up like that. You're not supposed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[來訪的拉菲尼]
咦？！
你什麼時候在這裡的？！
別偷偷摸摸的。你不應該在這裡。

scripts.text: What is 'that?'
scripts.translation: “那個”是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Working Laphine]
It's none of your business.
It's just a small talk between just two of us, so don't think about it.
Now, all visitors should leave the room.
scripts.translation:
[工作中的拉菲尼]
這不關你的事。
這只是我們兩個之間的閒聊，別多想。
現在，所有訪客都請離開房間。

scripts.text:
What is 'that' Laphines are talking about? It seems to be related to Kardui.
Let's stop worrying and ask Kardui instead!
scripts.translation:
拉菲尼們談論的“那個”是什麼？似乎與卡爾杜伊有關。
別擔心了，還是去問問卡爾杜伊吧！

scripts.text:
What Laphines said is interesting.
I would like to listen more, but I have to go. Should I listen to what other Laphines have to say?
scripts.translation:
拉菲尼們說的話很有趣。
我想再聽一會兒，但我必須走了。我該聽聽其他拉菲尼怎麼說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Working Laphine]
Do you have questions about our king?
However, the king of humans and our Mayor are incomparably different.
Don't apply the same concept when thinking about our Mayor.
scripts.translation:
[工作中的拉菲尼]
你對我們的國王有疑問嗎？
然而，人類的國王和我們的市長是完全不同的。
思考我們的市長時，不要套用同樣的概念。

scripts.text:
[Working Laphine]
I hope you don't show curiosity anymore.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[工作中的拉菲尼]
我希望你不要再表現出好奇心了。
你明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Working Laphine]
This is the office area designated for official business.
You're not supposed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[工作中的拉菲尼]
這是指定用於公務的辦公區域。
你不應該在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
What are you staring at, traveller?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
旅行者，你在盯著什麼看？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'm sorry for making you wait.
I read the letter.
He said he wanted to introduce his friend, and I guess it's you.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
抱歉讓你久等了。
我讀了那封信。
他說他想介紹他的朋友，我想那就是你。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Did you find anything?
A scholar of magics sponsored by the Chief of Staff?
We'd better ask who he is and where he came from.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你發現什麼了嗎？
由參謀長贊助的魔法學者？
我們最好問問他是誰，從哪裡來的。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Was there any progress?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
有進展嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Did the Chief of Staff say that?
Unless he wants to surprise everyone with a great research,
I'm sure that scholar of magics is not a normal Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
是參謀長說的嗎？
除非他想用一項偉大的研究來震驚所有人，
我確信那位魔法學者不是普通的拉菲尼。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Good, this is enough.
I'm thinking about going into Eclage without anyone noticing me.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
很好，這就夠了。
我在考慮在不被任何人注意的情況下潛入埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
We need to find the materials for his experiment in order to approach him casually.
Let's bring him the materials and pretend Shenime sent you.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我們需要找到他實驗所需的材料，以便自然地接近他。
讓我們帶上材料，假裝是謝尼梅派你來的。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Although he changed his hair color, it was Avant for sure. 
Just like they say 'the beacon does not shine on its own base.' keke...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
雖然換了髮色，但肯定是阿旺。
俗話說“燈下黑”嘛，呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I see they are tightening the guard around the Orb...
and I feel like I forgot about something..
scripts.translation:
[希西]
看來他們加強了水晶周圍的守衛...
總覺得我忘了什麼事...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Since you had interactions with the Chief of Staff constantly, it'll be easier for you to approach him.
Although Kar is Mayor, he might be the one with the least power throughout history.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
既然你一直和參謀長打交道，接近他應該比較容易。
雖然卡爾是市長，但他可能是歷史上權力最小的市長。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I've been spending more time at the palace thant here.
Since I have to send my magical powers to replace the Orb's inner core...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我最近花在宮殿裡的時間比在這裡多。
因為我必須輸送魔力來替換水晶的核心...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
If you climbed all the way here out of curiosity, you'd better start going down now.
Professor has been under the weather nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
如果你只是好奇才爬到這裡，最好現在就開始下山。
智者最近身體不太舒服。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Not yet, I'm still reading.
Just a minute.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
還沒好，我還在看。
請稍等。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I ask you to be in charge of searching inside Eclage.
There will hardly be any clues, so it's going to be pretty tough.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
拜託你負責在埃克拉珠內部搜尋。
線索會很少，所以會很艱難。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I need to see what Avant is researching about.
Let's hurry.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我得去看看阿旺在研究什麼。
快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
You were supposed to bring Avant's research materials to Kar.
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你本該把阿旺的研究資料帶給卡爾。
你怎麼在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Let's go to Eclage.
I'm going to talk to Kar.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我們去埃克拉珠。
我要去見卡爾。

scripts.text:
The Laphine standing in front of you is tall and dark-skinned, and he has small wings.
He seems to be a mix of Dona, the upper class Laphines, and Papang, the lower class Laphine.
Moreover...
scripts.translation:
站在你面前的拉菲尼身材高大，皮膚黝黑，長著小小的翅膀。
他似乎是上層拉菲尼多娜和下層拉菲尼帕潘格的混血。
而且...

scripts.text: He looks the same!!
scripts.translation: 他長得一模一樣！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You, Laphine?
Why do you look exactly the same as Kardui?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你，拉菲尼？
為什麼你和卡爾杜伊長得一模一樣？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Is your job saying random things?
or is it commenting on my looks?
Who on earth are you?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你的職業是胡說八道嗎？
還是在評論我的長相？
你到底是什麼人？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Did Kar send you?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
是卡爾派你來的嗎？

scripts.text: I need to meet Kardui's brother.
scripts.translation: 我要見卡爾杜伊的哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
......I guess Kar didn't tell you about me.
You didn't even ask the name of his brother and just came?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
......看來卡爾沒告訴你關於我的事。
你連他哥哥的名字都沒問就來了？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'm Hisie, Kar's older brother.
The reason why we look alike is because we're twins.
You're here to bring me that letter in your hand, right?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我是希西，卡爾的哥哥。
我們長得像是因為我們是雙胞胎。
你是來把手裡那封信給我的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Maybe this is what he meant when he told me that I might have a guest over soon.
I'll read the letter. Just wait over there.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
也許這就是他告訴我可能很快會有客人來訪的意思。
我要讀信了。請在那邊稍等。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It will only take a few minutes.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
只需要幾分鐘。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
He probably wanted to surprise me.
He hasn't changed a bit.
I look pretty unique because, as you already know, I'm half Dona and half Papang.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
他大概是想給我個驚喜。
他一點都沒變。
我看起來挺特別的，因為如你所知，我是半多娜半帕潘。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It's a long story, but I think you should know.
There was one more thing Kar mentioned in the letter besides introducing you.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
說來話長，但我覺得你應該知道。
除了介紹你之外，卡爾在信裡還提到了另一件事。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
But then...
Why is he looking for Avant now?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
但是...
他為什麼現在要找阿旺？

scripts.text: Avant?
scripts.translation: 阿旺？

scripts.text: One more thing?
scripts.translation: 另一件事？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
He wants me to find Avant.
And he says you'll be a great help?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
他想讓我去找阿旺。
他說你會幫上大忙？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Avant is a scholar of magical powers...
...and the father of me and Kar.
But why did he choose you?
If it's something that he didn't want to tell anyone, he could have just told me.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
阿旺是一位魔法學者...
...也是我和卡爾的父親。
但他為什麼選了你？
如果是他不想告訴任何人的事，他完全可以只告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Anyway, I don't know Avant's whereabouts.
I don't want to know, and I want to stop Kar looking for him. But there must be a reason.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
總之，我不知道阿旺的下落。
我也不想知道，我想阻止卡爾去找他。但一定是有原因的。

scripts.text: But he's your father?
scripts.translation: 但他是你父親？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
He's just our biological father.
In reality, we're nothing more than materials for his experiments.
We are just objects that were made in an effort to prove his hypothesis.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
他只是我們的生物學父親。
實際上，我們不過是他的實驗材料。
我們只是為了驗證他的假設而被製造出來的物品。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
So, there can't be any relationship or love between us.
Kar could be looking for Avant in order to eliminate him.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
所以，我們之間不可能存在任何關係或愛意。
卡爾可能在找阿旺是為了除掉他。

scripts.text: Experiments? Hypothesis?
scripts.translation: 實驗？假設？

scripts.text: Objects that were made?
scripts.translation: 被製造出來的物品？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Do you know about Seneth, who became Mayor even though he was half breed?
Avant must have been interested about the fact that half-blood became Mayor.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你知道塞內斯嗎？他雖然是混血，卻當上了市長。
阿旺一定對混血兒能當市長這件事很感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
So, he developed a couple of hypotheses and did experiments in order to prove them.
Kar is a piece of work that Avant created with thorough preparations,
scripts.translation:
[希西]
於是，他提出了幾個假設，並進行了實驗來證明它們。
卡爾是阿旺精心準備後創造出來的作品，

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
while I am an accident that always happens in experiments. 
Anyway, Kar became the king but lost his whole life.
However, his hatred for Avant hasn't changed a bit.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
而我則是實驗中總是會出現的意外。
總之，卡爾成為了國王，卻失去了整個人生。
然而，他對阿旺的仇恨一點都沒變。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
But now, Kar is looking for Avant...?
Maybe he changed his mind or he has a plan. 
After becoming Mayor, that crybaby has grown so much.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
但現在，卡爾在找阿旺...？
也許他改變主意了，或者他有計劃。
自從當上市長後，那個愛哭鬼成長了很多。

scripts.text: A crybaby?
scripts.translation: 愛哭鬼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must be kidding that he's a crybaby.
The Kardui I know is very confident and skillful...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你肯定在開玩笑，說他是個愛哭鬼。
我認識的卡爾杜伊非常自信且技藝高超...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
You're right. I know.
His personality has changed a lot ever since he became Mayor. 
I've wanted to see that with my own eyes.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你說得對。我知道。
自從他當上市長後，性格變了很多。
我一直想親眼看看。

scripts.text: What if you go and see him in person?
scripts.translation: 如果你親自去看看他呢？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
If I do, younger Laphines are going to be scared.
I'm not Dona nor Papang. I don't belong anywhere.
What Florence wanted to do once upon a time, creating a lineage of mixed blood.
Wouldn't he have wanted to create something like me?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
如果我去的話，年輕的拉菲尼斯們會害怕的。
我不是多娜，也不是帕潘格。我不屬於任何地方。
弗洛倫斯曾經想做的事，就是創造混血的譜系。
他難道不正是想創造像我這樣的存在嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Anyway, we should look for Avant?
It's been decades since his stupid experiment was caught by the elders and he disappeared.
I'm sure he's somewhere celebrating the success of his experiments.
He is like that.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
總之，我們應該去找阿旺？
自從他那愚蠢的實驗被長老們發現並消失後，已經幾十年了。
我確信他正在某個地方慶祝實驗的成功。
他就是那樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'll let you search the inside of Eclage.
He was an excellent scholar of magics, so scholars who belong to the gate of the truth might know something.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我會讓你去埃克拉珠內部搜尋。
他曾是優秀的魔法學者，所以屬於真理之門的學者們可能知道些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'll be searching outside Eclage on my own.
I'm lucky if I could find the slightest trace.
Now, let's move!
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我會獨自去埃克拉珠外部搜尋。
如果我能找到哪怕一點線索，那也算幸運了。
現在，出發吧！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
You can easily find Dustballs and bookmarks made of fallen leaves anywhere in this tower.
Just do what he asked you to do for now, and try to gather some information.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
在這座中央塔裡，你很容易就能找到塵埃和由落葉製成的書籤。
先做他讓你做的事，試著收集一些資訊。

scripts.text: Tell him about the information you received from Minuel.
scripts.translation: 告訴他你從米努埃爾那裡得到的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
We should go check who the scholar of magics that Shenime sponsors is.
I accidentally found a laboratory Yai in the east.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我們應該去查一下謝尼梅資助的那位魔法學者是誰。
我在東邊偶然發現了一個亞伊實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
But since it's a Yai that is opened just like any other Yais for residence or a simple research...
it might not be a place for secret experiments or where Avant would hide in.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
但既然這是一個像其他用於居住或簡單研究的亞伊一樣開放的實驗室...
它可能不是進行秘密實驗的地方，也不是阿旺會藏身的地方。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Let's go check who he is since we don't have any clues other than that.
This is my plan.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
既然除了這個之外我們沒有任何線索，那就去查一下他是誰吧。
這是我的計劃。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I want you to pretend that Shenime sent you and bring him a Dustball and 10 bookmarks.
I'll hide and check from afar whether it's Avant or not.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我要你假裝是謝尼梅派你來的，給他帶一個塵埃和10個書籤。
我會躲起來，從遠處確認他是不是阿旺。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'm thinking about going into Eclage without anyone noticing me.
Meet me at the forked road before entering the plaza of Eclage.
Don't forget to bring the materials for experiments.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我在考慮在不被任何人發現的情況下進入埃克拉珠。
在埃克拉珠廣場前的岔路口與我匯合。
別忘了帶上實驗材料。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Usually, those geeks of the gate of the truth take pride in their works and don't like hiding it. 
There is definitely something about that scholar of magics. I'm concerned.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
通常，真理之門的那些書呆子們會以他們的作品為榮，不喜歡隱藏它。
那位魔法學者肯定有什麼特別之處。我很擔心。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
We'd better do some research about him.
If we can't get any information about the scholar, we could track down Shenime.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我們最好對他做一些調查。
如果我們無法獲得關於那位學者的資訊，我們可以追蹤謝尼梅。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'll leave that part to you.
I'm concerned about something, so I'm going to go and check it myself.
I'll be looking forward to hearing some good news!
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那部分交給你了。
我有些擔心，所以我要親自去檢視一下。
期待聽到好訊息！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Meet me at the forked road before entering the plaza of Eclage.
Now, let's move!
scripts.translation:
[希西]
在埃克拉珠廣場前的岔路口與我匯合。
現在，出發吧！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Fortunately, I've found those materials for them the other day. I just have to find the same things again.
There were 10 Dustballs and 10 bookmarks, right?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
幸運的是，前幾天我已經找到了那些材料。我只需要再找到同樣的東西。
是10個塵埃和10個書籤，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I have to tell Kar about this.
Hurry up
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我必須把這件事告訴卡爾。
快一點

scripts.text: About Avant
scripts.translation: 關於阿旺

scripts.text: About the Chief of Staff
scripts.translation: 關於參謀長

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
That wicked man is just laughing and not saying anything.
He's just repeating the same answers like, 'because it's interesting,' or 'because it's fun.'
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那個卑鄙的傢伙只是在那笑，什麼也不說。
他只會重複同樣的回答，比如“因為很有趣”或者“因為好玩”。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
....!
Oh, right! The Chief of Staff!
How could I have forgotten about him?
I was too focused on Avant that I totally forgot about him.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
...！
對了！參謀長！
我怎麼會把他忘了？
我光顧著擔心阿旺，完全把他給忘了。

scripts.text: [Hisie]
scripts.translation: [希西]

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Although I was expecting this...
dealing with his personality makes me just so annoyed.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
雖然早有心理準備...
但和他這種性格的人打交道，真的讓我很煩躁。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Moreover, he's the one who rejected me as soon as he saw me. But he seems so interested in my body now,
and everytime I see him, I feel like I'm being examined and it horrifies me.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
而且，他一開始見到我就拒絕了我。但現在他似乎對我的身體很感興趣，
每次見到他，我都覺得自己像是在被檢查，這讓我感到恐懼。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
He's just amazed to see how I grew up to so clearly represent my mixed heritage.
I'll probably never admit that a person like him is my father!
scripts.translation:
[希西]
他對我長成現在這樣，完美地體現了混血特徵感到驚訝。
我大概永遠不會承認像他這樣的人是我的父親！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
The Chief of Staff doesn't know that Avant is imprisoned.
If he's the one who was pulling wires from behind, he'll be worried by now...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
參謀長不知道阿旺被囚禁了。
如果他是幕後操縱這一切的人，他現在應該很擔心...

scripts.text: Should I go and check on him?
scripts.translation: 我要去確認一下他的情況嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Thanks for suggesting.
Please, help us out.
It doesn't look good if Kar or I go and handle it ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
謝謝你的建議。
請幫幫我們。
如果卡爾或我自己去處理，情況會很不妙。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Especially, if Kar does so, other Laphines might misunderstand him.
Prejudice can be very hurtful.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
特別是如果卡爾去的話，其他拉菲涅人可能會誤解他。
偏見可能會造成很大的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Most Laphines want Kar to just keep the informations inherited from all the previous Mayors
and pass them on to the next Mayor quietly.
When he tries to do something, there is always a lot of resistance.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
大多數拉菲涅人希望卡爾只是安靜地繼承前任市長們的資訊，
並傳遞給下一任市長。
當他試圖做點什麼時，總是會遇到很大的阻力。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Kar doesn't have many people on his side. 
So, I want you to be a help to him
I'll leave the Chief of Staff to you.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
卡爾身邊沒有多少人支援他。
所以，我希望你能成為他的幫手。
參謀長就交給你了。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
If you find out something, return to where Kar is.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
如果你發現了什麼，回到卡爾所在的地方。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'm so thankful to you for your help.
Once everything goes back to normal, I would like to talk to you some more.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
非常感謝你的幫助。
等一切恢復正常後，我想和你多聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
We're here.
I'll tell you where the laboratory Yai is.
If you follow this road and head east...
it's where I marked.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我們到了。
我會告訴你雅伊實驗室在哪裡。
如果你沿著這條路往東走...
就是我標記的地方。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
You have the materials for experiment, right?
You have to approach him casually as if Shenime sent you.
Now, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你有實驗用的材料，對吧？
你必須表現得隨意一點，好像謝尼梅派你來的。
現在，走吧。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
This is the right Yai.
Remember to be casual.
Don't go inside, but make him come outside.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
這就是正確的雅伊。
記得要表現得隨意。
不要進去，讓他出來。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Since it's Avant's Yai, there might be equipped with some devices.
Anyway, let's wait and see if there's any chance.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
既然是阿旺的雅伊，可能配備了一些裝置。
不管怎樣，讓我們先看看有沒有機會。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Did you pack Dustballs and bookmarks made of fallen leaves?
You have to hurry.
Otherwise, he'll be suspicious of you.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你帶了塵埃和落葉做的書籤嗎？
你必須快點。
否則，他會對你起疑心。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Let's get out of here before he notices us.
We have to tell Kar about this first.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
趁他還沒發現我們，趕緊離開這裡。
我們必須先把這件事告訴卡爾。

scripts.text: [Hisie]
scripts.translation: [希西]

scripts.text:
After seeing Hisie hiding himself, you knocked on the door of the Yai.
After pounding on the door for a while, you sensed someone's presence near the door, and there opened a window that only one eye could peek through.
scripts.translation:
看到希西躲藏起來後，你敲了敲雅伊的門。
敲了一會兒後，你感覺到門附近有人，一扇只容得下一隻眼睛窺視的窗戶打開了。

scripts.text:
[A voice from inside]
...Who's this?
Is it a human being?
Interesting.
scripts.translation:
[裡面傳來的聲音]
...是誰？
是人類嗎？
有意思。

scripts.text:
The door of the Yai opened and a golden-haired Laphine came outside.
He started looking at me from head to toe with an interesting look on his face.
scripts.translation:
雅伊的門開了，一位金髮拉芬走了出來。
他帶著饒有興致的表情，從頭到腳打量著我。

scripts.text:
[Golden-haired Scholar]
Humans...nothing much to look at.
But why would a human being want to see me?
If it's something useless, you'll be sorry.
scripts.translation:
[金髮學者]
人類...沒什麼好看的。
但人類為什麼想見我？
如果是無聊的事，你會後悔的。

scripts.text: Delivery...
scripts.translation: 送貨...

scripts.text: Shenime told me to...
scripts.translation: 謝尼梅讓我來的...

scripts.text:
[Golden-haired Scholar]
What, Shenime sent you?
Dustballs and bookmarks made of fallen leaves.
It's no use...tsk.
scripts.translation:
[金髮學者]
什麼，謝尼梅派你來的？
塵埃和落葉做的書籤。
沒用...嘖。

scripts.text:
[Golden-haired Scholar]
Hey, human.
I'm more interested in you than these useless stuffs.
Do you want to be a subject of my experiments?
scripts.translation:
[金髮學者]
嘿，人類。
比起這些沒用的東西，我對你更感興趣。
你想成為我的實驗物件嗎？

scripts.text:
[Golden-haired Scholar]
You'll be able to rest in peace with no pain.
Isn't that a good option for you?
....Kkekekeke
scripts.translation:
[金髮學者]
你將能無痛苦地安息。
這不是個不錯的選擇嗎？
....呵呵呵呵

scripts.text:
[Golden-haired Scholar]
Look at that face!
If you don't want to, don't even think about coming here again.
scripts.translation:
[金髮學者]
看看那張臉！
如果你不想，就別再想來這裡了。

scripts.text:
The scholar of magics snatched the materials with a sarcastic smile on his face and went back into the Yai.
When he was gone, Hisie slid out of a leaf.
scripts.translation:
那位魔法學者帶著嘲諷的笑容拿走了材料，回到了雅伊裡。
他離開後，希西從一片葉子後滑了出來。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
That guy, he is Avant.
I think he is.
I almost didn't recognize him because he changed his hair color. But the way he looks and talks is pretty much the same. Disgusting!
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那個人，是阿旺。
我覺得是他。
他換了髮色，我差點沒認出來。但看他的樣子和說話方式，幾乎一模一樣。真噁心！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Does the Chief of Staff really know this guy?
Anyway, now that we know his whereabouts, let's go tell Kar.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
參謀長真的認識這傢伙嗎？
不管怎樣，既然知道了他的下落，我們快去告訴卡爾。

scripts.text: Go in right now.
scripts.translation: 現在進去

scripts.text: Wait and look all around.
scripts.translation: 等待並觀察四周

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Shh, I hear someone's inside. 
Let's wait a little more. We should go inside once he's gone.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
噓，我聽到裡面有人。
再等一會兒。等他走了我們再進去。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I feel some magical devices...
The more I see it, I think this Yai is not the real deal.
This could be connected to a separate place.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我感覺到一些魔法裝置...
越看越覺得這個雅伊不是真的。
這可能連線到另一個地方。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Let's be careful.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我們要小心。

scripts.text:
It's a Yai connecting to the scholar of magics' secret research lab.
Avant the Scholar of Magics must be subdued by Hisie.
scripts.translation:
這是一個連線到魔法學者秘密實驗室的雅伊。
魔法學者 阿旺必須被希西制服。

scripts.text:
It's a Yai connecting to the scholar of magics' secret research lab.
Avant the Scholar of Magics has already been subdued and is no longer here.
scripts.translation:
這是一個連線到魔法學者秘密實驗室的雅伊。
魔法學者 阿旺已經被制服，不再在這裡。

scripts.text:
This is a Laphine's Yai.
The door is locked shut.
scripts.translation:
這是拉芬的雅伊。
門被鎖住了。

scripts.text: It was definitely a small Yai when first entered, but upon regaining consciousness after being very dizzy, a huge space appeared.
scripts.translation: 剛進來時明明是個小雅伊，但頭暈目眩後恢復意識，眼前卻出現了一片巨大的空間。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It seems that a normal Yai is connected to a secret research lab.
How cautious...
Let's take a look.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
看來普通的雅伊連線著一個秘密實驗室。
真是謹慎...
我們去看看。

scripts.text:
It's a desk full of various experimental tools and documents.
What should we do?
scripts.translation:
這是一張堆滿了各種實驗工具和檔案的桌子。
我們要怎麼做？

scripts.text: Examine the desk.
scripts.translation: 檢查桌子

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text: Other parts of the desk should be examined.
scripts.translation: 應該檢查桌子的其他部分。

scripts.text:
I roughly organized the stuff on the desk.
What should we look into?
scripts.translation:
我大致整理了一下桌上的東西。
我們要檢視什麼？

scripts.text: Look at the documents first.
scripts.translation: 先看檔案

scripts.text: Look at the hinged devices on top of the desk.
scripts.translation: 看桌子上的鉸鏈裝置

scripts.text: Look at the book on the bookshelf.
scripts.translation: 看書架上的書

scripts.text: Try tasting the reagent.
scripts.translation: 嚐嚐試劑

scripts.text: Look at the lighting setup.
scripts.translation: 看照明裝置

scripts.text:
...Can't read a single word of it.
Let's show it to Hisie.
scripts.translation:
...一個字都看不懂。
給希西看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
...Door of Trust Periodicals publication...
......Not really useful.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
...《信任之門》期刊...
......沒什麼用。

scripts.text:
There are various hinged devices on top of the desk.
There has to be some kind of hints around here that can help with manipulating the device.
scripts.translation:
桌子上有各種鉸鏈裝置。
這裡肯定有某種線索，能幫助操作這個裝置。

scripts.text:
There are various hinged devices on top of the desk.
In the middle, there is a small numerical panel. A 5-digit number can be inputted.
scripts.translation:
桌子上有各種鉸鏈裝置。
中間有一個小的數字面板。可以輸入5位數字。

scripts.text: Input a number.
scripts.translation: 輸入數字

scripts.text: Look at other parts of the desk.
scripts.translation: 看桌子的其他部分

scripts.text: Look at other parts of the desk.
scripts.translation: 看桌子的其他部分

scripts.text:
As soon as the number is inputted, a click is heard.
The hinged device can be opened.
scripts.translation:
剛輸入完數字，就聽到咔噠一聲。
鉸鏈裝置可以打開了。

scripts.text:
The hinge does not open.
The number must be wrong.
scripts.translation:
鉸鏈沒有開啟。
數字肯定錯了。

scripts.text:
There are 5 books on the shelf arranged neatly.
Strange symbols are noticeable.
scripts.translation:
書架上整齊地擺放著5本書。
上面刻著奇怪的符號。

scripts.text: Try rearranging the books.
scripts.translation: 嘗試重新排列書籍

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text: Where should the {0} book be placed?
scripts.translation: 第{0}本書應該放在哪裡？

scripts.text: First
scripts.translation: 第一

scripts.text: Second
scripts.translation: 第二

scripts.text: Third
scripts.translation: 第三

scripts.text: Fourth
scripts.translation: 第四

scripts.text: Fifth
scripts.translation: 第五個

scripts.text: Book 1 was placed at the {0} spot.
scripts.translation: 第1本書被放在了第{0}個位置。

scripts.text:
As soon as the books were rearranged, the symbols formed one picture.
Does this mean something?
The reagent on the desk was tasted with a finger.
A pungent sensation at the tip of the tongue tasted like death...
scripts.translation:
書籍重新排列後，那些符號組成了一幅圖案。
這有什麼含義嗎？
用手指蘸了桌上的試劑嚐了嚐。
舌尖傳來刺鼻的感覺，嚐起來像是死亡的味道...

scripts.text:
Books were rearranged in various ways, but nothing happened.
The reagent on the desk was tasted with a finger.
A pungent sensation at the tip of the tongue tasted like death...
scripts.translation:
書籍被以各種方式重新排列，但什麼都沒發生。
用手指蘸了桌上的試劑嚐了嚐。
舌尖傳來刺鼻的感覺，嚐起來像是死亡的味道...

scripts.text:
Other parts of the desk should be examined.
The reagent on the desk was tasted with a finger.
A pungent sensation at the tip of the tongue tasted like death...
scripts.translation:
應該檢查桌子的其他部分。
用手指蘸了桌上的試劑嚐了嚐。
舌尖傳來刺鼻的感覺，嚐起來像是死亡的味道...

scripts.text:
The reagent on the desk was tasted with a finger.
A pungent sensation at the tip of the tongue tasted like death...
scripts.translation:
用手指蘸了桌上的試劑嚐了嚐。
舌尖傳來刺鼻的感覺，嚐起來像是死亡的味道...

scripts.text:
It is a typical, round lighting system.
Nothing was particularly special.
scripts.translation:
這是一個典型的圓形照明裝置。
沒有什麼特別之處。

scripts.text:
Within the secret space of the desk, a part of the research documents were found.
The contents could not be read.
Let's ask Hisie.
scripts.translation:
在桌子的秘密空間裡，找到了一些研究檔案。
內容無法閱讀。
去問問希西吧。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
What did you find?
Hmm?? This is a portrait of my mother.
Why does that man have this?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你找到了什麼？
嗯？？這是我母親的畫像。
為什麼那個男人會有這個？

scripts.text: She's beautiful.
scripts.translation: 她很漂亮。

scripts.text: Look at these documents!
scripts.translation: 看看這些檔案！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Kar's and my hair were inherited from our mother.
For Kar, it's an important memento of her...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我和卡爾的頭髮都是遺傳自母親的。
對卡爾來說，這是她重要的紀念物...

scripts.text: [Hisie]
scripts.translation: [希西]

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Ah, I'm sorry. I understand.
This is........
No way... I can't believe it.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
啊，抱歉，我明白了。
這是........
不可能...我不敢相信。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
More importantly, the documents next to it... These research documents must be the ones he's hiding.
This.... The content.... No way.. I can't believe this!
scripts.translation:
[希西]
更重要的是，旁邊的檔案...這些研究檔案一定是他藏起來的。
這....內容....不可能..我不敢相信！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Avant, is this what you were researching?
Where do you plan to use it?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
阿旺，這就是你在研究的東西嗎？
你打算用它做什麼？

scripts.text: Just what is it?
scripts.translation: 那到底是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
These research documents are regarding the Orb.
The Orb, the symbol of Eclage and the focus of great magic forces!
What do you plan to do with the Orb's magical powers?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
這些研究檔案是關於寶珠的。
寶珠，埃克拉珠的象徵，也是強大魔力力量的核心！
你打算用寶珠的魔力做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
This research is dangerous.
Is the chief of staff sponsoring you knowing the nature of this research?
We have to let Kar know immediately.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
這項研究很危險。
參謀長明知這項研究的性質，還在支援你嗎？
我們必須立刻告訴卡爾。

scripts.text:
[Avant the Scholar of Magics]
No, that's kind of difficult.
Impolite kids. Are you robbing an empty house?
That's the end of your antics!
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者 阿旺]
不，這有點困難。
沒禮貌的小孩。你們是在搶劫空房子嗎？
到此為止了！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Take this first.
I'll get Avant.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
先拿這個。
我去叫阿旺。

scripts.text: Let Hisie handle it.
scripts.translation: 讓希西處理

scripts.text: I'm taking care of this place!
scripts.translation: 我來處理這裡

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'll be right there.
Give the documents to Kar!
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我馬上到。
把檔案交給卡爾！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Alright. We just need to eliminate the ones that Avant summoned.
I'll support you from the back. If you need help, get closer to me.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
好的。我們只需要消滅阿旺召喚出來的那些東西。
我在後方支援你。如果需要幫助，就靠近我。

scripts.text: [Hisie]
scripts.translation: [希西]

scripts.text:
Avant's research documents have already been obtained.
Nothing more to see on the desk.
scripts.translation:
阿旺的研究檔案已經獲取。
桌上沒有更多東西了。

scripts.text: It's a Laphine scholar's desk.
scripts.translation: 這是拉斐恩學者的書桌。

scripts.text:
[Avant]
You dare lay a finger on me?! Pipsquek!!
I'll make your wish come true!
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
你敢碰我？小不點！
我會讓你如願以償的！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'm sure there are either important or strange research documents here.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
這裡肯定有重要或奇怪的研究檔案。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I can't believe you were hiding and carrying out such useless research...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
真不敢相信你竟然躲在這裡進行這種無用的研究...

scripts.text: [Hisie]
scripts.translation: [希西]

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Don't try anything funny.
You'd better do as we say.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
別耍花樣。
最好聽我們的話。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
There's nothing more to see here.
Let's go back.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
這裡沒有更多東西了。
我們回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Avant]
Breaking and entering is not enough that you would mug me now, too, huh?
That's why young kids are...
Well, whatever, do as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
入室盜竊還不夠，現在還要偷我的錢嗎？
這就是年輕小孩...
算了，隨你們便吧。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
...Are you playing with me?
Why are you letting me catch you so easily?
What are you scheming?!
scripts.translation:
[希西]
...你在耍我嗎？
為什麼讓你這麼容易抓住？
你在打什麼算盤？！

scripts.text:
[Avant]
Just because. Maybe because it's good to meet my sons after many years?
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
只是這樣。也許是因為多年後見到我的兒子們是件好事？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Your sons? Give me a break.
{0}! I have nothing more to say to this guy.
I'll take care of it so you go on your way.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你的兒子？別開玩笑了。
{0}！我沒什麼好跟這傢伙說的了。
我來處理，你走吧。

scripts.text:
It's a Laphine's corpse.
From how much change the corpse underwent, it probably hasn't been too long.
scripts.translation:
這是拉斐恩的屍體。
從屍體的變化程度來看，應該沒過多久。

scripts.text:
Looking at it closer, it's the chief of staff!
Where there's supposed to be the head, there is a hole.
scripts.translation:
仔細看，這是參謀長！
本該有頭部的地方，只有一個洞。

scripts.text:
Blood stains from the hole seems to be directing toward the south.
The stains seem like some kind of long bug crawled away.
scripts.translation:
從那個洞裡的血跡來看，似乎是指向南方。
血跡的樣子像是某種長條形的蟲子爬走了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If it's south of here...
It's the rift.
.....did he escape to the rift, Shenime!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果是在南邊...
那就是裂縫。
.....他逃到裂縫裡去了嗎，謝尼梅！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Looks like there's nothing more to be gained here.
I should let Kardui know as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來這裡已經查不出更多線索了。
我得儘快通知卡爾杜伊。

scripts.text:
It's the chief of staff's corpse.
The body that used to control the chief of staff has escaped.
scripts.translation:
這是參謀長的屍體。
原本控制著參謀長身體的那個東西逃走了。

scripts.text: It's a Laphine's corpse.
scripts.translation: 這是拉斐恩的屍體。
